local local_class = newclass('CafeTiniaRecruitingSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = "cafe_1_4"

end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local tinia = get_character('recruit_tinia')

	character_util.set_emotion(tinia, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(tinia, {name = 'seat', loop = true})
	character_util.set_direction(tinia, 'right')
	tinia.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	local cafe_main_quest_id = 60033
	local q = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(cafe_main_quest_id)

	if q.InnerProgress >= 17 then
		character_util.set_position(tinia, vector(26, 0, -84))
	end


end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_interact_event, self, e))

	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local tinia = get_character('recruit_tinia')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, tinia) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.tinia_recruit_event_clear, self)
	end
end


function local_class:tinia_recruit_event_clear()
	-- 아랫방에 침울해 있는 티니아
	-- 티니아에게 말을 걸면 동료 영입 이벤트 발생.

	local tinia = get_character('recruit_tinia')

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	character_util.align_party(tinia.Position, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(tinia, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(tinia, {name = 'idle', loop = true})
	character_util.set_direction(tinia, 'left')

	-- 나는 정의의 사도인데...
	character_util.set_anim(tinia, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(tinia, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tinia, { key = 'cafe_s17_29', skip = true })

	-- 이렇게 헛발질 하다가 죄없는 사람이라도 잡으면…
	character_util.set_anim(tinia, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(tinia, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tinia, { key = 'cafe_s17_30', skip = true })

	-- 같이 페이퍼마스크를 혼내주자!
	-- 같이 정의를 되찾을 때야!
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'cafe_s17_34', 'forced' }, { 'cafe_s17_35', 'intellect' } }, 'release')

	-- 네 말이 맞아...
	character_util.set_anim(tinia, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(tinia, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tinia, { key = 'cafe_s17_31', skip = true })

	-- 맛간 대사
	character_util.set_anim(tinia, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(tinia, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tinia, { key = 'cafe_s17_31_1', skip = true })


	-- 악을 베어내는 한 송이 하얀 장미! 티! 니! 아!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim(tinia, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_jump_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(tinia, { name = 'attack', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tinia, { key = 'cafe_s17_32', skip = true })


	-- 너와 함께 할게!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim(tinia, { name = 'sing', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(tinia, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tinia, { key = 'cafe_s17_33', skip = true })

	if tinia.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		tinia.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end


	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cafe_s17_36'})

	character_util.remove_anim(tinia)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(tinia, { vector(26, 0, -80.5), vector(33, 0, -80.5) }, 5, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'up', true)

	character_util.set_position(tinia, vector(999, 0, 888))

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
	-- 티니아 리크루트. 이벤트 종료.
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('CafeTurnBasedVsRealTimeSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CafeTurnBasedVsRealTime @
		Comment = 턴제 vs 실시간 스타피스 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 배틀 그룹 이름
	self.battle_group_name = 'turn_based_vs_real_time'

	-- 배틀 존 이름
	self.battle_zone_name = 'turn_based_vs_real_time'

	-- 문 이름
	self.battle_gate_name = 'turn_base_vs_real_time_door_'

	-- 스타 피스를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	-- 캐릭터를 얻어오는 함수
	self.get_tifa = function() return get_character('tifa') end
	self.get_aerith = function() return get_character('aerith') end
	self.get_thug = function(num) return get_character('thug_' .. num) end

	-- 이펙트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_hit_effect = controller.get_hit_effect
	self.get_blink_effect = controller.get_blink_effect
	self.get_target_marker_effect = controller.get_target_marker_effect

	-- 에어리스와 티파가 대사를 반복하고 있는지
	self.is_speech_tifa_and_aerith = true

	-- 불량배가 타겟을 계속 때리고 있는지
	self.is_thug_attack_target = false

	-- 티파와 에어리스가 안에 들어갔는지
	self.is_tifa_and_aerith_go_inside = false

	self.target_marker = nil
	self.target_marker_container = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	local tifa = self.get_tifa()
	tifa.Position = vector(55, 0, 33)
	character_util.set_direction(tifa, 'right')
	tifa.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	local aerith = self.get_aerith()
	aerith.Position = vector(56, 0, 33)
	character_util.set_direction(aerith, 'left')
	aerith.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.speech_tifa_and_aerith, self))

	self.target_marker = self.get_target_marker_effect():Instantiate(vector(999, 0, 999))
	self.target_marker_container = self.target_marker.transform:GetChild(0)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local tifa = self.get_tifa()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(tifa.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		tifa.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	local aerith = self.get_aerith()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(aerith.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		aerith.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	local thug_1 = self.get_thug(1)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(thug_1.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		thug_1.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	local thug_2 = self.get_thug(2)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(thug_2.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		thug_2.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.target_marker ~= nil then
		self.target_marker:Dispose()
		self.target_marker = nil
	end
	self.target_marker_container = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		return self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local tifa = self.get_tifa()
	local aerith = self.get_aerith()
	local thug_1 = self.get_thug(1)
	local thug_2 = self.get_thug(2)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, tifa) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, aerith) then
		if not self.is_tifa_and_aerith_go_inside then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_ff7_npc, self)
			return true
		elseif not self.is_thug_attack_target then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.never_win, self)
			return true
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_thug, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, thug_1) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, thug_2) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_thug, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.battle_end, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 코루틴 반복
function local_class:speech_tifa_and_aerith()
	local tifa = self.get_tifa()
	local aerith = self.get_aerith()

	while self.is_speech_tifa_and_aerith do
		-- 도저히 그놈들을 이길 수가 없어….
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tifa, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_1' })

		if not self.is_speech_tifa_and_aerith then break end

		-- 대체 뭐가 문제지….
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aerith, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_2' })
	end
end

-- 티파/에어리스 에게 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_ff7_npc()
	local tifa = self.get_tifa()
	local aerith = self.get_aerith()

	party_util.align_to_target((tifa.Position + aerith.Position) / 2 + vector(0, 0, -0.5), 'down', 1, 'arc')

	if self.is_speech_tifa_and_aerith then
		self.is_speech_tifa_and_aerith = false
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(tifa)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(aerith)

		-- 저기, 저희를 좀 도와주실 수 있을까요?
		character_util.look_at(tifa, user_party_leader)
		character_util.set_anim(tifa, { name = 'sing' })
		character_util.look_at(aerith, user_party_leader)
		character_util.set_anim(aerith, { name = 'sing' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aerith, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_3', skip = true })

		-- 얼마 전부터 불량배들이 나타나 자릿세를 내라고 위협하기 시작했어요.
		character_util.set_anim(aerith, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aerith, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_4', skip = true })

		-- 저희도 저희 나름대로 맞서 싸우고는 있지만…
		character_util.remove_anim(aerith)
		character_util.remove_anim(tifa)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tifa, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_5', skip = true })

		-- 어째서인지 저희 공격은 놈들에게 전혀 먹히지 않았어요!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		character_util.set_anim(tifa, { name = 'cast' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tifa, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_6', skip = true })

		-- 힘이 부족하다거나 그런 게 아니라…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tifa, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_7', skip = true })

		-- 뭔가 근본적인 게 차이가 나는 것 같은데…
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(tifa, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tifa, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_8', skip = true })
	end

	-- 혹시 저희 전투를 보시고 문제점을 짚어 주실 수 있을까요?
	character_util.remove_anim(tifa)
	character_util.remove_anim(aerith)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aerith, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_8_1', skip = true })

	-- 예 / 아니오
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_8_2', 'mercy' }, { 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_8_3', 'brutal' } })
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 좋았어! 그럼 바로 갑시다! 이쪽이에요!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(tifa, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(tifa, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tifa, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_8_4', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tifa)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(aerith)

		-- 플래그 설정 후 이동
		character_util.move_waypoint(tifa, { vector(55, 0, 31), vector(64, 0, 31) }, 7, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(aerith, { vector(56, 0, 31), vector(65, 0, 31) }, 7, true, nil, nil, 'right', true)

		tifa.Position = vector(93, 0, 33)
		character_util.set_direction(tifa, 'down')

		aerith.Position = vector(94, 0, 33)
		character_util.set_direction(aerith, 'down')

		self.is_tifa_and_aerith_go_inside = true
	else
		-- 저흰 이곳에 있을테니, 생각이 바뀌시면 찾아와 주세요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aerith, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_8_5', skip = true })
	end
end

-- 길가에 곤란해 하고 있는 에어리스와 티파 코스프레를 한 서큐버스들
function local_class:never_win()
	local tifa = self.get_tifa()
	local aerith = self.get_aerith()
	local thug_1 = self.get_thug(1)
	local thug_2 = self.get_thug(2)

	party_util.align_to_target((tifa.Position + aerith.Position) / 2 + vector(0, 0, -0.5), 'down', 1, 'arc')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aerith, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_8_6', skip = true })

	-- 어이! 멍청이들!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_goblin_appear_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	character_util.set_direction(tifa, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(aerith, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim(tifa)
	character_util.remove_anim(aerith)
	party_util.set_direction('left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(thug_1, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_9', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = vector(89.5, 0, 31.5) })

	-- 불량배들이 걸어 들어온다.
	thug_1.Position = vector(84, 0, 31.25)
	thug_2.Position = vector(84, 0, 29.75)
	character_util.move_waypoint(thug_1, vector(91, 0, 31.25), 4, false)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(thug_2, vector(91, 0, 29.75), 4, false)

	-- 오늘은 제대로 준비를 해 놨겠지?
	character_util.set_emotion(thug_1, { name = 'doyagao' })
	character_util.set_anim(thug_1, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(thug_1, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_10', skip = true })

	-- 그래~ 서로 귀찮게 하지 말자고~
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_die_fat_ogre_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(thug_2, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(thug_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(thug_2, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_11', skip = true })

	-- 몇 번이고 말했지만, 당신들에게 줄 돈은 한 푼도 없어요!
	character_util.remove_anim(thug_2)
	character_util.set_emotion(aerith, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aerith, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_12', skip = true })

	-- 어우, 지겨워. 맨날 똑같은 소리…
	character_util.normal_jump(thug_2, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(thug_2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(thug_2, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_13', skip = true })

	-- 그래, 이번엔 또 어떻게 패 줄까?
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(thug_1, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_14', skip = true })

	-- 이번엔 호락호락 당하고만 있지는 않겠어요!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(thug_1)
	character_util.set_emotion(tifa, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tifa, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_15', skip = true })

	-- 간다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aerith, { key = 'cafe_turn_based_vs_real_time_16', skip = true })

	party_util.set_direction('down')
	camera_util.move(vector(93.5, 0, 30.5), 0.5)

	character_util.move_waypoint(user_party_leader, vector(93.5, 0, 33), 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')

	local tifa_battle_position = vector(96, 0, 31.25)
	local aerith_battle_position = vector(96.5, 0, 29.75)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(tifa, 'left')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(aerith, 'left')
	character_util.jump(tifa, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.jump(aerith, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.remove_emotion(tifa)
	character_util.remove_emotion(aerith)
	character_util.set_anim(tifa, { name = 'cast2' })
	character_util.set_anim(aerith, { name = 'cast2' })
	character_util.move_to(tifa, tifa_battle_position, 0.5, nil, false, false)
	character_util.move_to_async(aerith, aerith_battle_position, 0.5, nil, false, false)

	local is_kong_japan = CS.Foundations.GameEnvironment.IsKongJapan
	local sfx_to_play = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_kong_japan, 'bgm_battle_event', 'ondemand/cafe/parody_audio:bgm_cafe_battle')

-- 턴 게이지 재충전
function local_class:timer_bar_recharge(timer_bar, duration, delay, callback)
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0)

	wait_for_sec(delay)

	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(duration, duration)

	while true do
		local value = timer_bar.BarSprite.CurrentValue

		if value >= duration then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	callback()
end

-- 턴 게이지 중지
function local_class:timer_bar_stop(timer_bar)
	local current_value = timer_bar.BarSprite.CurrentValue

	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(current_value, 0)
end

-- 턴 게이지 재진행
function local_class:timer_bar_resume(timer_bar, duration)
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(duration, duration)
end

-- 공격자가 타겟을 공격함
function local_class:attack_target(attacker, target, battle_position, attack_anim, idle_anim, damage)
	-- 공격자의 턴이 돌아온 표시로 캐릭터가 번쩍 거림
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_guild_warp_01')
	self.get_blink_effect():Instantiate(attacker.Position)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 공격자가 적 앞으로 다가감
	character_util.remove_anim(attacker)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(attacker, target.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 7, true, nil, nil, 'left', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 공격자가 적을 공격
	character_util.set_anim(attacker, { name = attack_anim, loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.1666)
	self:target_hit(target, damage)
	wait_for_sec(0.1666)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 공격자가 원래 자리로 돌아감
	character_util.remove_emotion(attacker)
	character_util.remove_anim(attacker)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(attacker, battle_position, 7, true, nil, nil, 'left', true)
	character_util.set_anim(attacker, { name = idle_anim })
end

-- 피격 연출
function local_class:target_hit(target, damage)
	damage = lua_helper.get_or_default(damage, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = target, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))

	character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	if damage > 0 then
		CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(target, damage, unity_class.color.red, target.Position)
	end
end

-- 불량배가 대상을 지속해서 때리는 연출
function local_class:thug_attack_target(thug, target, delay, scale)
	scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 4)

	delay = lua_helper.get_or_default(delay, 0)

	wait_for_sec(delay)

	while self.is_thug_attack_target do
		character_util.set_anim(thug, { name = 'attack', loop = false, scale = scale })
		wait_for_sec(0.3 / scale)
		self:target_hit(target, 100)
		wait_for_sec(0.2 / scale)
		character_util.remove_anim(thug)
		wait_for_sec(0.5 / scale)
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:get_current_footprint()

function local_class:start_footprint_routine(index)
	if self.is_tracking_list[index] == false then
		self.is_tracking_list[index] = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.footprint_routine, self, index))
	end
end

function local_class:stop_footprint_routine(index)
	self.is_tracking_list[index] = false
end

function local_class:footprint_routine(index)
	local footprint_pos = self.get_footprint_pos(index)
	local fx_footprint_list = {}
	local renderer_list = {}

	for _, info in pairs(self.footprint_info[index]) do
		local fx_footprint = (info.is_left and self.get_fx_footprint_left() or self.get_fx_footprint_right())
				:Instantiate(footprint_pos + info.pos)
		fx_footprint.transform.rotation = info.rot
		local renderer = fx_footprint.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))
		renderer.material:SetColor('_TintColor', self:get_progress_color(0))
		table.insert(fx_footprint_list, fx_footprint)
		table.insert(renderer_list, renderer)
	end

	while self.is_tracking_list[index] do
		for k, v in pairs(fx_footprint_list) do
			local dist = (user_party.Leader.Position - v.transform.localPosition).magnitude
			local progress = 0

			if dist <= self.appear_start_dist then
				progress = self:get_dist_progress(dist)
			end

			renderer_list[k].material:SetColor('_TintColor', self:get_progress_color(progress))
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local duration = 1
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local cur_alpha_list = {}

	for _, v in pairs(renderer_list) do
		table.insert(cur_alpha_list, v.material:GetColor('_TintColor').a)
	end

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((unity_class.time.time - start_time) / duration)
		for k, v in pairs(renderer_list) do
			v.material:SetColor('_TintColor', unity_color({1, 0, 0, cur_alpha_list[k] * (1 - progress)}))
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	for _, v in pairs(fx_footprint_list) do
		v:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:get_dist_progress(dist)
	return unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((self.appear_start_dist - dist) / (self.appear_start_dist - self.appear_end_dist))
end

function local_class:get_progress_color(progress)
	local ease = -(progress - 1) * (progress - 1) + 1
	return unity_color({1, 0, 0, ease * 50 / 256})
end

function local_class:process_to_next_footprint()
	self:stop_footprint_routine(self.current_progress)
	self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

	local cur_footprint = self:get_current_footprint()
	if not is_unity_null(cur_footprint) then
		cur_footprint.Position = self.get_footprint_pos(self.current_progress)
		cur_footprint.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end
end

end

local local_class = newclass('CaptainLostMemorySection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CaptainLostMemory @
		Comment = 용사교도들과 의식을 치르다 플레이어를 보고 도망가는 기사단장 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.believer_eva = nil
	self.believer_list = {}
	self.ritual = nil

	self.ritual_index = 1
	self.is_request = false

	self.believer_eva_name = "believer_eva"
	self.believers_name = "believer_"
	self.marker_name1 = "captain_lost_memory"
	self.tracker_name1 = "knight_captain_lose_memory_tracker_1_0"

	self.talk_name1 = "knight_captain_lose_memory_1"
	self.talk_name2 = "knight_captain_lose_memory_2"

	self.branch_name1 = "knight_captain_lose_memory_talk_branch_0"
	self.branch_name2 = "knight_captain_lose_memory_talk_branch_1"
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= "desert_1_2" then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.believer_eva = get_character(self.believer_eva_name)
	self.believer_eva.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	character_util.set_position(self.believer_eva, vector(-5, 0, 97.5))
	character_util.set_direction(self.believer_eva, "left")
	character_util.set_anim(self.believer_eva, {name = "victory_extra"})

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local c = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.believers_name, i))
		character_util.set_anim(c, {name = "victory_extra"})
		table.insert(self.believer_list, c)

		if i == 1 or i == 5 then
			character_util.set_direction(c, "left")
		else
			character_util.set_direction(c, "right")
		end
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.believer_list[1], vector(-4, 0, 95))
	character_util.set_position(self.believer_list[2], vector(-1, 0, 95))
	character_util.set_position(self.believer_list[3], vector(0, 0, 97.5))
	character_util.set_position(self.believer_list[4], vector(-1, 0, 100))
	character_util.set_position(self.believer_list[5], vector(-4, 0, 100))

	self.ritual_index = 2

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= "desert_1_2" then
		return
	end

	self:set_marker_and_tracker()
end

function local_class:set_marker_and_tracker()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name1)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name1, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
	self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.believer_eva)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name1))

	self.ritual = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
			self.believers_ritual, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.believer_eva = nil
	self.believer_list = nil
	if self.ritual ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.ritual)
	end
	self.ritual = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.believer_eva) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_eva, self))
	end

	for key,value in pairs(self.believer_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, value) then
			if i % 2 == 1 then
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(value, {key = self.talk_name1})
			else
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(value, {key = self.talk_name2})
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:believers_ritual()
	local ritual_pos_list = {
		vector(-5, 0, 97.5),
		vector(-4, 0, 95),
		vector(-1, 0, 95),
		vector(0, 0, 97.5),
		vector(-1, 0, 100),
		vector(-4, 0, 100),
	}

	while true do
		self.believer_eva:RemoveAnimation()

		for key,value in pairs(self.believer_list) do
			value:RemoveAnimation()
		end

		local dest = ritual_pos_list[self.ritual_index]
		local dir
		if self.ritual_index <= 2 or self.ritual_index == 6 then
			dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		else
			dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint(self.believer_eva, dest, 4, false, "stop", "floor",
				dir)

		for i = 1, #self.believer_list do
			local cur_inx
			if self.ritual_index + i > 6 then
				cur_inx = self.ritual_index + i - #ritual_pos_list
			else
				cur_inx = self.ritual_index + i
			end

			dest = ritual_pos_list[cur_inx]

			if cur_inx <= 2 or cur_inx == 6 then
				dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			else
				dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
			end

			character_util.move_waypoint(self.believer_list[i], dest, 4, false, "stop",
					"floor", dir)
		end

		local move_finished = false

		while not move_finished do
			local check = 0

			for key,value in pairs(self.believer_list) do
				if value.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
					check = check + 1
				end
			end

			if self.believer_eva.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ==  CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
				check = check + 1
			end

			if check == #self.believer_list + 1 then
				move_finished = true
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if self.ritual_index == 6 then
			self.ritual_index = 1
		else
			self.ritual_index = self.ritual_index + 1
		end

		if self.ritual_index % 3 == 1 then
			self:set_believers_animation("clap")
		elseif self.ritual_index % 3 == 2 then
			self:set_believers_animation("sing")
		else
			self:set_believers_animation("success")
		end

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(3))
	end
end

function local_class:talk_with_eva()
	stop_coroutine(self.ritual)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	character_util.stop(self.believer_eva)

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "talk_with_eva_start")

	if not self.is_request then
		yield_return(self.controller.scene, "talk_with_eva")

		self.is_request = true
	end

	local wait = true
	local take_eva = false
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			take_eva = true
		end})

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.believer_eva, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		return true

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_event')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.survive_believer = nil
	self.switch_list = nil
	self.brazier_list = nil
	self.check_switche_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent) then
		self:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		self:on_item_get_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.remove_marker_zone_name then
		if not user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.substage_map_name) then
			quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
		end
	end

	-- 서브스테이지가 아닌 경우 아래 루틴 무시함
	if stage.Name == self.substage_map_name then
		if zone_name == self.battle_zone_name then
			if not self.enter_first_battle then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.male_cry_sfx_handle_name)

				self.enter_first_battle = true
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.survive_believer, {key = self.talk_name1})
			end
		elseif zone_name == self.main_room_zone_name then
			if not self.see_intro then
				self.see_intro = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_hide_out, self))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.survive_believer) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.survive_believer, game_string:GetString(self.talk_name2))
	end
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.switch_list do
		if e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.switch_list[i]) and
				not self.check_switche_list[i] then
			self.check_switche_list[i] = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.switch_on, self, i))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if e.Item.ItemId == self.key_id then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_key, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.save_believer, self))
	end
end

function local_class:save_believer()
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	self.survive_believer.SpineController:CancelShake()

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "section_3_save_believer")

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
	self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.survive_believer)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name2))
	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:enter_hide_out()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "section_3_enter_hideout")

	self.survive_believer.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(string.format("%s_%d", self.marker_name, i),
				self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.switch_list[i])
	end

	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name3))
	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:switch_on(index)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(string.format("%s_%d", self.marker_name, index))
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	screen_util.fade_out(0.7, unity_class.color.black, "linear")
	--screen_util.fade_out_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.7))

	camera_util.move(self.brazier_list[index].Position, 0, {ignorecameragrids = true})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	screen_util.fade_in(0.7, unity_class.color.black, "linear")
	--screen_util.fade_in_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.switch_on_sfx_handle_name)
	self.brazier_num = self.brazier_num + 1
	command_util.execute_burn(self.switch_list[index], self.brazier_list[index])

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.2))

	if self.brazier_num == self.max_brazier then
		--TODO: Check
		--local func = coroutine_class.coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.drop_key, self))
		--yield_return_func(func)
		yield_return(coroutine_manager, "StartCoroutine", stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.drop_key, self))
		--coroutine.yield(coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		--		util.cs_generator(self.drop_key, self)))
	end

	screen_util.fade_out(0.7, unity_class.color.black, "linear")
	--screen_util.fade_out_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.7))

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	screen_util.fade_in(0.7, unity_class.color.black, "linear")
	--screen_util.fade_in_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.7))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:drop_key()
	camera_util.move(vector(-0.5, 0, 27.5), 0.5, { ignorecameragrids = true})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	local throw_audios_source_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = self.throw_key_Sfx_handle_name,
	loop = true, type_priority = "loop", player_priority = "npc"})

	local key = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{pos = vector(-0.5, 10, 27.5), target = vector(-0.5, 0, 27.5),
			itemid = self.key_id, notforinven = true, bounce = true})
	key.PickFlyDistance = 1

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))

	throw_audios_source_holder:FadeOut(0.2)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.drop_key_sfx_handle_name)
	throw_audios_source_holder:FadeOut(1.5)
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
	self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-0.5, 0, 27.5))
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name4))

	--coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:section_3_get_key())

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shield_force_effect_preset_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shield_force_effect_preset_name)

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	self.survive_believer = get_character(self.believer_name)
	self.believer_eva = get_character(self.believer_captain_name)
	self.captain_eva = get_character(self.captain_name)
	self.boss = get_character(self.boss_name)

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 3 then
		character_util.set_position(self.survive_believer, vector(-0.5, 0, 1))
		character_util.set_direction(self.survive_believer, "down")
	end

	self.believer_eva.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	table.insert(self.believer_list, self.believer_eva)

	for i = 2, 5 do
		local c = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.believer_list_name, i))
		c.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		table.insert(self.believer_list, c)
	end

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local c = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.tentacle_list_name, i))
		table.insert(self.tentacle_list, c)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= "substage_5_3" then
		return
	end

	self.controller.scene:add_callback('ThrowBelievers', { controller = self, func = self.throw_believers } )
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('DamagedParty', { controller = self, func = self.damaged_party } )
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('EvaRemind', { controller = self, func = self.eva_remind } )
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('CaptainDefeatBoss', { controller = self, func = self.captain_defeat_boss } )

	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name1))
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
	self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-0.5, 0, 48))

	local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(self.survive_believer, user_party, 0, 0)
	self.survive_believer:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	self.survive_believer.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.survive_believer.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.setting, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.survive_believer = nil
	self.believer_eva = nil
	self.captain_eva = nil
	self.boss = nil

	if self.resource_holder ~= nil then
		self.resource_holder:Dispose()
	end
	self.resource_holder = nil
	self.eva_effect_Sfx = nil
	self.custom_sprite = nil
	self.custom_atlas = nil
	self.original_combat_music_name = nil


	self.believer_list = nil

	for key,value in pairs(self.tentacle_list) do
		value = nil
	end
	self.tentacle_list = nil
	self.bone_follower_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and
		e.Zone.Name == self.boss_room_zone_name then
			if not self.see_boss_intro then
				self.see_boss_intro = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_battle, self))
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == self.boss_group_name then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:setting()
	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "section_4_setting")

	local idx = 1
	for key,value in pairs(self.believer_list) do
		character_util.spine_rotate(value, 180, 0)
		character_util.set_active_shadow(value, false)
		value:Shake(0.04, 9999)

		local bone_follower = value.UnityGameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
		bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
		bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = self.tentacle_list[idx].SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
		bone_follower:SetBone(self.tentacle_bone_name)
		table.insert(self.bone_follower_list, bone_follower)
		idx = idx + 1
	end
end

function local_class:boss_battle()
	music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.suspense_bgm_handle_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event)
	music_player:RemoveStageMusicClip(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field)
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = false

	self.original_combat_music_name = music_player.StageCombatMusicName
	yield_return(music_player, "SetStageMusicClip", self.boss_battle_bgm_handle_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Combat)

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	self.survive_believer:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	self.survive_believer.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance;
	self.survive_believer.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.survive_believer.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "section_4_boss_battle")

	camera_util.move(self.boss.Position, 1, {ignorecameragrids = true})
	screen_util.show_boss_title(self.boss_title_name, self.boss_subtitle_name, 2)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	character_util.set_anim(self.boss, {name = "attack"})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.boss))
	self.boss:RemoveAnimation()
	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 1, {ignorecameragrids = true})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	character_util.convert_to_monster(self.boss, self.first_battle_group_name)

	for key,value in pairs(self.tentacle_list) do
		value:RemoveAnimation()
		character_util.convert_to_monster(value, self.first_battle_group_name)
	end

	character_util.set_immortal(self.boss, true)
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.boss, user_party_leader, "battle")

	for i = 1, 2 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(string.format("%s%d",
		self.boss_battle_gate_name, i)));
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false));

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_boss_hp, self))
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name2))
	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:check_boss_hp()
	local stats = self.boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour

	while true do
		if stats.HP < stats.MaxHP * 0.3 then
			if self.boss.SpineController.SpineOffset.y < 0 then
				self.boss.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
			end
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	yield_return(self, "awake_eva")
end

function local_class:awake_eva()
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.boss)

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "section_4_awake_eva")

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.boss))

	character_util.convert_to_monster(self.boss, self.boss_group_name)
	character_util.set_death_type(self.boss, "bossexplosion")
	character_util.set_immortal(self.boss, false)
	self.boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour:Heal(math.floor(self.boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.3))
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.boss, user_party_leader, "battle")

	for key,value in pairs(self.tentacle_list) do
		value:RemoveAnimation()
		character_util.convert_to_monster(value, self.boss_group_name)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.boss_battle_bgm_handle_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Combat)
	CS.Oak.StageUtil.NpcToAllyInBattle(self.captain_eva)
	character_util.set_immortal(self.captain_eva, true)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(string.format("%s%d",
		self.boss_battle_gate_name, i)));
	end

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:ending()
	music_player:PlayVoice(self.eva_voice_id, 0 , CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.BossBattleWin, self.captain_eva)

	for key,value in pairs(self.tentacle_list) do
		character_util.set_active_state(value, "disabled")
	end

	if self.original_combat_music_name ~= nil then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(music_player, music_player:SetStageMusicClip(self.original_combat_music_name,
		CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Combat))

		self.original_combat_music_name = nil
	end

	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = true

	for i = 1, 2 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(string.format("%s%d",
				self.boss_battle_gate_name, i)));
	end

	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.captain_eva)
	character_util.stop(self.captain_eva)
	character_util.set_anim(self.boss, {name = "damaged"})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(5.25))

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "section_4_end")

	local wait = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.captain_eva, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "section_4_end_2")

	local char_spec = CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId
	local alreadyhascharacter = user:GetCharacter(char_spec.KnightCaptain, true) ~= nil
	local eva = self.captain_eva

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)

	local ismaxparty = user_party.Count >= CS.Oak.User.Me.Party.MaxLimitCharacterCount
	local character_theatre_data = CS.Oak.CharacterTheatreData()
	character_theatre_data.Character = eva
	character_theatre_data.CardName = self.eva_Card_name
	character_theatre_data.Title = game_string:GetString(self.eva_title_name)
	character_theatre_data.Subtitle = game_string:GetString(self.eva_subtitle_name)
	character_theatre_data.Desc = game_string:GetString(self.eva_desc_name)
	character_theatre_data.IsMaxParty = ismaxparty
	character_theatre_data.AlreadyHasInParty = alreadyhascharacter
	character_theatre_data.VoiceId = self.eva_voice_id
	character_theatre_data.VoiceType = CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.NormalBattleWin

	local isended_threatre = false
	CS.Oak.NewCharacterTheatre.ShowThreatre(character_theatre_data, function()
		isended_threatre = true
	end)

	while not isended_threatre do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	if not ismaxparty and not alreadyhascharacter then
		local getted_character = user:GetCharacter(char_spec.KnightCaptain)
		CS.Oak.AddHeroStageLogic.Execute(eva, getted_character, user, user_party)
	end

	local waiting = true
	stage.FieldUIQuestComplete:PlayTemplateWithChapter(game_string:GetString(self.stage_clear_title), "s",
	function ()
		waiting = false
	end)

	while waiting do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, "linear", "image")

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby(true)
end

function local_class:throw_believers()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.earthquake_sfx_handle_name)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.scream_Sfx_handle_name)
	character_util.set_anim(self.boss, {name = "cast"})

	for key,value in pairs(self.tentacle_list) do
		character_util.set_anim(value, {name = "in"})
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.tentacle_attack_sfx_handle_name)
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 1)

	for key,value in pairs(self.tentacle_list) do
		character_util.set_anim(value, {name = "attack", loop = false})
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	for k,v in pairs(self.bone_follower_list) do
		if v ~= nil then
			CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(v)
		end
	end

	self.bone_follower_list = nil
	self.bone_follower_list = {}
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.falldown_believers, self))

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.tentacle_hide_sfx_handle_name)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local down_time = 0.5
	local start_y = 0
	local end_y = -5.5

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < down_time do
		local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInSine(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_y, end_y - start_y,
		down_time)

		for key,value in pairs(self.tentacle_list) do
			character_util.set_position(value, vector(value.Position.x, cur_y, value.Position.z))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.boss:RemoveAnimation()
	for key,value in pairs(self.tentacle_list) do
		character_util.set_active_state(value, "disabled")
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 1, {ignorecameragrids = true})
	stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(1)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
end

function local_class:falldown_believers()
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 0.5
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.tentacle_swing_sfx_handle_name)

	local start_pos_list = {}
	for key,value in pairs(self.believer_list) do
		table.insert(start_pos_list, value.Position)
		character_util.spine_rotate(value, 0, fall_time)
		value.SpineController:CancelShake()
		character_util.set_active_shadow(value, false)
	end

	local start_y = self.believer_eva.Position.y

	local end_pos_list = {
		vector(-1, 0, 46),
		vector(4, 0, 47),
		vector(3, 0, 45.5),
		vector(-6, 0, 47),
		vector(5, 0, 48)
	}

	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, start_y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		for i = 1, #self.believer_list do
			local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos_list[i].x,
			end_pos_list[i].x - start_pos_list[i].x, fall_time)
			local cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()
			local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos_list[i].z,
					end_pos_list[i].z - start_pos_list[i].z, fall_time)
			character_util.set_position(self.believer_list[i], vector(cur_x, cur_y, cur_z), true)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.hit_by_land_sfx_handle_name)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.male_scream_Sfx_handle_name)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.female_scream_sfx_handle_name)
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.5)

	for i = 1, #self.believer_list do
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset_name):Instantiate(self.believer_list[i].Position)
		character_util.set_position(self.believer_list[i], end_pos_list[i])

		local dir
		if i % 2 == 1 then
			dir = "left"
		else
			dir = "right"
		end

		character_util.set_direction(self.believer_list[i], dir)
		character_util.set_anim(self.believer_list[i], {name = "prostrate"})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.believer_list[i], {name = "damaged"})
	end
end

function local_class:damaged_party()
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(self.tentacle_list[i + 1], vector(user_party[i].Position.x,
				self.tentacle_list[i + 1].Position.y, user_party[i].Position.z))
		character_util.set_active_state(self.tentacle_list[i + 1], "enabled")
		character_util.set_anim(self.tentacle_list[i + 1], {name = "attack", loop = false})
		self.tentacle_list[i + 1].SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.tentacle_swing_sfx_handle_name)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.tentacle_attack_sfx_handle_name)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local down_time = 0.5
	local start_y = -5.5
	local attach_y = -4
	local is_attach = false
	stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(down_time)
	camera_util.shake(0.7, down_time)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < down_time do
		local progress = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInSine(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, 0, 1, down_time))

		local cur_y = start_y * (1 - progress)

		for i = 1, user_party.Count do
			character_util.set_position(self.tentacle_list[i],
					vector(self.tentacle_list[i].Position.x, cur_y, self.tentacle_list[i].Position.z))
		end

		if not is_attach and cur_y > attach_y then
			is_attach = true

			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				local party_member = user_party[i]

				character_util.spine_rotate(party_member, 180, 0.5)
				character_util.set_active_shadow(party_member, false)
				character_util.set_anim(party_member, {name = "embarrassed"})
				character_util.set_emotion(party_member, {name = "damaged"})
				party_member:Shake(0.04, 9999)
				local bone_follower = party_member.UnityGameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
				bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
				bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = self.tentacle_list[i + 1].SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
				bone_follower:SetBone(self.tentacle_bone_name)

				table.insert(self.bone_follower_list, bone_follower)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.believer_eva, "right")
	character_util.set_direction(self.survive_believer, "right")
	character_util.jump(self.believer_eva, 0.7, 0.5)
	character_util.jump(self.survive_believer, 0.7, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(self.believer_eva, { name = "embarrassed"})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.believer_eva, {name = "scared"})
	character_util.set_anim(self.survive_believer, { name = "embarrassed"})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.survive_believer, {name = "scared"})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	self.believer_eva:RemoveAnimation()
	self.believer_eva:RemoveEmotion()
	self.survive_believer:RemoveAnimation()
	self.survive_believer:RemoveEmotion()
	self.boss:RemoveAnimation()

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.boss, vector(-0.5, 0, 49), 6, true, "stop",
			"floor", CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

	local tentacle_dest_list = {
		vector(-2, 0, 48),
		vector(1, 0, 48),
		vector(-2, 0, 50),
		vector(1, 0, 50)
	}

	for i = 1, user_party.Count do
		character_util.set_anim(self.tentacle_list[i], {name = "idle"})
		character_util.move_waypoint(self.tentacle_list[i], tentacle_dest_list[i], 6, true,
				"stop", "floor", CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	end

	local move_finished = false

	while not move_finished do
		move_finished = true
		if self.boss.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then

			for i = 1, user_party.Count do
				if self.tentacle_list[i].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
					move_finished = false
				end
			end
		else
			move_finished = false
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i]:CancelShake()
	end

	camera_util.move(self.believer_eva.Position, 1)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	stage_camera:SetTarget(self.believer_eva)
end

function local_class:eva_remind()
	music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.remind_bgm_handle_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event)
	self.resource_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync(self.resource_holder,
			self.eva_knight_remind_asset_path, self.eva_knight_remind_asset_name, function (prefab)
				local c = prefab
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				self.custom_atlas:Initialize()

local local_class = newclass('ChinaCatchMonkeySection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ChinaCatchMonkey @
		Comment = 원숭이 잡기 시작 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress_enum = {
		-- 초기 상태
		idle = 1,
		-- 시작 이벤트를 본 상태
		start_event = 2,
		-- 원숭이가 지정 위치에 있는 상태
		monkey_pos_1 = 3,
		monkey_pos_2 = 4,
		monkey_pos_3 = 5,
		monkey_pos_4 = 6,
		monkey_pos_5 = 7,
		-- 원숭이 잡은 상태
		catch_monkey = 8
	}

	self.current_progress = nil

	-- 원숭이가 아이템 던지는 이벤트를 봤는지
	self.seen_monkey_throw = false

	-- 원숭이 이동이 끝났는지 (원숭이가 아이템 던지는 이벤트 할 때만 필요)
	self.end_monkey_move = false

	-- 원숭이가 아이템 던지는 이벤트 하는 존에 들어왔는지
	self.monkey_throw_zone = false

	self.monkey_name = 'catch_monkey'
	self.tourist_name = 'catch_monkey_tourist'
	self.monkey_host_name = 'catch_monkey_host'
	self.monkey_pos_marker = 'runaway_monkey_'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	local monkey_host = get_character(self.monkey_host_name)
	monkey_host.Position = field:GetMarker('monkey_host_pos').position
	character_util.set_emotion(monkey_host, { name = 'tired' })
	monkey_host.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	local marker = field:GetMarker('monkey_tourist_pos').position
	local monkey = get_character(self.monkey_name)
	monkey.Position = marker + vector(2, 0, 2)
	local tourist = get_character(self.tourist_name)
	tourist.Position = marker

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local monkey = get_character(self.monkey_name)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(monkey.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		monkey.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	local monkey_host = get_character(self.monkey_host_name)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(monkey_host.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		monkey_host.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	self.progress_enum = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local monkey = get_character(self.monkey_name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, monkey) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.runaway_monkey_routine, self))
			return true
		end

		local monkey_host = get_character(self.monkey_host_name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, monkey_host) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()

				monkey_host.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

				party_util.align_to_target(monkey_host, 'down', 1, 'linear')

				-- 기사님, 혹시 제 애완 원숭이 못 보셨나요?
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(monkey_host,
					{ key = 'nightmare_china_3_catch_monkey_1', skip = true })

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
				character_util.set_anim(monkey_host, { name = 'question', loop = false })
				-- 이 근처만 오면 꼭 신나서 사라져버린다니까요!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(monkey_host,
					{ key = 'nightmare_china_3_catch_monkey_2', skip = true })

				character_util.remove_anim(monkey_host)

				-- 이 녀석이 대체 어딜 갔담…
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(monkey_host,
					{ key = 'nightmare_china_3_catch_monkey_3', skip = true })

				monkey_host.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
			end)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local zone_name =  e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'catch_monkey_start' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.start_event
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_event, self)
		return true
	end

	if zone_name == 'monkey_throw_item' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.monkey_pos_3 then
		if not self.seen_monkey_throw and not self.monkey_throw_zone then
			self.monkey_throw_zone = true
			-- 원숭이가 아이템 던지는 이벤트
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()

				-- 원숭이 이동이 끝나기를 기다림
				while not self.end_monkey_move do
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				self.seen_monkey_throw = true

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_monkey_laugh_01')
				local monkey = get_character(self.monkey_name)
				local marker = field:GetMarker('monkey_treasure_pos').position
				local monkey_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = monkey.Position,
																 target = marker + vector(0.2, 0, 0.2),
																 itemid = 9110213, notforinven = true,
																 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true})

				monkey_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.one
				monkey_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.one
			end))
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

	local tourist_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = tourist.Position,
													  target = tourist.Position + 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.right,
													  itemid = 9110213, notforinven = true,

	tourist_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.one
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.set_anim(monkey, { name = 'hold_loop' })

	local start_pos = tourist_item.Position
	local end_pos = tourist_item.Position + 0.8 * unity_class.vector3.up

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		tourist_item.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time_passed / duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

-- 플레이어가 상호작용한 방향에 따라 도망가는 원숭이 루틴
function local_class:runaway_monkey_routine()
	local monkey = get_character(self.monkey_name)
	monkey.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	monkey.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 플레이어가 상호작용한 위치
	local leader_dir = vector_util.to_direction(user_party_leader.Position - monkey.Position)
	-- 상호작용 했을 때 이동할 위치 마커 index
	local move_next_pos = self.current_progress
	-- 원숭이 이동 경로
	local monkey_waypoint
	-- 원숭이 이동 스피드
	local monkey_speed = 11

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(monkey)
	monkey.Direction = leader_dir
	character_util.normal_jump_async(monkey, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 1번 위치일 때
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.start_event then
		monkey_waypoint = {
			monkey.Position + vector(-14, 0, 0),
			monkey.Position + vector(-14, 0, 15)
		}

	-- 2번 위치일 때
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.monkey_pos_1 then
		if leader_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			monkey_waypoint = {
				monkey.Position + vector(0, 0, 11.5),
				monkey.Position + vector(23.5, 0, 11.5)
			}
		else
			monkey_waypoint = {
				monkey.Position + vector(0, 0, -9),
				monkey.Position + vector(26.5, 0, -9)
			}
		end

	-- 3번 위치일 때
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.monkey_pos_2 then
		if leader_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			monkey_waypoint = {
				monkey.Position + vector(0, 0, -10),
				monkey.Position + vector(-2, 0, -10),
				monkey.Position + vector(-2, 0, -14)
			}
		else
			monkey_waypoint = monkey.Position + 20 * unity_class.vector3.forward

			move_next_pos = move_next_pos - 2
		end

	-- 4번 위치일 때
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.monkey_pos_3 then
		if leader_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			monkey_waypoint = {
				monkey.Position + vector(4, 0, 0),
				monkey.Position + vector(4, 0, 4)
			}
		else
			monkey_waypoint = {
				monkey.Position + vector(0, 0, 4),
				monkey.Position + vector(2, 0, 4),
				monkey.Position + vector(2, 0, 14)
			}

			move_next_pos = move_next_pos - 2
		end

	-- 5번 위치일 때
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.monkey_pos_4 then
		if leader_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			monkey_waypoint = monkey.Position + 7 * unity_class.vector3.right
		else
			monkey_waypoint = {
				monkey.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0),
				monkey.Position + vector(-4, 0, -4)
			}

			move_next_pos = move_next_pos - 2
		end
	end

	self.current_progress = move_next_pos + 1

	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_05' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async( monkey, monkey_waypoint, monkey_speed, true)

	dash_sfx:FadeOut(0.5)

	monkey.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.monkey_pos_marker .. move_next_pos).position
	monkey.Position = marker

	character_util.set_direction(monkey, 'right')

	character_util.set_anim(monkey, { name = 'eat' })

	-- 원숭이가 아이템 던지는 이벤트를 봤는지에 따른 처리
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.monkey_pos_3 and not self.seen_monkey_throw then
		character_util.set_direction(monkey, 'left')
		character_util.remove_anim(monkey)
		character_util.set_anim(monkey, { name = 'victory_extra' })
		character_util.set_emotion(monkey, { name = 'smile' })

		self.end_monkey_move = true
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 주인 옆까지 이동했는지에 따른 처리
	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress_enum.monkey_pos_5 then
		monkey.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	else
		character_util.remove_anim(monkey)
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	end
end

return local_class

    self.prisonGuard = nil
    self.isFight = false
    self.keyId = 30020
    self.battlegateName = "prison_event_battlegate_1"
end

function local_class:enter()
    self.prisonGuard = get_character("prison_guard")

    -- 전투 종료되서 이미 아이템은 획득했는데, 퀘스트 섹션이 진행되지 않은 경우 섹션 넘겨줌
    if user:HasItem(self.keyId) then
        character_util.set_active_state(self.prisonGuard, 'disabled')

        return false
    else
        message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
        message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')
        message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

        return true
    end
end

function local_class:start()
    quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.prisonGuard)

    ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO("china_prison_escape", self.quest_spec.QuestId,
            self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.prisonGuard)
end

function local_class:exit()
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_progress = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil
    self.prisonGuard = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
        if e.FullEnter and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader and e.Zone.Name == "china_prison" then
            if not self.isFight then
                coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_prison, self))
            end
        end
    end

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
        if e.Item.ItemId == self.keyId then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_key, self))
        end
    end

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
        if e.BattleGroupName == 'prison_guard' then
            message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battlegateName))
            quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
        end
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:enter_prison()
    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.prisonGuard)

    for i=0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        character_util.stop(user_party[i])
    end

    coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:enter_prison())

    local waitForBranch = true
    local goBack = false

    local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString("china_prison_escape_talk_branch_0"),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
        Callback = function()
            goBack = true
            waitForBranch = false
        end})
    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString("china_prison_escape_talk_branch_1"),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
        Callback = function()
            waitForBranch = false
        end
    })

    local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
    choice_state.Branchs = branches
    choice_state.Talker = self.prisonGuard
    ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

    while waitForBranch do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    if goBack then
        coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:go_back())
    else
        self.isFight = true
        coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:fight_with_guard())
        character_util.convert_to_monster(self.prisonGuard, "prison_guard")
        self.prisonGuard.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.AirSpin

        command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.prisonGuard, user_party_leader, "battle")

        message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegateName))
        message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))
        ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("china_prison_escape")

        quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString("china_prison_escape_tracker_0"))
    end

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:get_key()
    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    for i=0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        character_util.stop(user_party[i])
    end

    local item_place_holder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
    item_place_holder.ItemId = self.keyId

    coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent(item_place_holder, "china_prison_escape_key_subtitle",
            "china_prison_escape_key_description"))

    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))

    coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_section(self.controller))

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

function local_class:start()

    ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("china_prison_escape")
    quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

    quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.sapaDosa)
    ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO("china_prison_escape", self.quest_spec.QuestId,
            self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.sapaDosa)

    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

    self.quest_progress = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil
    self.sapaDosa = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
        if e.FullEnter and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader and e.Zone.Name == self.introZoneName then
            if not self.seeIntro then
                self.seeIntro = true
                coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.intro_event, self))
            end
        end
    end

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if e.Target == self.sapaDosa then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_sapa_dosa, self))
        end
    end

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent) then
        if e.DoorHandleName == self.keyDoorName then
            quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
            quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString("china_prison_escape_tracker_2"))
        end
    end

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
        if e.BattleGroupName == 'sapa_dosa' then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending, self))
        end
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:drop_costume()
    local player = user_party_leader

    music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_throw_01")

    drop_item_util.create_item(
            { pos = self.sapaDosa.Position, target = player.Position,
              itemid = self.sapaCostumeId, notforinven = true})

    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
    character_util.set_direction(player, "down")

    local item_place_holder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
    item_place_holder.ItemId = self.sapaCostumeId

    coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent(item_place_holder, "china_prison_escape_sapa_costume_subtitle",
            "china_prison_escape_sapa_costume_description"))

    character_util.set_direction(player, "up")
end

function local_class:intro_event()
    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    for i=0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        character_util.stop(user_party[i])
    end

    coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:intro_sapa_dosa())

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:talk_with_sapa_dosa()
    ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("china_prison_escape")
    quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.sapaDosa)
    character_util.align_party(self.sapaDosa, "down")

    coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:talk_with_dosa())

    local waitForBranch = true
    local isRelease = false

    local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString("china_prison_escape_talk_branch_2"),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
        Callback = function()
            isRelease = true
            waitForBranch = false
        end})
    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString("china_prison_escape_talk_branch_3"),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
        Callback = function()
            waitForBranch = false
        end
    })

    local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
    choice_state.Branchs = branches
    choice_state.Talker = self.sapaDosa
    ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

    while waitForBranch do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    if isRelease then
        coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:release())
        character_util.set_active_state(self.sapaDosa, "disabled")

        character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "right")

        local undisplayReward = {}
        table.insert(undisplayReward, self.sapaCostumeId)
        coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller,
                2,true, true, true, true, undisplayReward ))
    else
        coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:fight_with_dosa())

        character_util.convert_to_monster(self.sapaDosa, "sapa_dosa")
        self.sapaDosa.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.AirSpin

        command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.sapaDosa, user_party_leader, "battle")

        message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegateName))
        message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))
        ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("china_prison_escape")
        quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

        quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString("china_prison_escape_tracker_3"))
    end

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:ending()
    ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("china_prison_escape")
    quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battlegateName))

    local player = user_party_leader

    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    character_util.set_direction(player, "right")

    for i=0, user_party.Count - 1 do
        character_util.stop(user_party[i])
    end

    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))

    local undisplayReward = {}
    table.insert(undisplayReward, self.sapaCostumeId)
    coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller,
            0,true, true, true, true, undisplayReward ))

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

		return self:on_interact_event(e)

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local bad_kid_1 = self.get_bad_kid(1)
	local nari = self.get_nari()

	local giftbox_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	for i = 1, 20 do
		giftbox_list:Add(self.get_giftbox(i))
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bad_kid_1) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.bad_kid_interact, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, nari) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.nari_interact, self)
	end

	for i = 0, giftbox_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, giftbox_list[i]) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.giftbox_narration, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.Zone.Name == self.revolution_zone_name and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
			self.current_revolution_state == self.revolution_states.revolution_kid then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.revolution_ending, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and
			not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then return false end

	local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name

	if grid_name == self.revolution_grid_name and not self.is_in_revolution_camera_grid and
			self.current_revolution_state == self.revolution_states.revolution_kid then
		self.is_in_revolution_camera_grid = true

		field:Tint('revolution_tint', unity_color({ 0.4, 0.2, 0.2, 1 }), 0.2)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and
			not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then return false end

	local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name

	if grid_name == self.revolution_grid_name and self.is_in_revolution_camera_grid and
			self.current_revolution_state == self.revolution_states.revolution_kid then
		self.is_in_revolution_camera_grid = false

		field:RemoveTint('revolution_tint', 0.2)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 1 then
		if e.Params[0] == self.enter_section_5 then
			self.current_revolution_state = self.revolution_states.talk_kid

			for i = 1, 20 do

-- 선물 들고 이동하는 연출
function local_class:hold_gift_and_move(kid, gift)
	character_util.move_to_async(kid, vector(kid.Position.x, 0, gift.Position.z),
			nil, 3, true, true)

	local left = false

	if gift.Position.x < kid.Position.x then
		left = true

		character_util.move_to_async(kid, vector(gift.Position.x + 1, 0, gift.Position.z),
				nil, 3, true, true)
	else

				nil, 3, true, true)
