-- 카메라 줌 인
function local_class:camera_zoom_in()
	local start_size = 6
	local end_size = 2
	local duration = 4

	local heavenhold_camera = self.heavenhold_obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	heavenhold_camera.orthographicSize = 6

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration

		if heavenhold_camera ~= nil then
			heavenhold_camera.orthographicSize = start_size + (end_size - start_size) * normalized
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 메이든 이동 처리
function local_class:move_maiden()
	local maiden = get_character(self.maiden_name)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.move_to_async(maiden, maiden.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			nil, 2, true, true)

	character_util.set_direction(maiden, 'up')
end

-- 카메라 셰이크
function local_class:camera_shake(tavern_root, magnitude, duration)
	local tavern_camera = tavern_root.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))

	local start_pos = tavern_camera.transform.localPosition

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)
		local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)

		tavern_camera.transform.localPosition = start_pos + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	tavern_camera.transform.localPosition = start_pos
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.heavenhold_obj ~= nil then
		self.heavenhold_theatre = nil

		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.heavenhold_obj)
	end

	if self.heavenhold_christmas ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.heavenhold_christmas)
	end

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ChristmasMainSection11')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ChristmasMain @
		Comment = 격납고에 들어가서 산타의 썰매를 찾아내는 일행 @
		Index = 10 @
		NextSections = 11 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = "xm_1_3"

	-- 루돌프
	self.rue = nil

	-- 공주
	self.princess = nil

	-- 격납고
	self.hangar = nil

	-- 썰매
	self.slide = nil

	-- 리소스 홀더
	self.resholder = nil

	-- 스포트라이트 이펙트
	self.spotlight_effect = nil

	-- 탑승 연출 완료 체크
	self.ride_on_slide = 0

	-- 격납고 내부에 있는지 확인하는 플래그
	self.is_in_hangar = false

	-- 메인 이벤트 발생 플래그
	self.see_main_event = false

	-- 공주 이동 연출 플래그
	self.is_move_princess = false

	-- NPC 이름
	self.rue_name = 'rue'
	self.princess_name = 'princess'
	self.ancient_santa_name = 'ancient_santa_hangar'

	-- 필드오브젝트 이름
	self.hangar_name = 'mainquest_hangar'
	self.slide_name = 'slide'

	-- 타일맵 존 이름
	self.hangar_zone_name = 'mainquest_hangar_zone'
	self.hangar_event_zone_name = 'section_11_hangar'

	-- 틴트 키
	self.tint_key = 'christmas_main'

	-- 퀘스트 마커, 트래커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'christmas_main'
	self.quest_tracker_name = 'christmas_main_s11_tracker_0'
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 이 섹션에서 스테이지 4에 입장한 경우, 퀘스트와 스테이지 싱크가 맞지 않는 문제를 해결하기 위해 섹션 자동으로 넘김
	if stage.Name == 'xm_1_4' then
		return false
	end

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	self.rue = get_character(self.rue_name)

	self.princess = get_character(self.princess_name)

	self.hangar = get_field_object(self.hangar_name)

	self.slide = get_field_object(self.slide_name)
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.rue, user_party, true)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.princess, user_party, true)

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.hangar.Position + vector(2.5, 2, 0))
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.rue = nil
	self.princess = nil

	self.hangar = nil
	self.slide = nil

	if self.spotlight_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.spotlight_effect)
		self.spotlight_effect = nil
	end

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.hangar_zone_name and not self.is_in_hangar then
		self.is_in_hangar = true

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_intro_shivermore_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(29.5, 0, 95.5))

		field:Tint(self.tint_key, CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1), 0)
	elseif zone_name == self.hangar_event_zone_name and not self.see_main_event then
		self.see_main_event = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.take_off, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end

	if e.Zone.Name == self.hangar_zone_name and self.is_in_hangar then
		self.is_in_hangar = false

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.hangar.Position + vector(2.5, 2, 0))

		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key)
	end

	return true
end

-- 공주가 신나서 썰매 옆을 뛰어다니며 이동하는 연출
function local_class:princess_move()
	self.is_move_princess = true

	while self.is_move_princess do
		local princess_waypoint = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		princess_waypoint:Add(self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5))

		character_util.set_anim(self.princess, { name = 'walk' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(self.princess, princess_waypoint,
				1, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		local wait_duration = 0.5

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.is_move_princess then
			break
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(self.princess)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		wait_duration = 0.5

		while self.is_move_princess and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.is_move_princess then
			break
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.jump(self.princess, 0.5, 0.3)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		wait_duration = 0.3

		while self.is_move_princess and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.is_move_princess then
			break
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.jump(self.princess, 0.5, 0.3)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		wait_duration = 1.3

		while self.is_move_princess and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.is_move_princess then
			break
		end

		princess_waypoint:Clear()
		princess_waypoint:Add(self.princess.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0))
		princess_waypoint:Add(self.princess.Position + vector(-2, 0, 1.5))

		character_util.move_waypoint(self.princess, princess_waypoint,
				3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		wait_duration = 1.3

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.is_move_princess then
			break
		end

		character_util.set_anim(self.princess, { name = 'sing' })

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		wait_duration = 2

		while self.is_move_princess and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.is_move_princess then
			break
		end

		princess_waypoint:Clear()
		princess_waypoint:Add(self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0, 2))
		princess_waypoint:Add(self.princess.Position + vector(6, 0, 2))
		princess_waypoint:Add(self.princess.Position + vector(6, 0, 0))

		character_util.set_anim(self.princess, { name = 'run' })
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.princess)
		character_util.move_waypoint(self.princess, princess_waypoint,
				6, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left', true)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		wait_duration = 1.7

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.is_move_princess then
			break
		end

		character_util.set_anim(self.princess, { name = 'victory_extra' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.princess, { name = 'awesome' })

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		wait_duration = 2

		while self.is_move_princess and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.is_move_princess then
			break
		end

		princess_waypoint:Clear()
		princess_waypoint:Add(self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0, -3))
		princess_waypoint:Add(self.princess.Position + vector(-4, 0, -3))
		princess_waypoint:Add(self.princess.Position + vector(-4, 0, -2))

		character_util.set_anim(self.princess, { name = 'run' })
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.princess)
		character_util.move_waypoint(self.princess, princess_waypoint,
				6, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up', true)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		wait_duration = 1.4

		while self.is_move_princess and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.is_move_princess then
			break
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(self.princess)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		wait_duration = 1

		while self.is_move_princess and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.is_move_princess then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.princess)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.princess)
end

		local rudolph = self.get_rudolph()

	local first_switch = self.get_first_switch()

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointOpenedEvent), 'on_waypoint_opened_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 15 then
		self.controller:set_rudolph_manual()
		self.controller:set_stage_5_monster_info()
	end

	self.controller:stop_tint_in_out_routine()

	for i = 1, 15 do
		self.block_pos_list[i] = self.get_broken(i).Position + vector(24, 0, -15)
	end

	for i = 16, 30 do
		self.block_pos_list[i] = self.get_broken(i).Position + vector(30, 0, -21)
	end

	self.get_sled().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self:set_battle_info()
	self:reset_battle(self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 15)
	character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, true)

	local sled_2 = self.get_sled_2()
	local effect_object = sled_2.transform:GetChild(0)
	effect_object.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.get_princess().Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.get_princess())

	self.get_fx_wind():Instantiate(sled_2.Position)

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.after_battle_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointOpenedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self.get_sled().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.rockslide_info_list = nil
	self.block_pos_list = nil
	self.battle_state = nil
	self.battle_info_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return false end

	-- 이미 시간이 5초 이하로 남아 있을 때 그냥 이벤트 발동 없이 지나가도록
	if e.Zone.Name == 'broken_block_scene' and not self.is_seen_broken_block_scene and self.timer_alarm_count == 0 then
		self.is_seen_broken_block_scene = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.broken_block_scene, self))
		return true

	elseif self.rockslide_info_list[e.Zone.Name] ~= nil
			and self.rockslide_info_list[e.Zone.Name].active == false and self.first_scene_done then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_rockslides, self, e.Zone.Name))
		return true

	elseif self.battle_info_list[e.Zone.Name] ~= nil
			and (self.battle_info_list[e.Zone.Name].state == self.battle_state.none
			or self.battle_info_list[e.Zone.Name].state == self.battle_state.reactive) then
		self:start_battle(e.Zone.Name)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.battle_info_list[e.BattleGroupName] ~= nil then
		self:end_battle(e.BattleGroupName)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_sled()) then
		self.escape_success = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.escape_scene, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm_event(e)
	if e.TimerId == CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer then
		if e.IsComplete == true and self.escape_fail_scene_active == false then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.escape_fail, self)
			return true
		elseif e.IsComplete == false then
			self.timer_alarm_count = self.timer_alarm_count + 1
			if self.is_seen_broken_block_scene and self.timer_alarm_count == 2 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.after_block_waiting, self))
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_bomb()) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.after_destroy_remains, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_waypoint_opened_event(e)
	self:pause_timer()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_healing_routine, self))

	return true
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local info = e.Info

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(info.target, user_party.Leader) and self.escape_fail_scene_active == false then
		if e.HpBefore - info:GetTotalDamage() < 1 then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.escape_fail, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:escape_fail()
	self.escape_fail_scene_active = true
	self:stop_timer()

	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i].CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

		if i > 0 then
			user_party[i].FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
		end

		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = 'embarrassed'})
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = 'scared'})
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 2, nil, 'escape_fail')
	camera_util.resize_to(2.5, 2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_break_rock_earthquake_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.sfx_siren:FadeOut(1.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = nil
		heal_info.target = user_party[i]
		heal_info.heal = user_party[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP

		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

		if i > 0 then
			user_party[i].FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
		end
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	for key, info in pairs(self.battle_info_list) do
		for j = 1, info.gate_count do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(info.gate_key .. j, false))
		end

		if info.state == self.battle_state.done then
			self.battle_info_list[key].state = self.battle_state.reactive
		elseif info.state == self.battle_state.none_play then
			self.battle_info_list[key].state = self.battle_state.none
		elseif info.state == self.battle_state.reactive_play then
			self.battle_info_list[key].state = self.battle_state.reactive
		end
	end

	self:reset_battle(true)

	party_util.position_party(vector(28.5, 0, 0.5), 'right', 'linear')

	self.timer_alarm_count = 0

	for i = 1, 12 do
		local block = self.get_broken(i)
		block.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.sfx_siren = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '01_siren_loop_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc',
			 fade_in_time = 1.5})

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:start_timer()

	self.escape_fail_scene_active = false
end

function local_class:start_timer()
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.EventTimer)

	local game_timer = CS.Oak.InGameTimer.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, self.time_limit, { self.time_limit - 5, self.time_limit - 2 })
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAddEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, game_timer))
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_global_timer_alarm_event')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStartEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, true))
end

function local_class:pause_timer()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRequestPauseEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
end

function local_class:resume_timer()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRequestResumeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
end

function local_class:stop_timer()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRemoveEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStopEvent.Instance)
end

function local_class:check_healing_routine()
	while true do
		local current_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
		if current_state ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:resume_timer()
end

function local_class:show_rockslides(room_name)
	local info = self.rockslide_info_list[room_name]
	local center_pos = field:GetZone(room_name).Bounds.center

	local time_passed = 0
	local active_count = 0
	local active_list = {}

	for i = 1, #info.effects do
		active_list[i] = false
	end

	self.rockslide_info_list[room_name].active = true

	while active_count < #info.effects do
		for index, effect_info in pairs(info.effects) do
			if effect_info.delay <= time_passed and active_list[index] == false then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_rock_break_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
				local effect = self.get_fx_landslide():Instantiate(center_pos + effect_info.pos_dif)
				effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.6
				active_list[index] = true
				active_count = active_count + 1
			end
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

end

function local_class:set_battle_info()
	for key, info in pairs(self.battle_info_list) do
		-- 이번 섹션에서 시작한 게 아니라면 재전투 상황임
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 15 then
			self.battle_info_list[key].state = self.battle_state.reactive
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_battle(battle_name)
	local info = self.battle_info_list[battle_name]

	if info.state == self.battle_state.reactive then
		for i = 1, info.gate_count do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(info.gate_key .. i))
		end
		self.battle_info_list[battle_name].state = self.battle_state.reactive_play
	elseif info.state == self.battle_state.none then
		self.battle_info_list[battle_name].state = self.battle_state.none_play
	end

	for i = 1, info.max_count do
		local monster = self.get_monster(info.index, i)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(monster, 'none')
		monster.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end
end

function local_class:end_battle(battle_name)
	local info = self.battle_info_list[battle_name]

	if info.state == self.battle_state.reactive_play then
		for i = 1, info.gate_count do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(info.gate_key .. i))
		end
	end

	self.battle_info_list[battle_name].state = self.battle_state.done
end

function local_class:reset_battle(revive)
	for battle_name, info in pairs(self.battle_info_list) do
		for i = 1, info.max_count do
			local monster_dir = character_util.get_direction(info.dir.backward)

			local monster = self.get_monster(info.index, i)

			if revive then
				local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
				heal_info.sender = monster
				heal_info.target = monster
				heal_info.heal = monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
				heal_info.isRevive = true
				command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
			end

			monster.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
			monster.Position = self.controller.stage_5_monster_info_table[battle_name].pos_list[i]
			monster.Direction = monster_dir
			monster.LockedDirection = monster_dir

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(monster)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:broken_block_scene()
	local santa = self.get_santa()
	local rudolph = self.get_rudolph()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	--입구 근처 존에 들어가면, 거대한 물체가 하늘에서 떨어지며 일행의 앞을 가로막는다.
	local remains_info = {}
	local delay_list = {
		-- 앞쪽
		0.1,
		0,
		0.1,
		0.2,
		0.3,
		0.1,
		0.4,
		0.2,
		0.1,
		0.3,
		0,
		0.3,
		0.3,
		0.2,
		0.4,

		-- 뒤쪽
		0.1,
		0,
		0.1,
		0.2,
		0.3,
		0.1,
		0.4,
		0.2,
		0.1,
		0.3,
		0,
		0.3,
		0.3,
		0.2,
		0.4,
	}

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_height = 8
	local fall_time = 0.5
	local duration = 0.6 + fall_time
	local height_func = function(progress)
		return start_height * math.cos(math.pi / 2 * progress)
	end

	for i = 1, #delay_list do
		remains_info[i] = {
			delay = delay_list[i]
		}
		remains_info[i].fo = self.get_broken(i)
		remains_info[i].target_pos = self.block_pos_list[i]
		remains_info[i].fo.Position = remains_info[i].target_pos + vector(0, 8, 0)
		remains_info[i].done = false
		remains_info[i].fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0.89, 0.5), vector(1, 9, 1))

		remains_info[i].fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')

	while time_passed <= duration do
		for i, info in pairs(remains_info) do
			if time_passed >= info.delay and time_passed <= info.delay + fall_time then
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((time_passed - info.delay) / fall_time)
				info.fo.Position = info.target_pos + vector(0, height_func(progress), 0)
			elseif time_passed > info.delay + fall_time and not info.done then
				remains_info[i].done = true
				music_player_util.play_sfx(
						{sfx_name = '03_rock_break_01', parent = info.fo,
						 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object'})

				info.fo.Position = info.target_pos
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1, nil, 'remains_' .. i)
				local smoke_effect = self.get_fx_smokescreen():Instantiate(info.target_pos)
				smoke_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
			end
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--그 때, 거대한 물체에 폭탄이 떨어지고,
end

function local_class:float_rudolph()
	local rudolph = self.get_rudolph()
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local float_duration = 9

	local start_pos = rudolph.Position
	local start_cam_pos = vector(-84.25, 2, 8)
	local end_pos = rudolph.Position + vector(0, 20.5, 0)
	local end_cam_pos = vector(-84.25, 2, 8) + vector(0, 20.5, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < float_duration do
		local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutCubic(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.y, end_pos.y - start_pos.y, float_duration)

		local cur_cam_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutCubic(
			unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_cam_pos.y, end_cam_pos.y - start_cam_pos.y, float_duration)

		character_util.set_position(rudolph, vector(start_pos.x, cur_y, start_pos.z), true)
		camera_util.move(vector(start_cam_pos.x, cur_cam_y, start_cam_pos.z), 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(rudolph, end_pos)

	wait_for_sec(1)
end

		Comment = 가디언에게 선물을 주는 산타 공주 @
		Index = 17 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'xm_1_6'

	-- 아이템 스펙 이름
	self.paper_piece_item_spec_name = 'paper_piece'

	-- 문 이름
	self.door_name = 'door'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_knight = function()
		if user_util.has_knight_male() then
			return get_character('knight_male')
		end

		return get_character('knight_female')
	end
	self.get_princess = function() return get_character('princess') end

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_princess_gift_chest = function() return get_field_object('princess_gift_chest') end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_bed_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('bed') end
	self.get_front_bed_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('front_bed') end
	self.get_chest_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('chest') end
	self.get_paper_piece_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('paper_piece') end

	-- 이펙트 오브젝트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_dead_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead') end

	-- 아이템
	self.paper_piece_item = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	local princess_gift_chest = self.get_princess_gift_chest()
	if not princess_gift_chest.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self)
	else
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.normal_start, self)
	end

end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.paper_piece_item ~= nil then
		self.paper_piece_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.paper_piece_item = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TreasureOpenedEvent) then
		return self:on_tresure_opened_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		return self:on_item_get_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_tresure_opened_event(e)
	local princess_gift_chest = self.get_princess_gift_chest()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, princess_gift_chest) then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_name), false)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if e.Getter == user_party.Leader then
		local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
		local paper_piece_item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.paper_piece_item_spec_name).Id

		if e.Item.ItemId == paper_piece_item_id then
			self.paper_piece_item = nil
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_paper_piece_item, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

	local front_bed_marker = self.get_front_bed_marker()

-- 상자가 점점 커지는 연출
function local_class:chest_scale_big(chest, position_offset, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local chest_position = chest.Position

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local position = chest_position + unity_class.vector3.Lerp(position_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero, progress)

		chest.Transform.localScale = vector(progress, progress, progress)
		chest.Position = position

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	chest.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	chest.Position = chest_position
end

-- 상자가 통통 튀는 연출
function local_class:chest_free_fall(chest)
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, 16, 2, 4, nil)

	while true do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		if free_fall:IsDone() then
			break
		end

		local y = free_fall:GetDistance()
		chest.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(chest.Position, y)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	chest.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(chest.Position, 0)
end

return local_class

	self.bottom_zone_name = 'section_2_president_office_bottom'
	self.strike_off_3_name = 'strike_off_3'

	self.quest_marker_name = 'christmas_main'
	self.quest_tracker_name = 'christmas_main_s2_tracker_0'

	-- 커스텀 이벤트 이름
	self.activate_snow_custom_event = 'activate_snow'

	--조건수 체크용 변
	self.surprise = false
	self.surprising = false
	self.shout = false
	self.shouting = false

	self.throw = false
	self.box_interact = false

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	self.santa = get_character(self.santa_name)
	character_util.set_position(self.santa, field:GetMarker('hidden_path_santa').position)
	character_util.set_direction(self.santa, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.santa, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.santa, { name = 'tired' })

	self.hidden_path_box = get_field_object('new_box')
	self.hidden_path_box.Position = self.hidden_path_box.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)

	for i = 1, self.gatekeeper_num do
		local cur_elf = get_character(self.gatekeeper_name..i)
		character_util.set_emotion(cur_elf, { name = 'attack' })
	end

	local invader = get_character(self.invader_name)
	character_util.set_position(invader, vector(8.8, 1, 51.7))
	character_util.set_direction(invader, 'left')
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			vector(21.5, 0, 134.5))
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.intro_event, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.santa = nil

	self.square_npc_list = nil

	-- 동적 로딩한 캐릭터들 전부 제거
	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil and self.controller.experimental_destroy_character then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.princess_zone_name and self.current_event_progress < self.event_progress.see_princess_event then
		self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.see_princess_event

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.princess_run, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_zone_name and self.current_event_progress < self.event_progress.see_battle_event then
		self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.see_battle_event

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(get_character(self.elf_monster_name), { key = 'christmas_main_s2_1' })
	--elseif zone_name == self.president_office_event_zone_name and
	--		self.current_event_progress < self.event_progress.see_president_office_event then
	--	self.current_event_progress = self.event_progress.see_president_office_event
	--
	--	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.president_office_event, self)

	elseif zone_name == self.bottom_zone_name and not self.surprising then
		self.surprise = true
		self.throw = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_food, self))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.santa_surprise, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.strike_off_3_name and not self.shouting then
		self.shout = true
		self.throw = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.strike_off, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	if not e.FullLeave then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
	if zone_name == self.bottom_zone_name then
		self.surprise = false
		self.throw = false
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.santa)
	elseif zone_name == self.strike_off_3_name then
		self.shout = false
		self.throw = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hidden_path_box) then
		self.box_interact = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_box, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'elf_shout' then
		if e:GetParamAt(1) == 'stop' then
			self.shout = false
		elseif e:GetParamAt(1) == 'start' then
			self.shout = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.elf_shout, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:santa_surprise()

		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', parent = self.santa })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.santa, { key = 'christmas_main_s2_' .. idx % 3 + 1 .. '_new',

		character_util.set_emotion(self.santa, {name = 'scared'})

	local food_id = { 20048, 20081, 20014 }
	local idx = 0
	while self.throw do
		idx = idx + 1
		local time = unity_class.random.Range(0.1, 0.5)
		local random_elf = get_character(self.gatekeeper_name .. random_util.get_random_int(1, 6))

		local rand_x_offset = unity_class.random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)
		local rand_z_offset = unity_class.random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,

						self.santa.Position + vector(0.5 + rand_x_offset, 0, 2.5 + rand_z_offset), food_id[idx % 3 + 1]))

		wait_for_sec(time)
	end
end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 명중에 성공했을 경우 실행

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 1

	local custom_sprite = rock.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local custom_alpha = 1

	local shadow_sprite = rock.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local shadow_alpha = shadow_sprite.Alpha

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local alpha_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01( 1 - (time_passed / duration))

		local res = custom_alpha * alpha_progress
		custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({res, res, res, res})
		custom_sprite.Alpha = custom_alpha * alpha_progress
		shadow_sprite.Alpha = shadow_alpha * alpha_progress

		custom_sprite:Rebuild()
		shadow_sprite:Rebuild()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	rock:ConsumeComplete()
end

function local_class:elf_shout()

	self.shouting = true
	while self.shout do

		if not self.shout then
			break
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_shout_07', parent = elf })
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(elf, { key = 'christmas_main_s2_' .. idx % 3 + 1 .. '_new',
																  bubble_type = 'shout' })
		idx = idx + 1

		if not self.box_interact and idx >= 2 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_box_01', parent = self.hidden_path_box })
			self.hidden_path_box:Shake(0.1, 0.5)
			if not change_interactable then

				self.hidden_path_box.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end
	self.shouting = false
end

function local_class:strike_off()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_food, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.elf_shout, self))

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hidden_path_box, { key = 'christmas_main_s2_5_new', skip = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hidden_path_box, { key = 'christmas_main_s2_6_new', skip = true })

	local duration = 1
	local start_pos = self.hidden_path_box.Position

	self.hidden_path_box:Shake(0.05, 1)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.shout = false

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

function local_class:dispose()

	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	self.santa = get_character(self.santa_name)
	self.santa.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.ru = get_character(self.ru_name)
	self.ru:HideWeapon(false)

	self.santa_desk = get_field_object(self.santa_desk_name)
	--self.santa_desk.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		--character_util.set_position(self.santa, vector(24, 0.5, 134.5))
		character_util.set_position(self.santa, vector(21.5, 0, 134.5))
		character_util.set_direction(self.santa, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(self.santa, { name = 'scared' })

		character_util.set_direction(self.ru, 'up')

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	-- 루돌프는 플레이어 파티에 편입
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 2 then
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.ru, user_party, true)
	elseif self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 2 then
		self.shout = true
		self.throw = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.strike_off, self))
	end

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.santa)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))

	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.santa)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.santa.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.santa = nil

	self.ru = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
	if zone_name == self.strike_off_3_name and not self.shouting then
		self.shout = true
		self.throw = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.strike_off, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	if not e.FullLeave then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
	if zone_name == self.strike_off_3_name then
		self.shout = false
		self.throw = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.santa) then --or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.santa_desk) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_santa, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'elf_shout' then
		if e:GetParamAt(1) == 'stop' then
			self.shout = false
		elseif e:GetParamAt(1) == 'start' then
			self.shout = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.elf_shout, self))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:throw_rock_to_target(thrower, target_pos, food_id)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	--character_util.look_at(thrower, target)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	local rock = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = food_id, notforinven = true, pos = thrower.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			  target = target_pos + vector(0, 1, 0), lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7, showoncharacter = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(thrower)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 명중에 성공했을 경우 실행

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 1

	local custom_sprite = rock.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local custom_alpha = 1

	local shadow_sprite = rock.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local shadow_alpha = shadow_sprite.Alpha

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local alpha_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01( 1 - (time_passed / duration))

		local res = custom_alpha * alpha_progress
		custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({res, res, res, res})
		custom_sprite.Alpha = custom_alpha * alpha_progress
		shadow_sprite.Alpha = shadow_alpha * alpha_progress

		custom_sprite:Rebuild()
		shadow_sprite:Rebuild()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	rock:ConsumeComplete()
end

		self:on_interact_event(e)

	if not e.FullEnter then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.violent_elf_event_zone_name and
			self.violent_clue_current_state < self.violent_clue_state.see_violent_elf_event then
		self.violent_clue_current_state = self.violent_clue_state.see_violent_elf_event

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.violent_elf_event, self))

			self.violent_clue_current_state < self.violent_clue_state.ending then
		self.violent_clue_current_state = self.violent_clue_state.ending

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.invader_event, self)
	end

-- 일정 거리 이동 후 뒤돌아서 확인하고 다시 도는 루틴
function local_class:watch_pattern(pos)
	-- 섹션 종료 시 코루틴이 self 변수에 접근하면 NullReference 발생하므로 여기서 중단
	if self.elf_bat == nil then
		return
	end

	character_util.move_to_async(self.elf_bat, pos, nil, 3, true, true)

	while self.elf_bat ~= nil and not self:check_character_in_camera(self.elf_bat) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.elf_bat == nil then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.elf_bat, 'left')

	-- 시야 범위 보여줌
	self:show_attack_range(self.elf_bat)

	-- 일정 시간 확인 후 다시 이동
	local timer = 0
	local wait_duration = 2.5

	local in_sight = false

	while timer < wait_duration and self.elf_bat ~= nil do
		-- 플레이어가 시야 내에 들어오면 ! 띄우면서 멈추고 대기
		if self:is_in_sight(self.elf_bat, user_party_leader, self.sight_distance, self.sight_angle) then
			if not in_sight then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

				in_sight = true
				timer = 0

				character_util.show_emoticon(self.elf_bat, nil, 'notice')
			end
		else
			in_sight = false

			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:hide_attack_range()
end

-- 카메라 화면에 해당 캐릭터가 잡혔는지 확인, y축은 무시함
function local_class:check_character_in_camera(character)
	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth

	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	if character.Position.x < camera_pos.x + cam_half_width and
			character.Position.x > camera_pos.x - cam_half_width and
			character.Position.z < camera_pos.z + cam_half_height and
			character.Position.z > camera_pos.z - cam_half_height then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- A의 시야에 B가 들어왔는지 확인, y축은 무시함
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target, distance, angle)
	if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	local full_diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center
	local diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center

	if diff.magnitude > distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)) > angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	if field:IsAnythingBlockingWithoutBounds(CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(fo.Bounds.center, vector(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)),
			CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, vector_util.get_x0z(full_diff)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:talk_with_santa()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.santa)

	if self.santa.Position.x > self.santa_desk.Position.x then
		party_util.align_party(self.santa.Position + vector(-1, -0.5, 0),
				'left', 1, 'arc')
	else
		party_util.align_party(self.santa , 'left', 1, 'arc')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.jump(self.santa, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(self.santa, { name = 'sing' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.santa, { name = 'smile' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.santa, { key = 'christmas_main_s4_25', skip = true })

	--region 나레이션 박스 출력

	local nar_str = nil
	local gathered_count = 0
	local combine_nar_str = function(str)
		-- 앞에 "- " 붙여 줌. 언어마다 다를 수도 있기 때문에, 일단 스트링 시트에 따로 등록해놓음
		str = game_string:Format('christmas_main_s4_new_6', str)

		if nar_str == nil then
			nar_str = str
		else
			nar_str = nar_str .. '\n' .. str
		end

		gathered_count = gathered_count + 1
	end

	--(완성한 것만 나오도록)

	if self.violent_clue_current_state == self.violent_clue_state.ending then
		--엘프들이 폭력 시위를 선동했다는 증거
		combine_nar_str(game_string:GetString('christmas_main_s4_34'))
	end

	if self.business_debt_clue_current_state == self.business_debt_clue_state.ending then
		--산타가 경영난에 처했다는 증거
		combine_nar_str(game_string:GetString('christmas_main_s4_35'))
	end

	if self.new_car_current_state == self.new_car_event_state.ending then
		--산타의 새 차
		combine_nar_str(game_string:GetString('christmas_main_s4_new_2'))
	end

	if self.rest_area_current_state == self.rest_area_event_state.ending then
		--휴게소 완성
		combine_nar_str(game_string:GetString('christmas_main_s4_new_3'))
	end

	--소재가 하나라도 없을 경우 나레이션 박스가 뜨지 않는다.
	if gathered_count > 0 then
		--나레이션 박스 : 다음과 같은 소재를 모았다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'christmas_main_s4_new_1' })

		--나레이션 박스 :
		--휴게소 완성
		--산타의 새 차
		--산타가 경영난에 처했다는 증거
		--엘프들이 폭력 시위를 선동했다는 증거
		--합쳐진 스트링을 출력해야되기에, 유틸을 사용하지 않음
		stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
		yield_return_func(stage.FieldUINarrationBox.SetNarration, stage.FieldUINarrationBox, nar_str, 0, 0)
		yield_return_func(stage.FieldUINarrationBox.HideAnimation, stage.FieldUINarrationBox)

		--(만약 다 모았다면)
		if gathered_count == 4 then
			--나레이션 박스 : 이 이상 모을 수 있는 소재는 없을 것 같다.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'christmas_main_s4_new_4' })
		end
	else
		--아무 증거가 없을 경우 "아직 아무 소재도 찾지 못했다" 라는 나레이션 박스가 뜨도록.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'christmas_main_s4_new_5' })
	end

		--endregion

	--아직 아무 소재도 찾지 못했다 나레이션 뜬 후 예/아니오 뜨지 말고 그냥 바로 산타가 소재를 찾아오라고 말하는 것으로
	local choose_result = 2

	if gathered_count > 0 then
		choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
				{ { 'christmas_main_s4_26', 'mercy' }, { 'christmas_main_s4_27', 'brutal' } })
	end

	if choose_result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.set_direction(self.ru, 'down')

		character_util.set_direction(self.santa, 'up')
		character_util.set_anim(self.santa, { name =  'throw', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.santa, { key = 'christmas_main_s4_29', skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(self.ru, { name = 'nod' })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.santa)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ru, { key = 'christmas_main_s4_30', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.ru)

		coroutine.yield(self:negotiate())
	else
		character_util.set_anim(self.santa, { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.santa, { name = 'tired' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.santa, { key = 'christmas_main_s4_28', skip = true })

		if gathered_count > 0 then
			quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.santa)
		else
			quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(self.santa)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(self.santa)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.santa)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('ChristmasMainSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ChristmasMain @
		Comment = 빵 공장 미니게임 @
		Index = 4 @
		NextSections = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = "xm_1_1"

	self.santa = nil

	self.ru = nil

	-- 인트로 이벤트 보았는지 저장
	self.see_intro = false

	-- 기타 상수
	self.rifle_item_id = 9030291
	self.workbench_num = 3
	self.workbench_worker_num = 4
	self.end_door_num = 2

	-- 타일맵의 캐릭터 이름
	self.santa_name = 'santa'
	self.ru_name = 'ru'
	self.workbench_worker_name = 'workbench_'
	self.onigirl_name = 'oni_girl'

	-- 타일맵 필드오브젝트 이름
	self.blocker_name = 'blocker_2'
	self.end_door_name = 'end_door_'

	-- 미니게임 이름
	self.mini_game_name = 'xmas_comic_bakery'

	-- 퀘스트 마커, 트래커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'christmas_main'
	self.quest_tracker_name = 'christmas_main_s5_tracker_0'
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')

	self.santa = get_character(self.santa_name)

	self.ru = get_character(self.ru_name)
	character_util.add_listener(self.ru, self.controller.cs_controller)

	-- 이 섹션에서 시작했을때 npc setting
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 4 then
		character_util.set_position(self.santa, vector(24, 0.5, 134.5))
		character_util.set_direction(self.santa, 'left')
		character_util.remove_anim(self.santa)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.santa)

		character_util.set_position(self.ru, vector(21.5, 0, 124))
		character_util.set_direction(self.ru, 'down')
	end

	local blocker = get_field_object(self.blocker_name)
	blocker.Position = vector(42, 0, 120)
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	-- 다른 섹션에서 시작했을때 npc setting
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 4 then
		for i = 1, self.workbench_num do
			for j = 1, self.workbench_worker_num do
				character_util.set_active_state(get_character(self.workbench_worker_name..i..'_'..j), 'enabled')
			end
		end
	end

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.ru)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))

	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.ru)

	-- 미니게임 로드
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party_leader, { 'load_mini_game', 'default' }))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	self.santa = nil

	self.ru.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.ru = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent) then
		self:on_minigame_end_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.ru) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_ru, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_minigame_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name then
		if e.Success then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.minigame_complete, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.minigame_fail, self)
		end
	end
end

--- 오른쪽 보고 돌아있는 경우는 왼쪽으로 원상복구 시켜줌
function local_class:set_santa_lefter()
	character_util.remove_anim(self.santa)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.santa)
	character_util.set_direction(self.santa, 'left')
	self.santa.Interactable.Talk = ''

	local chair = get_field_object('santa_chair')
	if chair.Transform.localEulerAngles.y ~= 90 then
		chair.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
		chair.Position = chair.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
		chair.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.25), vector(1, 1, 2))
	end
end

-- 루돌프와 대화해서 미니게임 시작
function local_class:talk_with_ru()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.ru)

	party_util.align_party(self.ru, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	-- 이전 섹션에서 넘어온 경우는 산타 원라인 및 방향 다시 원복시켜줌
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 4 then
		self:set_santa_lefter()
	end

	if not self.see_intro then
		self.see_intro = true

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ru, { key = 'christmas_main_s5_1', skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(self.ru, { name = 'cross_arm' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.ru, { name = 'attack' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ru, { key = 'christmas_main_s5_2', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.ru)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.ru)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ru, { key = 'christmas_main_s5_3', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.set_anim(self.ru, { name = 'throw', loop = false, scale = 0.7, next_anim = 'idle' })

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_touch_laser_cannon_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = self.ru.Position, target = user_party_leader.Position, itemid = self.rifle_item_id })

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ru, { key = 'christmas_main_s5_4', skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ru, { key = 'christmas_main_s5_5', skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ru, { key = 'christmas_main_s5_6', skip = true })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'christmas_main_s5_7', 'mercy' }, { 'christmas_main_s5_8', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.ru, self.controller.cs_controller)

		-- Oni Girl 제거
		character_util.set_active_state(get_character(self.onigirl_name), 'disabled')

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent.Create(self.mini_game_name))
	else
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.ru)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))

		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.ru)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('ChristmasMainSection6')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ChristmasMain @
		Comment = 선물 나눠주기 미니게임 @
		Index = 5 @
		NextSections = 6 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.past_stage_name = 'xm_1_1'
	self.stage_name = 'xm_1_2'

	-- 미니 게임 이름
	self.mini_game_name = 'xmas_gift'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_princess = function() return get_character('princess') end
	self.get_santa = function() return get_character('santa') end
	self.get_rudolph = function() return get_character('rudolph') end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_camera_marker = function(num) return field:GetMarker('camera_' .. num) end

	-- 1스테이지 루돌프 이름
	self.ru_name = 'ru'
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 이전 스테이지에서 이 섹션으로 넘어온 상태일 때 이벤트 실행
	if stage.Name == self.past_stage_name then
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 5 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.past_stage_event, self))
		end
	end

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pre_mini_game_start, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent) then
		return self:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name then
		self.controller.gift_minigame_success = e.Success
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mini_game_clear, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 이전 스테이지에서 발생하는 이벤트
function local_class:past_stage_event()
	local ru = get_character(self.ru_name)

	character_util.set_anim(ru, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_to(ru, ru.Position + vector(32, 0, 0),
			nil, 7.5, true, false)

	local santa = self.get_santa()

	character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(6, 0, 0), 5, nil, true, true)

	-- …
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'christmas_main_s6_1', skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(santa, 'left')

	-- 산타는 썰매를 타고 다니면서 선물을 나눠주는줄 알았는데...

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'christmas_main_s6_2', skip = true })

	-- 썰매? 그런 고대 유물 같은걸 타고 다니다간, 공장이 망하고 말 거야.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	character_util.set_anim(santa, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(santa, { key = 'christmas_main_s6_3', skip = true })

	-- 서두르자고. 할당량을 채우지 못하면 내년 지원금 받을 때 불리해져.
	character_util.set_anim(santa, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(santa, { key = 'christmas_main_s6_4', skip = true })

	-- 착한 아이에겐 선물을…
	character_util.remove_anim(santa)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(santa, { key = 'christmas_main_s6_5', skip = true })

	-- 나쁜 아이에겐 지옥을 보여주는거야. 키키키키키...

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
	character_util.set_direction(santa, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(santa, { name = 'greed' })
	character_util.set_anim(santa, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'scared' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(santa, { key = 'christmas_main_s6_6', skip = true })

	-- ...이해해줘 가디언과 그 주군.
	character_util.set_direction(rudolph, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rudolph, { key = 'christmas_main_s6_7', skip = true })

	-- 이 맘 때 산타는 스트레스 때문에 예민하거든.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rudolph, { key = 'christmas_main_s6_7_1', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'sing' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(rudolph)
	character_util.set_anim(santa, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(santa, { key = 'christmas_main_s6_12', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(santa, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile' })

	character_util.move_to(santa, santa.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 0.5, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 0.5, nil, true, true)

	character_util.move_to(santa, santa.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 0.3, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	character_util.normal_jump(user_party.Leader, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-1, 0.5, 0), 0.3, nil)
	character_util.move_to_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(-1, 0.5, 0), 0.3, nil)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'seat' })
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'seat' })

	character_util.set_direction(santa, 'right')
	character_util.normal_jump(santa, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(santa, santa.Position + vector(-1, 0.5, 0), 0.3, nil)
	character_util.set_anim(santa, { name = 'seat' })

	-- 잠시 후 화면이 크게 진동한다. 주인공, 공주 (smile, seat)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_04')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black ,'linear')
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	-- 선물 나눠주기 미니게임 시작.

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent.Create('xmas_gift'))
end

return local_class

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

		self.present_box_list[i] = {}
		for j = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local present_box = obj_list[j]
			table.insert(self.present_box_list[i], present_box)
		end

		obj_list:Dispose()
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.attacked_to_invader, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.aircraft_sfx ~= nil then
		self.aircraft_sfx:Stop()
		self.aircraft_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.blizzard_sfx ~= nil then
		self.blizzard_sfx:Stop()
		self.blizzard_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.spin_sfx ~= nil then
		self.spin_sfx:Stop()
		self.spin_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.present_box_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.present_box_list do
			for j = 1, #self.present_box_list[i] do
				self.present_box_list[i][j] = nil
			end
			self.present_box_list[i] = nil
		end
		self.present_box_list = nil
	end

	if self.windhole_effect_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.windhole_effect_list do
			if self.windhole_effect_list[i] ~= nil then
				self.windhole_effect_list[i]:Dispose()
				self.windhole_effect_list[i] = nil
			end
		end

		self.windhole_effect_list = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		return self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress.belt_release then
				if e.Zone.Name == self.airplane_shake_zone_name then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.airplane_shake, self)
					return true
				end
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.battle then
				if e.Zone.Name == self.ending_zone_name then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self)
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' then
		local door = self.get_door()
		local lever = self.get_lever()

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, door) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.door_interact, self, e:GetParamAt(1)))
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, lever) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending_2, self)
			return true
		end

		for i = 1, self.present_box_area_num do
			local present_box_area = self.get_present_box_area(i)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, present_box_area) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.present_box_interact, self, i))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.is_qte_start then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.swipe_type = 'up'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'down'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'tap'
		self.turbo_tap_count = self.turbo_tap_count + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'invader_battle' then
		sp_util.play_battle_end_screenplay(self.hijacking, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 깜빡이는 틴트, 카메라 쉐이크
function local_class:tint_loop()
	local duration = 2

	while self.tint_loop_stat do
		camera_util.shake(0.08, duration * 0.7)
		field:Tint(self.tint_key_2, unity_color({1.0, 0.2, 0.2, 1}), duration)
		wait_for_sec(2.5)
		if self.tint_loop_stat == false then
			break
		end

		camera_util.shake(0.08, duration * 0.7)
		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_2, duration)
		wait_for_sec(2.5)
		if self.tint_loop_stat == false then
			break
		end
	end

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_1, 0)
	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_2, 0)
end

function local_class:speech_bubble_rotate_new(fo)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local speech_bubble = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleManager.Instance:Get(fo)

		while speech_bubble == nil do
			coroutine.yield()

			speech_bubble = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleManager.Instance:Get(fo)
		end

		local anchor = speech_bubble.transform:GetChild('anchor')

		while speech_bubble.gameObject.activeSelf do
			anchor.transform.eulerAngles = stage_camera.Transform.eulerAngles

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end))
end

function local_class:camera_rotation_shake(duration, rotate_speed)
	local rotate_angle = 45
	local rotate_angle_offset = 1.5
	local time_passed = 0

	local camera_pivot = stage_camera.Transform.parent

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local sin_val = unity_class.mathf.Sin(2 * unity_class.mathf.PI * progress * rotate_speed)
		camera_pivot.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rotate_angle + (rotate_angle_offset * sin_val), vector(1, 0, 0))

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	camera_pivot.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(45, vector(1, 0, 0))
end

-- 선물 상자에 인터렉트가 끝났을 때

-- 선물을 비행기 밖으로 날려버리는 루틴
function local_class:present_box_drop(fo, end_position, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_position = fo.Position

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutQuad(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)

		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

function local_class:airplane_wall_broken()

	local fragment = mesh.transform:GetChild(1)
	local none_fragment_renderers = none_fragment.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	fragment_renderers.sharedMaterial = none_fragment_renderers.sharedMaterial
