-- 화물/의자 피하기 qte
function local_class:qte_action_1()
	-- 앞쪽에 있던 화물들이 날아오고, 이를 좌우 스와이프 QTE로 피한다.
	-- qte 액션 swipe type
	local swipe_type_list = {
		'down',
		'up',
		'right',
		'down',
		'up',
		'right'
	}
	-- qte 액션후 플레이어가 이동할 거리
	local position_offset_list = {
		vector(3, 0, 0),
		vector(3, 0, 0),
		vector(3, 0, 0),
		vector(3, 0, 0),
		vector(3, 0, 0),
		vector(3, 0, 0)
	}
	-- 박스가 날아갈 위치
	local target_position_list = {
		vector(65, 0, 77.5),
		vector(65, 0, 73.5),
		vector(69, 0, 77.5),
		vector(69, 0, 73.5),
		vector(73, 0, 77.5),
		vector(73, 0, 73.5)
	}

	local box_and_chair_drop_new = function(box_num, chair_group_num, is_swipe)
		local drop_box = self.get_drop_box(box_num)
		local box_position = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(10, 0, 0)
		local target_position = target_position_list[chair_group_num]
		local direction = (target_position - box_position)

		if self.field_object_drop_table[drop_box] == nil then
			self.field_object_drop_table[drop_box] = 0
		end
		self.field_object_drop_table[drop_box] = self.field_object_drop_table[drop_box] + 1
		-- 지금 flag를 변경해도 코루틴이 다음 틱에 멈추기 때문에, 한틱 기다리고 ActiveState를 변경함.
		coroutine.yield()

		-- 박스가 의자 쪽으로 날아감
		drop_box.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		drop_box.Position = box_position
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.field_object_rotate, self, drop_box, 1000, vector(0, 1, 0), 1.5))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.field_object_drop, self, drop_box, box_position, box_position + (direction.normalized * direction.magnitude * 2.8), 1.5))

		if is_swipe then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'scared' })
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 박스와 의자가 부딪혀서 화면이 흔들리고, 이펙트가 나오는 연출
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_01')
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
		self.get_break_library_pot_effect():Instantiate(drop_box.Position)
		self.get_critical_hit_effect():Instantiate(drop_box.Position)

		-- 박스에 부딪힌 의자가 날아감
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local index = (chair_group_num - 1) * 2 + i
			local chair = self.get_chair(index)
			local direction = (user_party.Leader.Position - chair.Position)

			local rotate_x = random_util.get_random_int(0, 3)
			local rotate_y = random_util.get_random_int(0, 3)
			local rotate_z = random_util.get_random_int(0, 3)
			local rotate_angle = vector(rotate_x, rotate_y, rotate_z)

			if i ~= 1 then
				direction = -direction
				direction.x = -direction.x
			end

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.field_object_rotate, self, chair, 1000, rotate_angle, 1.5))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.field_object_drop, self, chair, chair.Position, chair.Position + (direction.normalized * direction.magnitude * 9), 2))
		end

		if is_swipe then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
			time_util.mod('qte', 0.2)
			yield_return_func(self.qte_swipe, self, swipe_type_list[chair_group_num], 0.2)
			time_util.unmod('qte')

			if self.swipe_type == swipe_type_list[chair_group_num] then
				-- 성공했을 때
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
				character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'prostrate' })
				character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + position_offset_list[chair_group_num], 0.3, nil, false, false)
				character_util.jump(user_party.Leader, 1, 0.3)

				if self.is_princess_attach_leader then
					local princess = self.get_princess()
					character_util.jump(princess, 1, 0.3)
				end

				time_util.mod('jump_slow_motion', 0.3)
				wait_for_sec(0.2)
				time_util.unmod('jump_slow_motion')
				wait_for_sec(0.1)
			else
				-- 실패했을 때
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_03')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
				self.get_critical_hit_effect():Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)

				local character_move_speed = 14
				character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })
				character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, 360 * 10, 5)
				character_util.move_waypoint(user_party.Leader, vector(44, 0, 75.5), character_move_speed, false, nil, nil, 'right')

				if self.is_princess_attach_leader then
					local princess = self.get_princess()
					character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 360 * 10, 5)
				end

				local camera_position = stage_camera.Transform.position
				local camera_target_position = vector(50, 0, 75.5)
				local camera_distance = (camera_position - camera_target_position).magnitude
				local camera_speed = character_move_speed / 2
				local camera_move_duration = camera_speed / camera_distance

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
				camera_util.move_async(camera_target_position, camera_move_duration)

				return false
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		return true
	end

	local chair_group_num_list = { 1, 2 }
	for i = 1, #chair_group_num_list do
		local index = chair_group_num_list[i]

		if index == 2 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				box_and_chair_drop_new(2, 3, false)
			end ))
		end
		local flag = box_and_chair_drop_new(1, index, true)

		if not flag then
			return false
		end
	end

	-- 공주
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local qte_type = 'tap'

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })

	-- 으아아아!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	princess.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 10)
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)
	princess.Position = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(10, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 1000, 0.7)
	self:speech_bubble_rotate_new(princess)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(princess, { key = 'christmas_main_s7_21', type_speed = 0 })
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.field_object_drop, self, princess, princess.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), princess.Position + vector(-10.25, 0, 0) + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.75, false))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local is_jump_end = false
	local is_jump_progress_half = false
	local real_jump = function(fo, height, duration)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			local time_passed = 0

			is_jump_end = false
			while not is_jump_stop and time_passed < duration do
				local progress = (time_passed / duration)
				local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height

				if progress >= 0.5 then
					is_jump_progress_half = true
				end

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				character_util.set_position(fo, vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position, y), false)

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			is_jump_end = true
			character_util.set_position(fo, vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position), false)
		end))
	end

	time_util.mod('qte', 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'cast2' })
	real_jump(user_party.Leader, 1, 0.4)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	yield_return_func(self.qte_swipe, self, qte_type, 0.2)

	if self.swipe_type == qte_type then
		-- 성공했을 때
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		while not is_jump_progress_half do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
		time_util.unmod('qte')
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(princess, vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0)), 4, false)
			character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 0, 0)
			character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'scared' })
			character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'push' })
			princess.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.princess_attach_leader, self, princess))
		end))
	else
		-- 실패했을 때
		time_util.unmod('qte')

		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
		character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 11000, 7)
		character_util.move_waypoint(princess, vector(44, 0, 75.5), 14, false, nil, nil, 'right')

		local character_move_speed = 14
		local camera_position = stage_camera.Transform.position
		local camera_target_position = vector(50, 0, 75.5)
		local camera_distance = (camera_position - camera_target_position).magnitude
		local camera_speed = character_move_speed / 2
		local camera_move_duration = camera_speed / camera_distance

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			while not is_jump_end do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_03')
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, 360 * 10, 5)
			character_util.move_waypoint(user_party.Leader, vector(44, 0, 75.5), character_move_speed, false, nil, nil, 'right')
		end))

		camera_util.move_async(camera_target_position, camera_move_duration)

		return false
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	-- 화물/의자
	chair_group_num_list = { 4, 6 }
	for i = 1, #chair_group_num_list do
		local index = chair_group_num_list[i]

		if index == 4 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				box_and_chair_drop_new(2, 5, false)
			end ))
		end
		local flag = box_and_chair_drop_new(1, index, true)

		if not flag then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- 공주가 기사 등 뒤에 붙어 있음.
function local_class:princess_attach_leader(princess)
	self.is_princess_attach_leader = true
	local layer_order = 10
	local prev_layer_order = 0

	local parent = princess.Transform.parent
	princess.Transform:SetParent(user_party.Leader.Transform)

	while self.is_princess_attach_leader do
		local direction = user_party.Leader.Direction
		local direction_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(direction)

		princess.Position = (direction_vector * -0.25)
		character_util.set_direction(princess, direction)

		if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			layer_order = 0
		else
			layer_order = 10
		end

		if layer_order ~= prev_layer_order then
			prev_layer_order = layer_order
			princess.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', layer_order)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	princess.Transform:SetParent(parent)
end

--region door_interact
-- 문이 열리는 시점 체크
function local_class:door_interact(percent)
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	local percent_list = {
		0.3,
		0.6,
		1
	}

	if percent_list[self.door_interact_count + 1] > tonumber(percent) then
		return
	end

	local door = self.get_door()
	message_system:SendSync(door, CS.Oak.InteractCancelEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, door))

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	coroutine.yield()

	if self.door_interact_count < 3 then
		self.door_interact_count = self.door_interact_count + 1
	end

	if self.door_interact_count == 3 then
		local door_position = door.Position
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.field_object_rotate, self, door, 1000, vector(0, 0, 1), 2))
		character_util.move_to(door, door.Position + vector(-20, 0, -8), 2, nil)

		-- 문이 열리고, 플레이어는 옆으로 구름.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_03')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_02')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_blizzard_02')
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.4)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 720, 0.285)
		character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, 720, 0.285)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-2, 0, 1), 7, false, nil, nil, 'left')

		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'prostrate' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'push' })

		local move_to_target_position = function(fo, target_position, duration)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				local time_passed = 0
				local start_position = fo.Position

				while time_passed < duration do
					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

					local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInExpo(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
					fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, target_position, progress)

					coroutine.yield()
				end

				fo.Position = target_position
			end))
		end

		local windhole_effect = self.get_windhole_side_small_effect():Instantiate(door_position, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0), nil)
		table.insert(self.windhole_effect_list, windhole_effect)

		local move_duration = 1.5
		move_to_target_position(user_party.Leader, door_position + vector(0, 1, -0.7), move_duration)
		wait_for_sec(move_duration)

		wait_for_sec(0.05)

		local move_distance = 0.5
		local move_speed = 12
		local rotate_duration = move_distance / move_speed

		character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'none')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-move_distance, 0, 0), move_speed, false, nil, nil, 'left')

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.catch_wall, self, user_party.Leader, 'right'))

		-- 연타 QTE
		local turbo_tap_count = 10
		local is_running_camera_angle_return = true
		local camera_angle_axis_z_return = function()
			local speed = 1

			while is_running_camera_angle_return do
				local camera_angle_axis_z = -6 + ((self.turbo_tap_count / turbo_tap_count) * 6)
				local diff = camera_angle_axis_z - self.camera_angle_axis_z

				self.camera_angle_axis_z = self.camera_angle_axis_z + (diff * speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)

				coroutine.yield()
			end
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(camera_angle_axis_z_return), false)

			character_util.set_anim(santa, { name = 'prostrate' })
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'cast2' })
			character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, -90, 0)

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 12, false, nil, nil, 'right')

			self.is_princess_attach_leader = false
			coroutine.yield()

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'prostrate' })
			character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'prostrate' })
			character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, 0, 0, 0)

			character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, 360 * 3, 0.7)
			character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 360 * 3, 0.7)
			character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'right')
			character_util.set_locked_dir(princess, 'right')
			character_util.move_waypoint(princess, princess.Position + vector(-3, -1, 5.5), 12, false, nil, nil, 'right')
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-2, -1, 5.5), 12, false, nil, nil, 'left')

			character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'none')
			character_util.set_locked_dir(princess, 'none')
			character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, 0, 0)
			character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 0, 0)

			-- 이 시점에서 조종실로 돌아가는 길을 화물로 막는다.
			-- 이후에도 구멍이 난 곳 근처 존에 진입시 QTE 연타 이벤트 발생.

			-- 더이상 고도를 유지할 수가 없다! 현재 빠른 속도로 하강중!

			self:speech_bubble_rotate_new(rudolph)

			character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

			self.current_progress = self.progress.door_open

			yield_return_func(self.battle_start, self)
		else
			-- 실패했을 때
			-- 플레이어가 비행기 밖에서 날아가는 연출
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
			camera_util.move(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.1)
			character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 720 * 1.5, 1.5)
			character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, 720 * 1.5, 1.5)
			character_util.move_waypoint(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position:Get0Yz(user_party.Leader.Position.x - 30), 21, false, nil, nil, 'right')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			self.aircraft_sfx:FadeOut(2)
			self.aircraft_sfx = nil
			self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(2)
			self.blizzard_sfx = nil
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			-- 플레이어 위치 세팅
			character_util.stop(user_party.Leader)
			user_party.Leader.Position = vector(77, 0, 76)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

			-- 문 복구
			door.Position = vector(77, 0, 72)
			door.Transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 180, 0))

			self.door_interact_count = 0

			is_running_camera_angle_return = false
			self.camera_angle_axis_z = -6

			self.windhole_effect_list[#self.windhole_effect_list]:Dispose()
			table.remove(self.windhole_effect_list, #self.windhole_effect_list)

			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			self.aircraft_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_aircraft_02', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
			self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
		end

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		return
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	local is_success = self:qte_action_2()

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	if not is_success then
		self.door_interact_count = 0
		-- 플레이어가 비행기 밖으로 날아가는 연출
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
		self.aircraft_sfx:FadeOut(2)
		self.aircraft_sfx = nil
		self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(2)
		self.blizzard_sfx = nil
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		self.spin_sfx:Stop()
		self.spin_sfx = nil
		character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 0, 0)
		character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, 0, 0)
		user_party.Leader.Position = vector(77, 0, 76)

		message_system:SendSync(door, CS.Oak.InteractFinishEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, door))

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		self.aircraft_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_aircraft_02', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
		self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
	else
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.stop(user_party.Leader)
		character_util.stop(princess)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.shake(user_party.Leader, 0.02, 0.5)
		character_util.shake(princess, 0.02, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(character_util.mario_jump_async, user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Direction),
			util.cs_generator(character_util.mario_jump_async, princess, princess.Direction)
		})
		character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'push' })
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:qte_action_2()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	local is_success = true

	local swipe_type_list = {
		'up',
		'down',
		'right',
		'left'
	}
	local qte_action_num = 2

	self.spin_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_air_spin_03', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	for i = 1, qte_action_num do
		local index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)
		local swipe_type = swipe_type_list[index]

		-- 1초에 2바퀴
		-- 길어봐야 20초 잡고
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 720 * 20, 20)
		character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, 720 * 20, 20)
		character_util.move_waypoint(user_party.Leader, vector(44, 0, 75), 7, false, nil, nil, 'right')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.qte_swipe, self, swipe_type))

		while self.is_qte_start do
			-- 플레이어가 비행기 밖으로 나간 경우
			if user_party.Leader.Position.x <= 51 then
				self.is_qte_start = false
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- 제한 시간 내에 qte를 성공하지 못했을 때
		if self.swipe_type ~= swipe_type then
			is_success = false
			break
		end
	end

	-- 성공했을 땐, 즉시 회전을 멈춤.
	if is_success then
		self.spin_sfx:Stop()
		self.spin_sfx = nil
		character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 0, 0)
		character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, 0, 0)
	end

	return is_success
end

-- 캐릭터가 벽을 붙잡고 매달려서 흔들리는 연출
function local_class:catch_wall(fo, direction)
	if self.catch_wall_table[fo] == nil then
		self.catch_wall_table[fo] = 0
	end

	self.catch_wall_table[fo] = self.catch_wall_table[fo] + 1
	local req_id = self.catch_wall_table[fo]

	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'hold_loop' })
	character_util.set_direction(fo, direction)

	local z = fo.Position.z
	local offset_z = 0.1
	local angle = -75
	local angle_offset = 7.5
	local speed = 4
	local time_passed = 0

	while req_id == self.catch_wall_table[fo] do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local sin_val = unity_class.mathf.Sin(2 * unity_class.mathf.PI * speed * time_passed)

		character_util.spine_rotate(fo, angle + (sin_val * angle_offset), 0)
		fo.Position = vector_util.get_xy0(fo.Position, z + (sin_val * offset_z))

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:stop_catch_wall(fo)
	character_util.remove_anim(fo)
	character_util.spine_rotate(fo, 0, 0)

	self.catch_wall_table[fo] = self.catch_wall_table[fo] + 1

-- 카메라 회전
function local_class:camera_rotation()
	local rotate_angle = 45
	local rotate_angle_offset = 2.5
	local rotate_speed = 0.25
	local time_passed = 0

	local camera_pivot = stage_camera.Transform.parent

	self.camera_angle_axis_z = -6
	self.is_camera_rotation = true
	while self.is_camera_rotation do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local sin_val = unity_class.mathf.Sin(2 * unity_class.mathf.PI * time_passed * rotate_speed)
		camera_pivot.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rotate_angle + (rotate_angle_offset * sin_val), vector(1, 0, 0))
		camera_pivot.transform.localRotation = camera_pivot.transform.localRotation * unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(self.camera_angle_axis_z, vector(0, 0, 1))

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	camera_pivot.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(45, vector(1, 0, 0))
end

-- 필드 오브젝트가 회전하는 함수
function local_class:field_object_rotate(fo, speed, rotate_vector, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	rotate_vector = rotate_vector.normalized

	while time_passed < duration do
		local angle = fo.Transform.eulerAngles
		angle = angle + (rotate_vector * speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		fo.Transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(angle)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
end

-- 물체가 날아오는 함수
function local_class:field_object_drop(fo, start_position, end_position, duration, is_disabled)
	if self.field_object_drop_table[fo] == nil then
		self.field_object_drop_table[fo] = 0
	end

	self.field_object_drop_table[fo] = self.field_object_drop_table[fo] + 1
	local req_id = self.field_object_drop_table[fo]

	local velocity = 5
	local accelerate = 20
	local distance = 0
	local bounce = 3

	local time_passed = 0
	local free_fall = nil

	is_disabled = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_disabled, true)

	if accelerate ~= 0 then
		free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(velocity, accelerate, distance, bounce, nil)
	end

	while req_id == self.field_object_drop_table[fo] and time_passed < duration do
		local progress = (time_passed / duration)
		local position = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if free_fall ~= nil then
			free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			local y = free_fall:GetDistance()
			if free_fall:IsDone() then
				y = 0
			end

			fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(position, y)
		else
			fo.Position = position
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if is_disabled then
		fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

--region qte
-- QTE 함수
function local_class:qte_swipe(type, duration)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 9999)

	if type == 'tap' then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTap()
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)
	end

	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.is_qte_start = true
	local time_passed = 0

	while self.is_qte_start and self.swipe_type ~= type and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end

-- 터치 연타 함수
function local_class:turbo_tap(duration, count)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_blizzard_02')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

	local time_passed = 0

	self.turbo_tap_count = 0
	self.is_qte_start = true

	while self.is_qte_start and self.turbo_tap_count < count and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end
--endregion

	local dot = self.live_dot

	local time_passed = 0

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= active_cycle then

function local_class:shake(scene)
	local calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	calculator:Shake(0.2, 1)
	local shaker = scene.transform:Find('background').transform
	local origin_pos = shaker.position;

	while calculator.IsActive do
		calculator:UpdateFrame(CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime)

		shaker.position = origin_pos + calculator.ShakeOffset

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	shaker.position = origin_pos
end

function local_class:set_part(scene, character_name, part_name, type_name, fade)
	local part = scene.transform:Find('background').transform:Find('characters').transform:Find(character_name).transform:Find(part_name).transform
	local child_count = part.childCount
	for i = 0, child_count - 1 do
		local child = part:GetChild(i)
		if child.name == type_name then
			if fade then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sprite_fade_in, self, child))
			else
				child.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			end
		else
			if fade then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sprite_fade_out, self, child))
			else
				child.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end
		end
	end
	if fade then
		wait_for_sec(0.55)
	end
end

function local_class:sprite_fade_in(transform)
	local elapsed_time = 0
	local sprite = transform.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	sprite.Alpha = 0
	sprite:Rebuild()
	local fade_duration = 0.5
	transform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	while elapsed_time < fade_duration do
		local progress = elapsed_time/fade_duration
		sprite.Alpha = progress
		sprite:Rebuild()
		elapsed_time = elapsed_time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	sprite.Alpha = 1
end

function local_class:sprite_fade_out(transform)
	local elapsed_time = 0
	local sprite = transform.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	sprite.Alpha = 1
	sprite:Rebuild()
	local fade_duration = 0.5
	while elapsed_time < fade_duration do
		local progress = elapsed_time/fade_duration
		sprite.Alpha = 1 - progress
		sprite:Rebuild()
		elapsed_time = elapsed_time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	sprite.Alpha = 0
	transform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

end

		return self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutEvent) then
		return self:on_xmas_survival_put_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.RemoveFieldObjectEvent) then
		return self:on_remove_field_object_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'battle_3_zone_entry' and not self.played_flag then
				self.played_flag = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rudolf_appear, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'central_plaza_zone' and not self.princess_find_flag then
				self.princess_find_flag = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.princess_find, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'battle_3' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.rue_saves_knight_post, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_xmas_survival_put_event(e)
	if e.Type == CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutEventType.Success then
		local campfire = get_field_object('campfire_1')
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, campfire) then
			local central_plaza = field:GetZone('central_plaza_zone')
			if central_plaza:Contains(e.Target.Position)then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.end_section, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif e.Type == CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutEventType.HoldStart then
		local campfire = get_field_object('campfire_1')
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, campfire) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_marker_to_plaza, self))
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local broken_bridge = get_field_object('broken_bridge_1')
	local broken_bridge_3 = get_field_object('broken_bridge_3')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, broken_bridge)
			or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, broken_bridge_3) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.bridge_broken, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_remove_field_object_event(e)
	local gold_woods = self:get_gold_woods()
	for i = 1,3 do
		if e.Target.Name == gold_woods[i].Name then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_gold_wood_component, self, i)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:get_gold_wood_component(i)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ItemData')
	local tmp = create_item_placeholder({ id = item_data:GetSpec('xmas_component_best_wood').Id , -- ore_silver_pickaxe
										  not_for_inventory = true})

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent,
			tmp,
			'xmas_component_best_wood_title',
			'xmas_component_best_wood_desc'
	)

	local old_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, 'gold_tree_collect')
	if old_state == -1 then
		old_state = 0
	end
	local new_state = old_state | self.quest_custom_state['gold_tree_'..i]

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, 'gold_tree_collect', new_state)
end

			tmp,

			'xmas_bronze_pickaxe_desc'
	)

	-- HACK : DefaultCharacterGenerator 에서 무기 세팅을 하고 끝날때까지 가디리지 않기 때문에 여기서 기다려줘야 한다.

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	local spec = item_data:GetSpec(weapon_name)
	local gear  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(spec)

	user_party[0]:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, nil , false)
	user_party[0]:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, gear)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	while user_party[0].IsChangingEquipment do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:end_section()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('xm_main')

	local rue = get_character(self.rue_name)
	local princess = get_character(self.princess_name)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(rue)

	local campfire = get_field_object('campfire_1')

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_catch_fire_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local campfire_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_xmas_campfire'):Instantiate(campfire.Position+ vector(0,0.2,0))
	campfire_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0,0,0)
	local timer = 0
	local duration = 0.5
	while timer < duration do
		local step = duration - timer
		campfire_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * timer/duration
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	campfire_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	wait_for_sec(2)

	--[[
	-- 어서 산타를 구하러 가자!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rue, {key = 'christmas_main_s9_tmp_1', skip = true})

	yield_return(self, 'turn_off_blizzard', true)

	-- 이펙트 로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, 'ondemand/xmas/effects', 'fx_xmas_stage_snow_camera_fx', function(prefab)
				self.snow_screen_effect = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.snow_screen_effect.transform:SetParent(stage_camera.Transform.parent)
				self.snow_screen_effect.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

-- 눈보라 효과
function local_class:turn_on_blizzard(value)
	while self.is_blizzard_changing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if not self.is_blizzard_active then
		self.is_blizzard_changing = true
		-- flag set
		self.is_blizzard_active = true

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		-- blizzard start
		self:blizzard_start()

		---[[
		stage.BuffManager:AddBuff(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
				user_party.Leader, self.blizzard_buff, 0, false, false)
		--]]

		self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = "event", player_priority = "player"
		})
		local fade_time = 0.3
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		local mult = lua_helper.get_or_default(value, 0.4)

		-- blizzard update
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fade_time do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0) * mult

			self:blizzard_update(progress)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.is_blizzard_changing = false
	end
end

function local_class:turn_off_blizzard(force)
	while self.is_blizzard_changing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	local cond = false
	if force then
		cond = true
	end
	if self.is_blizzard_active and cond then
		self.is_blizzard_changing = true
		-- flag set
		self.is_blizzard_active = false

		music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'field', mix = 2})
		-- blizzard inner param refresh
		self:blizzard_color_refresh()

		stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party_leader, self.blizzard_buff)

		local fade_time = 0.4
		if force then
			fade_time = 1
		end

		local wait_time = fade_time + 1.5
		--local remove_buff_time = 1.5
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		--local remove_buff = false

		self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(2)

		-- blizzard update
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_time do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max(1 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0) * 0.4

			self:blizzard_update(progress)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if unity_class.time.time - cur_time > fade_time and not force then
				break
			end
		end

		-- blizzard dispose
		self:blizzard_dispose()
		self.is_blizzard_changing = false
	end
end

-- blizzard 이펙트 셋업
function local_class:blizzard_start(args)
	if self.blizzard == nil or self.fade == nil then return end
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil or self.fade.obj ~= nil then return end

	local with_fade = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'with_fade', true)
	local alpha = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'alpha', -1)
	local custom_alpha = false

	if not float_util.almost_close_to(alpha, -1) then
		custom_alpha = true
	end

	local camera = stage_camera

	self.blizzard.obj = self.preset.blizzard:Instantiate(
			camera.Transform.position + vector(0, 5, 10), unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
	self.blizzard.material = self.blizzard.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
			typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer)).material

	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	local target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.blizzard.color.a * 0.1

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, target_alpha }))

	if with_fade then
		self.fade.obj = self.preset.blizzard_fade:Instantiate(
				camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
		self.fade.main_module = self.fade.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
				typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color

		target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.fade.color.a * 0.1

		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, target_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_lerp(from, to, duration)

	self.is_blizzard_changing = true
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local tint = from

	-- blizzard update
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration, 0)
		tint = from + (to - from) * progress

		self:blizzard_update(tint)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.is_blizzard_changing = false
end

function local_class:blizzard_update(alpha, fade_alpha)
	if fade_alpha == nil then
		fade_alpha = alpha
	end

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, alpha }))

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, fade_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_fade_max()
	if self.fade.obj == nil then return end

	self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color({ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, 1 })

	self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
end

function local_class:blizzard_color_refresh()
	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

-- 눈보라 관련 이펙트 dispose
function local_class:blizzard_dispose()
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil then
		self.blizzard.material = nil
		self.blizzard.color = nil
		self.blizzard.obj:Dispose()
		self.blizzard.obj = nil
	end

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.main_module = nil
		self.fade.color = nil
		self.fade.obj:Dispose()
		self.fade.obj = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.played_flag = nil
	self.princess_find_flag = nil
	self.workstation_interactable = nil


	if self.snow_screen_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.snow_screen_effect)
		self.snow_screen_effect = nil
	end

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_request, self, e.Target))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and
		e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name and not self.is_seen_cooking_monster_event then
			self.quest_notice_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(

		end

			CS.Oak.StageEventControllerDungeonKingdom1At5.CustomKey.CookingMonster.value__, true)

	self.marcille.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.chilchuck.Interactable.Talk = self.chilchuck_oneline_talk

	if self.is_cleared_witch_chef_quest then
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.marcille)
	end

	self.quest_notice_coroutine = nil
end

function local_class:quest_request(target)
	if self.is_cleared_witch_chef_quest then
		quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.marcille)
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
		field_ui_manager:Hide()

		if not self.see_intro then
			self.see_intro = true
			yield_return(self.controller.scene, "firstEventReal")
		end
		yield_return(self.controller.scene, "firstEventRealRepeat")

		local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

		if is_accepted then
			yield_return(self.controller.scene, "acceptedQuest")
			yield_return_func(CS.Oak.AddSNSCoroutine, self.mage_floow_id)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.block_door_name))
			yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
		else
			quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.marcille)
		end

		user_party:ResetControllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	else
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.marcille) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.marcille, {key = self.talk_name1})
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.chilchuck, {key = self.talk_name2})
		end
	end
end

function local_class:talk_branch()

	local wait = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.user_party_leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "right")
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "bomb_attack", loop = false})

	self.cook_book = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = user_party_leader.Position, target =
	user_party_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, itemid = self.item_id, notforinven = true,
	lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})
end

	self.cook_book.ConsumeTarget = user_party_leader
	self.cook_book:Fly()
end

end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		self:on_item_get_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.zone_name1 and self.inner_progress == 0 then
		self.inner_progress = self.inner_progress + 1
	elseif zone_name == self.zone_name2 and self.inner_progress == 1 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gembug_move_start, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.zone_name3 and self.inner_progress == 6 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gembug_qte, self))
		self.inner_progress = self.inner_progress + 1
	end

	for i = 2, 5 do
		if string.find(zone_name, self.zone_name4) then
			if self.inner_progress == i and string.find(zone_name, tostring(i)) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gembug_move, self,
				self.inner_progress))
				self.inner_progress = self.inner_progress + 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:gembug_move(progress_index)
	local scene_name = string.format("%s%d", "gembugMove", progress_index)
	yield_return(self.controller.scene, scene_name)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gem_bug) then
		if self.inner_progress == 8 and not self.qte_success then

			character_util.set_active_state(self.gem_bug, "disabled")

			if self.stun ~= nil then
				self.stun:Dispose()
			end

			self:get_gembug(self.gem_bug.Position)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight and not self.qte_success then
		self.qte_success = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if e.Item.ItemId == self.gem_bug_id and self.inner_progress == 8 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
				self.progress, self))
		self.inner_progress = self.inner_progress + 1
	end
end

function local_class:gembug_move_start()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	for i = 1, 4 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(
				string.format("%s%d", self.battle_gate_name, i), false))
	end
	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "gembugJump")
	self.inner_progress = self.inner_progress + 1
	ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name1, self.gem_bug)
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:gembug_qte()
	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "gembugPinch")
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe("right")

	local qte_time = 0.3
	local qte_delay = 0

	while qte_delay < qte_time do
		if self.qte_success then
			yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, qte_time - qte_delay)
			break
		end

		qte_delay = qte_delay + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
	self.fire_ball = self.fire_ball_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.marcille.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * 2)

	self.cast_audio_source_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = self.cast_fire_ball_sfx_name,
	loop = true, fade_in_time = 0.4, type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc"})

	local scale = 1
	while scale < 2.5 do
		scale = scale + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 2
		self.fire_ball.transform.localScale = vector(scale, scale, scale)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.marcille:RemoveAnimation()
	character_util.set_anim(self.marcille, {name = "hold_loop"})

	while scale < 3 do
		scale = scale + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 2
		self.fire_ball.transform.localScale = vector(scale, scale, scale)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_fire_ball()
	self.marcille:RemoveAnimation()
	self.cast_audio_source_holder:FadeOut(0.3)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.shoot_fire_ball_sfx_name)

	self.magic_circle:Dispose()
	self.magic_circle = nil

	self.magic_circle_cast:Instantiate(self.marcille.Position)

	local fire_ball_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(0, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultGravity, 2, 0)
	local start_pos = self.marcille.Position
	local target_pos = self.gem_bug.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5
	fire_ball_fall:ScaleTime(1.5)

	while not fire_ball_fall:IsDone() do
		fire_ball_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		local progress = fire_ball_fall:GetProgress()
		local move_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
		move_pos.y = fire_ball_fall:GetDistance()
		self.fire_ball.transform.position = move_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.fire_ball.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	if self.fire_ball ~= nil then
		self.fire_ball:Dispose()
	end
	self.fire_ball = nil

	character_util.set_emotion(self.marcille, {name = "tired"})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.hit_fire_ball_sfx_name)
	self.explosion_effect_pool:Instantiate(target_pos)
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.gem_bug, "disabled")
	self.gem_bug_item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = self.gem_bug.Position, target =
	vector(-61.5, 0, -46.5), itemid = self.gem_bug_id, notforinven = true,
	                                                lootstate = "dontfindlooter", sprscale = 0.7})

	local knock_back_list = {}
	table.insert(knock_back_list, self.chilchuck)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(knock_back_list, user_party[i])
	end

	for i = 1, #knock_back_list do
		local dir
		if i == 1 then
			dir = vector(0, 0, 1)
		else
			dir = vector(1, 0, 0)
		end

		character_util.set_anim(knock_back_list[i], {name = "damaged"})
		character_util.set_emotion(knock_back_list[i], {name = "damaged"})
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(knock_back_list[i], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(knock_back_list[i], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 1)

		local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info("physics", true, dir, 9000, 0.05,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
		local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(knock_back_list[i], knockback_info)
		knock_back_list[i].FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.7))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(trip_sfx_name)

	for key,value in pairs(knock_back_list) do
		character_util.set_anim(value, {name = "prostrate"})
	end
end

function local_class:fire_ball()
	local magic_circle = self.magic_circle_appear:Instantiate(self.marcille.Position)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
	local fire_ball = self.fire_ball_effect_pool:Instantiate(self.marcille.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * 2)
	local cast_audio_source_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = self.cast_fire_ball_sfx_name,
	loop = true, fade_in_time = 0.4, type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc"})

	local scale = 1
	while scale < 2.5 do
		scale = scale + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 2
		fire_ball.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * scale
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.marcille:RemoveAnimation()
	character_util.set_anim(self.marcille, {name = "hold_loop"})

	while scale < 3 do
		scale = scale + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 2
		fire_ball.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * scale
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	character_util.set_emotion(self.marcille, {name = "damaged"})
	self.marcille:RemoveAnimation()
	cast_audio_source_holder:FadeOut(0.3)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.shoot_fire_ball_sfx_name)

	magic_circle:Dispose()
	magic_circle = nil

	self.magic_circle_cast:Instantiate(self.marcille.Position)

	local fire_ball_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(0, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultGravity, 2, 0)
	local start_pos = self.marcille.Position
	local target_pos = self.pot.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5

	fire_ball_fall:ScaleTime(1.5)

	while not fire_ball_fall:IsDone() do
		fire_ball_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local progress = fire_ball_fall:GetProgress()
		local move_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
		move_pos.y = fire_ball_fall:GetDistance()
		fire_ball.transform.position = move_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	fire_ball.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	fire_ball:Dispose()
	fire_ball = nil

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.hit_fire_ball_sfx_name)
	self.explosion_effect_pool:Instantiate(target_pos)
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)
	self.marcille:RemoveEmotion()

	camera_util.shake(0.8, 1)

	table.insert(knock_back_list, self.marcille)

		table.insert(knock_back_list, user_party[i])
	end

	for i = 1, #knock_back_list do

			dir = vector(0, 0, 1)

		end

		character_util.spine_pulse_color(knock_back_list[i], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)

		end})

	end

		local player = user_party_leader
		local clear_grade = 0

		end

		field_ui_manager:Show()

		end

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'prostrate' })

	damage_info.direction = unity_class.vector3.zero

	yield_return_func(character_util.mario_jump_async, user_party_leader, 'right')

	field_ui_manager:Show()

		on = 1,
		off = 2,
	}
	self.current_on_off_request = self.on_off_request.none

	self.cached_interactable_talk = ''
end

function local_class:enter()
	--맨 처음 남편이 내연녀를 만났던 약속 장소 주변에서 의뢰인을 볼 수 있음.
	--의뢰인에게 사실을 알렸을 경우,
	local client = self.get_client()
	client.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(client)

	if self.controller.quest_progress.Grade == 0 then
		client.Position = field:GetMarker('adultery_in_plat_female').position
		client.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		--이미지에 표시된 위치에 의뢰인이 tired ,seat 상태로 있음.
		character_util.set_emotion(client, {name = 'cry'})
		character_util.set_anim(client, {name = 'seat'})
	else
		--조용히 덮었을 경우,
		client.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(field:GetZone('adultery_section2_active_1').Bounds.center)
		client.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		--이미지에 표시된 위치에 의뢰인이 awesome, cast 상태로 있음.
		character_util.set_emotion(client, {name = 'awesome'})
		character_util.set_anim(client, {name = 'cast'})
	end

	character_util.add_listener(client, self.controller)
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_client(), self.controller)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_client())
				and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.after_talk
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_client, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.controller.exclusive_quest_event_key then
		self:request_on_off(false, e.Fade)
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.controller.exclusive_quest_event_key then
		self:request_on_off(true, e.Fade)
	end
end

function local_class:request_on_off(is_on, is_fade)
	local prev_request = self.current_on_off_request
	local client = self.get_client()

	if is_fade then
		if is_on then
			client.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(client, 1, 0)
			client.Interactable.Talk = self.cached_interactable_talk

			if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then
				character_util.add_listener(client, self.controller)
			end
		else
			client.Interactable.Talk = ''
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(client, 0, 0)
			client.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			character_util.remove_relate_event(client, self.controller)
		end

		self.current_on_off_request = self.on_off_request.none
		return
	else
		if is_on then
			client.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
			character_util.set_emotion(client,
					{name = self.controller.quest_progress.Grade == 0 and 'cry' or 'awesome'})
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(client, 1, 1)

			self.current_on_off_request = self.on_off_request.on
		else
			client.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(client, 0, 1)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(client, self.controller)
			client.Interactable.Talk = ''

			self.current_on_off_request = self.on_off_request.off
		end
	end

	if prev_request == self.on_off_request.none then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.client_on_off_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:client_on_off_routine()
	local prev_request = self.current_on_off_request
	local request_duration = 1
	local time_passed = 0
	local client = self.get_client()

	while self.current_on_off_request ~= self.on_off_request.none do
		-- 1초 안에 새 리퀘스트가 들어온 경우
		if prev_request ~= self.current_on_off_request then
			time_passed = 0
		elseif time_passed >= request_duration then
			if self.current_on_off_request == self.on_off_request.on then
				client.Interactable.Talk = self.cached_interactable_talk
				if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then
					character_util.add_listener(client, self.controller)
				end
				client.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

			elseif self.current_on_off_request == self.on_off_request.off then
				character_util.remove_emotion(client)
				client.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end

			self.current_on_off_request = self.on_off_request.none
			-- 여기서 리턴을 안해주면 다음 프레임에 새 요청들어왔을 때 리퀘스트쪽에서는 코루틴을 새로 생성하고,
			-- 여기선 다시 돌기 때문에 무조건 리턴 필요함
			return
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		prev_request = self.current_on_off_request
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

	--오딜 : 어떤 상황인지 알겠지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_18', skip = true})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_19', skip = true})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_20', skip = true})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_23', skip = true})

	character_util.nod_twice(user_party.Leader)

	--오딜 : 여기서 나간 다음, 차도를 따라 쭉 아래쪽으로 내려가다보면 대로 건너편에 정류장이 보일 거야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_24', skip = true})

	--오딜 : 그럼 행운을 빌지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_25', skip = true})

	quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller)

	self.controller:publish_ordeal_talk_done()
end

return local_class

	self.in_main_field = self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 0

	self.get_flower_bed().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_follow
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent))

	self.get_flower_bed().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- 컨트롤러에서 직접 보내준 CustomStageEvent 처리
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.controller.target_follow_infos.cse_send_key
				and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.following then
			local end_state_key = e:GetParamAt(1)
			if end_state_key == 'give_up' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.give_up_following, self))
				return true

			elseif end_state_key == 'restart' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.retry_following, self))
				return true

			elseif end_state_key == 'success' then
				self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_enter_store
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.following_done, self))
				return true
			end
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == self.controller.picturing_infos.cse_send_key
				and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.in_store then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.after_picturing
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.picturing_success, self))

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'adultery_picture_store')
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_enter_store then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.enter_store

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_cakeshop_01')
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key,
				(self.get_female_target().Position + self.get_male_target().Position) / 2, true)
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'adultery_in_store')
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.enter_store then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.in_store
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_store, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'adultery_picture_store')
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.enter_store then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_enter_store

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, self.get_store_entrance(), true)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'start_adultery_quest_progress' then
		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none
				or self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_follow then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.talk_about_place
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_about_place, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_flower_bed())
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_follow then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.wait_targets
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_following_event, self)
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'main_field') then
		self.in_main_field = true
		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_follow and self.controller.exclusive_on == false then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, self.get_flower_bed(), true)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'main_field') then
		self.in_main_field = false
		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_follow then
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.controller.exclusive_quest_event_key
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_follow then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)
		self.get_flower_bed().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.controller.exclusive_quest_event_key
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_follow and self.in_main_field then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, self.get_flower_bed(), true)
		self.get_flower_bed().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_start_event(e)
	if e.StartedBattle.AllCharacters:Contains(get_character('battle_2_1'))
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_follow then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)
		self.get_flower_bed().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	if e:IsCharacterInBattle(get_character('battle_2_1'))
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_follow then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, self.get_flower_bed(), true)
		self.get_flower_bed().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:talk_about_place()
	local ordeal = self.get_ordeal()

	--의뢰 해결에 필요한 정보를 듣는다 선택 시
	--오딜 : 남편의 약속 장소는 상점가 초입의 버스 정류장이야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_23', skip = true})

	--오딜 : 여기서 나간 다음, 차도를 따라 쭉 아래쪽으로 내려가다보면 대로 건너편에 정류장이 보일 거야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_24', skip = true})

	--오딜 : 그럼 행운을 빌지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_25', skip = true})

	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_follow
	self.controller:publish_ordeal_talk_done()
end

function local_class:start_following_event()
	local male = self.get_male_target()
	local female = self.get_female_target()

	--선택지
	--의뢰인의 남편을 기다린다. / 그만둔다.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'demonworld_adultery_26_1', 'intellect'},
		{'demonworld_adultery_26_2', 'brutal'}
	})

	if result == 2 then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_follow
		return
	end

	--ExclusiveQuestStartEvent / 자동차 & NPC 날려줌
	self.controller:publish_exclusive_event(true, false)
	self.controller:toggle_car_and_npc(false)
	self.controller:toggle_monster_battles(false)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)

	local flower_bed = self.get_flower_bed()
	flower_bed.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	local leader_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	local target_pos = flower_bed.Position + vector(0.2, 0, -(0.5 + user_party.Leader.Bounds.extents.z))
	local leader_wps = {}
	if leader_pos.x > flower_bed.Position.x - 0.5 and leader_pos.z > flower_bed.Position.z then
		leader_wps = {
			flower_bed.Position + vector(-0.8, 0, 0.8),
			flower_bed.Position + vector(-0.8, 0, -0.8),
			target_pos
		}
	elseif leader_pos.x < flower_bed.Position.x - 0.5 then
		leader_wps = {
			flower_bed.Position + vector(-0.8, 0, -0.8),
			target_pos
		}
	else
		leader_wps = { target_pos }
	end

	--오른쪽 가로등 근처에 숨음. (프로토타입과 같음)
	local male_start_pos = self.controller.get_target_start_marker(1, 1).position
	local female_start_pos = self.controller.get_target_start_marker(1, 2).position
	local fade_dur = 1
	local move_done = false

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 0, fade_dur)
		user_party[i]:HideWeapon(true)
	end

	-- GT-1281 : 파티원 비활성화가 제대로 되지 않는 문제 수정
	if user_party.Count > 1 then
		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(fade_dur)

			for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
				user_party[i].ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end
		end)
	end

	camera_util.move(flower_bed.Position, 0.5)

	wp_util.move_way_points(user_party.Leader,
			{waypoints = leader_wps, speed = 3, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
			 callback = function(wp_index)
				 move_done = (wp_index + 1) == #leader_wps
			end})

	while move_done == false do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'cross_arm'})

	male.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(male, 0, 0)
	female.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(female, 0, 0)

	--카메라 앵글은 주인공 중심이 아니라 위 이미지와 흡사함.

	--2초 후, 남편(demon_civilian_business_male) 아래쪽에서 올라와 표시 지점에 위치. (down, cross_arm)
	male.Position = male_start_pos + vector(0, 0, -12)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(male, 1, 0.7)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(male, {waypoints = male_start_pos, speed = 4})

	male.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--1초 후 내연녀(demon_civilian_business_female) 왼쪽에서 뛰어와 남편과 조우.
	female.Position = female_start_pos + vector(-9, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(female, 1, 0.7)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(female,
			{waypoints = female_start_pos, speed = 6, run = true, play_sfx = true})

	--남편, 내연녀 둘이 만나면 서로 마주보면서 남편 (smile) , 내연녀 (awesome, jump)
	character_util.remove_anim(male)
	male.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	character_util.set_emotion(male, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.normal_jump(female, '01_jump_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(female, {name = 'awesome'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	user_party.Leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up

	camera_util.move_async((female_start_pos + male_start_pos) / 2, 1)

	--불륜녀 : 어머, 오래 기다렸어요?
	character_util.set_emotion(female, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(female, 'cast',
			nil, 'demonworld_adultery_27')

	--남편 : 아하하, 나도 방금 온 참입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_28', skip = true})

	--남편 (left, idle) : 그나저나, 오늘도 기가 막히게 아름다우시군요. demonworld_adultery_28_1
	character_util.play_speech_action(male, 'sing',
			nil, 'demonworld_adultery_28_1')

	--남편 (left, smile) : 이 거리가 온통 환해지는 느낌인데요? demonworld_adultery_28_2
	character_util.play_speech_action(male, 'bomb_idle',
			'doyagao', 'demonworld_adultery_28_2')
	character_util.set_emotion(male, {name = 'smile'})

	--내연녀 (right, sleep_deep) : 예쁘게 하고 나와야죠. 이렇게 멋진 신사와의 만남인데요. demonworld_adultery_28_3
	character_util.play_speech_action(female, 'cast',
			'sleep_deep', 'demonworld_adultery_28_3')
	character_util.set_emotion(female, {name = 'smile'})

	--남편 (left, smile) : 아하하, 역시 선생님은 못 당하겠다니깐요. demonworld_adultery_28_4
	character_util.normal_jump(male, '01_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_28_4', skip = true})

	--남편 (left, idle) : 자, 그럼 가실까요? demonworld_adultery_28_5
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_28_5', skip = true})

	--남편 (left, doyagao) : 제가 아주 비밀스러운 장소를 찾아뒀습니다. demonworld_adultery_28_6
	character_util.set_emotion(male, {name = 'doyagao'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_28_6', skip = true})

	--내연녀 (right, awesome, nod)
	character_util.set_emotion(female, {name = 'awesome'})
	character_util.nod_twice(female)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({female, male})

	--이후 둘이 아래쪽으로 나란히 내려가면,
	wp_util.move_way_points(male,
			{waypoints = male.Position + vector(0, 0, -6), speed = 2})
	wp_util.move_way_points(female,
			{waypoints = female.Position + vector(0, 0, -6), speed = 2})
	--주인공 중심으로 카메라 옮겨지며 컨트롤 풀림.

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	party_util.set_active_state('enabled')
	party_util.position_party(user_party.Leader.Position, 'left', 'linear')
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 1, 1)
		user_party[i]:HideWeapon(false)
	end
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.stop(male)
	character_util.stop(female)

	--미행 시작.
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.following
	self.controller:start_target_follow('phase_1')
end

function local_class:retry_following()
	local male = self.get_male_target()
	local female = self.get_female_target()
	local male_start_pos = self.controller.get_target_start_marker(1, 1).position
	local female_start_pos = self.controller.get_target_start_marker(1, 2).position

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(male)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(female)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(male, 1, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(female, 1, 0)

	male.Position = male_start_pos
	male.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	female.Position = female_start_pos
	female.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	party_util.position_party(self.get_flower_bed().Position + vector(0.2, 0, -0.8),
			'left', 'linear')

	wp_util.move_way_points(male,
			{waypoints = male.Position + vector(0, 0, -6), speed = 2})
	wp_util.move_way_points(female,
			{waypoints = female.Position + vector(0, 0, -6), speed = 2})

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ActivateExitInteractableEvent.Create(false))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.stop(male)
	character_util.stop(female)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)

	self.controller:start_target_follow('phase_1')

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:give_up_following()
	local male = self.get_male_target()
	local female = self.get_female_target()
	local flower_bed = self.get_flower_bed()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(male)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(female)

	male.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	female.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_follow

	local shopkeeper = self.get_shopkeeper()
	character_util.remove_anim(shopkeeper)
	shopkeeper.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	self.controller:publish_exclusive_event(false, true)
	self.controller:toggle_car_and_npc(true)
	self.controller:toggle_monster_battles(true)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)

	party_util.position_party(flower_bed.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1.5),
			'left', 'linear')
	flower_bed.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, flower_bed)
end

function local_class:following_done()
	local male_target = self.get_male_target()
	local female_target = self.get_female_target()
	local shopkeeper = self.get_shopkeeper()
	local move_done = false

	self:start_give_up_check(male_target.Position)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(male_target, 0, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(female_target, 0, 1)

	male_target.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
	female_target.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	wp_util.move_way_points(male_target,
			{waypoints = male_target.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			 speed = 1, callback = function()
				move_done = true
			end})
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(female_target,
			{waypoints = female_target.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			 speed = 1})

	while move_done == false do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(male_target, 1, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(female_target, 1, 0)

	male_target.Position = field:GetMarker('adultery_in_store_male').position
	female_target.Position = field:GetMarker('adultery_in_store_female').position

	character_util.look_at(male_target, female_target)
	character_util.look_at(female_target, male_target)

	character_util.set_group_emotion({male_target, female_target}, {name = 'smile'})

	shopkeeper.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.set_anim(shopkeeper, {name = 'eat'})

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ActivateExitInteractableEvent.Create(true))

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, self.get_store_entrance(), true)
end

function local_class:start_give_up_check(position)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.give_up_check_routine, self, position))
end

function local_class:give_up_check_routine(position)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	while self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_enter_store
			or self.current_event_state == self.event_state.enter_store do

		-- 너무 많이 떨어져 있으면 상점 안에 있는 것으로 판정함
		if (leader.transform.position - position).magnitude > 8
				and leader.transform.position.x > -50 then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.following
			self.controller:failed_target_follow('phase_1', {self.get_store_entrance()}, false)
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:enter_store()
	local male = self.get_male_target()
	local female = self.get_female_target()
	local shopkeeper = self.get_shopkeeper()
	local in_store_bounds = field:GetZone('adultery_in_store').Bounds

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)

	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true,
			 parent = shopkeeper, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	camera_util.move((male.Position + female.Position) / 2, 1)

	party_util.align_to_target(vector(in_store_bounds.center.x, 0, in_store_bounds.min.z + 1.5),
			'down', 1, 'arc')

	-- 상점 내 연출
	--계산대 앞의 남편과 내연녀 커플, 서로 마주보며 smile 표정.
	--가게 주인은 계산대 건너편에서 right, eat 모션.

	--잠시 후, 가게 주인이 pearl_ring 스프라이트를 계산대 위에 내놓으면,
	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	character_util.remove_anim(shopkeeper)
	shopkeeper.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	equipping_sfx:FadeOut(0.5)

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldAdulterySection2')
demon_world_global_event = get_or_create_global_variable('utils/DemonWorldGlobalEvent')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_client = function() return get_character('adultery_client') end
	self.get_ordeal = function() return get_character('trouble_shooter') end
	self.get_male_target = function() return get_character('adultery_target_male') end
	self.get_female_target = function() return get_character('adultery_target_female') end
	self.get_shopkeeper = function() return get_character('jewel_shopkeeper') end

	self.get_ordeal_desk = function() return get_field_object('ordeal_desk') end

	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		talk_ordeal = 1,
	}
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none

	self.marker_key = 'adultery'
	self.in_main_field = true

	self.is_warning = false

	-- 메인 퀘스트 번호
	self.main_quest_id = 216
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	local female = self.get_female_target()
	local male = self.get_male_target()

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 1 then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(female)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(male)

		female.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		male.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

		male.Position = field:GetMarker('adultery_in_store_male').position
		female.Position = field:GetMarker('adultery_in_store_female').position

		character_util.look_at(male, female)
		character_util.look_at(female, male)

		character_util.set_emotion(male, {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_emotion(female, {name = 'smile'})

		self.controller.ring_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{itemid = 20363, notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.5,
				 pos = self.get_shopkeeper().Position + vector(0, 0.7, -1), lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})

		-- 메인 퀘스트 InnerProgress가 9 이하일때 퀘스트 마커 출력(9부터 오딜이 사무실에 없음)
		local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
		local main_quest_inner_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress

		if main_quest_inner_progress ~= 9 then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key,
					get_field_object('entry_office'), true)
		end

				get_field_object('jewel_store_out'), true)
		self.in_main_field = false
	end

	--남편과 내연녀에게 상호작용 시 원라인 출력.
	--남편 : 아내가 마음에 들어했으면 좋겠는데… demonworld_adultery_42
	--내연녀 : 후후, 아내 분이 정말 행복하시겠네요. demonworld_adultery_42_1
	male.Interactable.Talk = 'demonworld_adultery_42'
	female.Interactable.Talk = 'demonworld_adultery_42_1'
