function local_class:start()
	--다시 보석 가게 안으로 진입하면 내연녀는 없고 남편만 있음.
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'start_adultery_quest_progress' and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.talk_ordeal
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_ordeal, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'adultery_in_store_warning')
			and self.controller.exclusive_on == false and self.is_warning == false then
		if user_party.Leader.Position.z > e.Zone.Bounds.center.z  then
			self.is_warning = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.warn_player_too_close, self.controller, e.Zone, function()
				self.is_warning = false
			end)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'main_field') then
		self.in_main_field = true
		if self.controller.exclusive_on == false then
			-- 메인 퀘스트 InnerProgress가 9 이하일때 퀘스트 마커 출력(9부터 오딜이 사무실에 없음)
			local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
			local main_quest_inner_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress

			if main_quest_inner_progress ~= 9 then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key,
						get_field_object('entry_office'), true)
				return true
			else
				quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'main_field') then
		self.in_main_field = false
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.controller.exclusive_quest_event_key then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.controller.exclusive_quest_event_key then
		if self.in_main_field then
			-- 메인 퀘스트 InnerProgress가 9 이하일때 퀘스트 마커 출력(9부터 오딜이 사무실에 없음)
			local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
			local main_quest_inner_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress

			if main_quest_inner_progress ~= 9 then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key,
						get_field_object('entry_office'), true)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

	self.controller:publish_exclusive_event(true, true)

	--페이드인 되면 아래 이미지의 상황.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.play_speech_action(client, nil,

	character_util.set_emotion(client, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(client, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_65', skip = true})

	--의뢰인이 주인공에게 guild_credit 을 내민다.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(client, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_66', skip = true})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dollars_01')

	local demon_world_dollar = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/DemonWorldDollar')
	demon_world_dollar:add_dollar(self.controller.money_info.before_truth, false, { pos = client.Position })

	--주인공이 돈 받으면 츠킁~ 하는 계산대 소리.
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader,
			{name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true, sfx = '01_stage_intro_jump_01'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	--이후 의뢰인은 left 로 방향 전환 후, awesome 표정이 되어 사무실 밖으로.

	character_util.set_emotion(client, {name = 'awesome'})

	local client_target_pos = field:GetMarker('entry_office').position
	wp_util.move_way_points(client, {waypoints = {
		vector(client_target_pos.x, 0, client.Position.z),
		client_target_pos,
	}, speed = 4})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--페이드아웃 되며 이벤트 종료.

	character_util.stop(client)
	character_util.remove_emotion(client)
	client.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		member.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end
	party_util.position_party(user_party.Leader.Position, 'left', 'linear')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	self.controller:publish_exclusive_event(false, true)

	--페이드인 되면 컨트롤 풀림.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
	self.controller:publish_ordeal_talk_done()

		after_picturing = 8,
	}
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none

	self.in_dist_checking = false

	self.event_active_zone_name = 'adultery_section2_active_'
	self.event_reactive_zone_name = 'adultery_section2_reactive_'
	self.activated_zone_num = 0

	self.on_off_request = {
		none = 0,
		on = 1,
		off = 2,
	}
	self.current_on_off_request = self.on_off_request.none

	self.event_active_zones = {}
	self.event_reactive_zones = {}
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self.event_active_zones = {
		field:GetZone(self.event_active_zone_name .. 1),
		field:GetZone(self.event_active_zone_name .. 2),
	}

	self.event_reactive_zones = {
		field:GetZone(self.event_reactive_zone_name .. 1),
		field:GetZone(self.event_reactive_zone_name .. 2),
	}

	self:enter_init()
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.male_emoticon = nil
	self.female_emotion = nil
	self.event_active_zones = nil
	self.event_reactive_zones = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.controller.target_follow_infos.cse_send_key
				and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.following then
			local end_state_key = e:GetParamAt(1)
			if end_state_key == 'give_up' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.give_up_following, self))
				return true

			elseif end_state_key == 'restart' then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.restart_following, self)
				return true

			elseif end_state_key == 'success' then
				self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_enter_plat
				self:following_done()
				return true
			end
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == self.controller.picturing_infos.cse_send_key
				and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.in_plat then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.after_picturing
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.picturing_success, self))

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.FullEnter then
		if self.activated_zone_num == 0
				and (e.Zone.Name == self.event_active_zone_name .. 1 or e.Zone.Name == self.event_active_zone_name .. 2)
				and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none
				and self.controller.exclusive_on == false then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.male_appear
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.male_appear_from_store, self, e.Zone)
			return true

		elseif self.activated_zone_num ~= 0
				and e.Zone.Name == self.event_reactive_zone_name .. self.activated_zone_num
				and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.appeared
				and self.controller.exclusive_on == false then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.wait_start
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.entered_reactive_zone, self, e.Zone))
			return true

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'adultery_plat_enter' then
			if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.following then
				self.current_event_state = self.event_state.entered_earlier

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_earlier_than_target, self)
				return true

			elseif self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_enter_plat then
				self.current_event_state = self.event_state.in_plat
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.enter_plat, self, e.Zone))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.controller.exclusive_quest_event_key then
		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.appeared
				or self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then
			self:request_on_off(false, e.Fade)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.controller.exclusive_quest_event_key then
		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.appeared
				or self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then
			self:request_on_off(true, e.Fade)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:request_on_off(is_on, is_fade)
	local prev_request = self.current_on_off_request
	local male = self.get_male_target()

	if is_fade then
		if is_on then
			male.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(male, 1, 0)
		else
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(male, 0, 0)
			male.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

		self.current_on_off_request = self.on_off_request.none
		return
	else
		if is_on then
			male.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(male, 1, 1)

			self.current_on_off_request = self.on_off_request.on
		else
			male.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(male, 0, 1)

			self.current_on_off_request = self.on_off_request.off
		end
	end

	if prev_request == self.on_off_request.none then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.male_on_off_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:male_on_off_routine()
	local prev_request = self.current_on_off_request
	local request_duration = 1
	local time_passed = 0
	local male = self.get_male_target()

	while self.current_on_off_request ~= self.on_off_request.none do
		-- 1초 안에 새 리퀘스트가 들어온 경우
		if prev_request ~= self.current_on_off_request then
			time_passed = 0
		elseif time_passed >= request_duration then
			if self.current_on_off_request == self.on_off_request.on then
				male.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
				self.current_on_off_request = self.on_off_request.none

			elseif self.current_on_off_request == self.on_off_request.off then
				male.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				self.current_on_off_request = self.on_off_request.none
			end

			-- 여기서 리턴을 안해주면 다음 프레임에 새 요청들어왔을 때 리퀘스트쪽에서는 코루틴을 새로 생성하고,
			-- 여기선 다시 돌기 때문에 무조건 리턴 필요함
			return
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		prev_request = self.current_on_off_request
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:male_appear_from_store(enter_zone)
	local male = self.get_male_target()
	local store_entrance = self.get_store_entrance()
	local zone_center = enter_zone.Bounds.center
	local is_left = zone_center.x < store_entrance.Position.x
	local align_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(
			(is_left and unity_class.vector3.right or unity_class.vector3.left) + zone_center)

	male.Interactable.Talk = ''

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(male)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(male, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move(store_entrance.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 1)
	party_util.align_to_target(align_pos, is_left and 'left' or 'right', 1, 'linear')

	male.Position = store_entrance.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(male, 1, 0.7)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(male, {waypoints = {
		male.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
		male.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
				+ (is_left and unity_class.vector3.right or unity_class.vector3.left) * 2
	}, speed = 2})

	if is_left then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		male.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		wait_for_sec(0.7)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		male.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		wait_for_sec(1)

		male.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		male.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		wait_for_sec(0.7)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		male.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(male, {name = 'doyagao'})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--"이전에 미행했던 의뢰인의 남편이다." "거동이 매우 수상하다.." 라는 나레이션 박스가 뜨고 선택지가 뜨도록.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'demonworld_adultery_66_1'})
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, 'SetNarration',
			game_string:GetString('demonworld_adultery_66_2'), 0, 0)

	--미행한다.  <
	--그만 둔다.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'demonworld_adultery_67', 'mercy'},
		{'demonworld_adultery_68', 'brutal'}
	})

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, 'HideAnimation')

	if result == 1 then
		self:start_following(is_left)
	else
		-- 해당 존에 다시 진입할 수 있도록 존 인덱스 캐싱해놓음
		self.activated_zone_num = is_left and 1 or 2
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.appeared
	end
end

function local_class:entered_reactive_zone(zone)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local male = self.get_male_target()
	local zone_bounds = zone.Bounds
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local leader_controller = leader.FieldObjectController
	local is_left = leader.Position.x < zone_bounds.center.x

	-- 혹시라도 존 안에서 보석상에 들어갔다가 나왔을 경우 이동 루틴 끝나기 전까지 기다리도록 함
	while lua_helper.type_compare(leader_controller.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if is_left then
		local target_pos = vector(zone_bounds.min.x + 0.5, 0, male.Position.z)
		local move_dur = math.max(1, (target_pos - user_party.Leader.Position).magnitude / 2)
		party_util.align_to_target(target_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
				'left', move_dur, 'linear')
	else
		local target_pos = vector(zone_bounds.max.x - 0.5, 0, male.Position.z)
		local move_dur = math.max(1, (target_pos - user_party.Leader.Position).magnitude / 2)
		party_util.align_to_target(target_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				'right', move_dur, 'linear')
	end

	--"이전에 미행했던 의뢰인의 남편이다." "거동이 매우 수상하다.." 라는 나레이션 박스가 뜨고 선택지가 뜨도록.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'demonworld_adultery_66_1'})
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, 'SetNarration',
			game_string:GetString('demonworld_adultery_66_2'), 0, 0)

	--미행한다.  <
	--그만 둔다.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'demonworld_adultery_67', 'mercy'},
		{'demonworld_adultery_68', 'brutal'}
	})

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, 'HideAnimation')

	if result == 1 then
		self:start_following(self.activated_zone_num == 1)
	else
		-- 해당 존에 다시 진입할 수 있도록 존 인덱스 캐싱해놓음
		self:party_walk_back()
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.appeared
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:party_walk_back()
	local move_done_left = user_party.Count
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		member.LockedDirection = member.Direction
		wp_util.move_way_points(member,
				{waypoints = member.Position
						+ vector(member.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right and -1.5 or 1.5, 0, 0),
				 speed = 2, callback = function()
					move_done_left = move_done_left - 1
				end})
	end

	while move_done_left > 0 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	party_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader.LockedDirection)
	party_util.set_locked_dir('none')
end

function local_class:start_following(is_left)
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.following

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'bgm_chasing', mix = 2.0})

	local male = self.get_male_target()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(male)

	local female = self.get_female_target()
	female.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	female.Position = field:GetMarker('adultery_in_plat_female').position
	female.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	if is_left then
		self.controller:start_target_follow('phase_2_left')
	else
		self.controller:start_target_follow('phase_2_right')
	end

	self.controller:publish_exclusive_event(true, false)
	self.controller:toggle_car_and_npc(false)
	self.controller:toggle_monster_battles(false)
end

function local_class:give_up_following()
	self:enter_init()

	party_util.position_party(field:GetZone(self.event_active_zone_name .. 1).Bounds.center
			+ vector(-3, 0, 0), 'right', 'linear')

	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none

	self.controller:publish_exclusive_event(false, true)
	self.controller:toggle_car_and_npc(true)
	self.controller:toggle_monster_battles(true)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:enter_init()
	local female = self.get_female_target()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(female)
	female.Interactable.Talk = ''
	female.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	local male = self.get_male_target()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(male)
	male.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	male.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	male.Position = field:GetMarker('adultery_in_store_male').position + vector(2, 0, -1)
	character_util.set_anim(male, {name = 'cast'})

end

function local_class:restart_following()
	local male = self.get_male_target()
	male.Position = field:GetMarker('jewel_store_out').position + vector(-2, 0, 0)
	male.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	party_util.position_party(male.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), 'left', 'linear')

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.controller:start_target_follow('phase_2_right')
end

function local_class:enter_earlier_than_target()

	local female = self.get_female_target()

	self.controller:stop_target_follow()

	camera_util.move_async(female.Position, 0.7)

	female.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_01')

	character_util.set_anim(female, {name = 'cast'})
	character_util.set_emotion(female, {name = 'scared'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(female, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_120', skip = true})

	party_util.position_party(start_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0), 'right', 'arc')

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(male, {waypoints = {

	}, speed = 3})

function local_class:following_done()
	local male = self.get_male_target()
	local female = self.get_female_target()

	male.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.set_emotion(male, {name = 'smile'})
	wp_util.move_way_points(male,
			{waypoints = female.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			 speed = 5, run = true, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left, callback = function()
				character_util.set_emotion(female, {name = 'awesome'})
			end})

	self:start_give_up_check(male.Position)
end

function local_class:start_give_up_check(position)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.give_up_check_routine, self, position))
end

function local_class:give_up_check_routine(position)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	while self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_enter_plat do
		if (leader.transform.position - position).magnitude > 8 then
			-- 포기 연출이 나오는 동안 루틴 정지
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.following
			self.controller:failed_target_follow('phase_2_right', {self.get_male_target()}, false)
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:enter_plat(zone)
	local male = self.get_male_target()
	local female = self.get_female_target()
	local plat_zone_bounds = zone.Bounds

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	--남편이 공터 중앙에 있는 내연녀와 만난 상태에서 시작.

	--남편과 내연녀 서로 마주보고 둘 다 awesome 상태

	--카메라 살짝 올라가서 커플 중심으로 비춤.

	camera_util.move(female.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1)
	party_util.align_to_target(vector(plat_zone_bounds.center.x, 0, plat_zone_bounds.min.z + 1.5),
			'down', 1, 'linear')

	-- 이동 멈출 때 까지 기다림
	while male.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 항상 여자가 앞에 오도록 (남자 덩치가 너무 커서 묻힐 가능성이 있음
	female.SpineController:SetSortingLayer(nil, 1)

	--내연녀 (right, blush) : 잠깐인데도 너무 보고 싶었어, 자기!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(female)
	character_util.set_emotion(female, {name = 'blush'})
	character_util.set_anim(female, {name = 'sing'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(female, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_69', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(female)

	--남편 (left, blush) : 마찬가지야!
	character_util.set_emotion(male, {name = 'doyagao'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_70', skip = true})

	--남편 (left, blush) : 자기랑 떨어져 있는 동안 미치는 줄 알았다고.
	character_util.set_emotion(male, {name = 'damaged'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_71', skip = true})

	--커플은 붙을 수 있는 한 찰싹 붙어서, 블러시 상태로 하트 말풍선 띄움.
	character_util.set_emotion(male, {name = 'doyagao'})
	wp_util.move_way_points(female,
			{waypoints = female.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0), speed = 0.5})
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(male,
			{waypoints = male.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0), speed = 0.5})

	character_util.set_anim(female, {name = 'cast'})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon(male, nil, 'heart')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(female, nil, 'heart')

	--내연녀 (right, question)  : 그럼, 이제 아내 일은 해결된 거야?
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(female)
	character_util.play_speech_action(female, {name = 'question', loop = false},
			nil, 'demonworld_adultery_72')

	--남편 (left, doyagao, nod) : 그럼, 그럼!
	character_util.set_emotion(female, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_emotion(male, {name = 'doyagao'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(male, 'nod',

	self.get_female_target = function() return get_character('adultery_target_female') end

	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object('adultery_star_piece') end

	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		talk_ordeal = 2,
	}
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none

	self.marker_key = 'adultery'
	self.in_main_field = true

	self.is_warning = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	local male = self.get_male_target()
	local female = self.get_female_target()

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 3 then
		male.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		female.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(male)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(female)

		female.SpineController:SetSortingLayer(nil, 1)
		female.Position = field:GetMarker('adultery_in_plat_female').position + vector(0.25, 0, 0)
		female.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		male.Position = female.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
		male.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		character_util.set_group_emotion({male, female}, {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_anim(female, {name = 'cast'})
	end

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key,
			get_field_object('entry_office'), true)

	male.Interactable.Talk = 'demonworld_adultery_79'
	female.Interactable.Talk = 'demonworld_adultery_78'
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'start_adultery_quest_progress' then
		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.talk_ordeal
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_ordeal, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'adultery_in_plat_warning')
			and self.controller.exclusive_on == false and self.is_warning == false then
		if user_party.Leader.Position.z > e.Zone.Bounds.center.z  then
			self.is_warning = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.warn_player_too_close, self.controller, e.Zone, function()
				self.is_warning = false
			end)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'main_field') then
		self.in_main_field = true
		if self.controller.exclusive_on == false then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key,
					get_field_object('entry_office'), true)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'main_field') then
		self.in_main_field = false
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.controller.exclusive_quest_event_key then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key ~= self.controller.exclusive_quest_event_key then
		if self.in_main_field then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key,
					get_field_object('entry_office'), true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

		self.controller:publish_exclusive_event(false, false)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.8)

		character_util.remove_emotion(ordeal)
		party_util.remove_animation()
		party_util.remove_emotion()

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 2.0})

		quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0)

	else
		--조용히 덮어 둔다. 선택 시
		--오딜 (right, sleep_deep) : 흐으음…
		character_util.play_speech_action(ordeal, nil,
				'sleep_deep', 'demonworld_adultery_103')

		--오딜 (right, idle) : 왜 그런 결정을 내렸지?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_104', skip = true})

		--그 편이 모두에게 좋을 것 같아서
		--의뢰인의 행복을 망치기 싫어서
		--더 이상 관여하고 싶지 않아서
		choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{'demonworld_adultery_105', 'intellect'},
			{'demonworld_adultery_106', 'mercy'},
			{'demonworld_adultery_107', 'brutal'}
		})

		--오딜 (right, question) : 흠… 그런가.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(ordeal, {name = 'question', loop = false, upper = true},
				nil, 'demonworld_adultery_108')

		--오딜 (down, nod) : 그래.
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(ordeal, {name = 'nod', count = 2, upper = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_109', skip = true})

		--오딜 (down, idle) : 때론 그 편이 나을 수도 있을 것 같군.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_110', skip = true})

		--오딜 (right, idle) : 어쨌든 수고 많았어.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_111', skip = true})

		--오딜이 주인공에게 guild_credit 을 내민다.

		--오딜 (right, idle) : 이건 수고비야.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ordeal, {key = 'demonworld_adultery_112', skip = true})

		star_piece_util.appear(self.get_star_piece(), ordeal.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0))

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dollars_01')

		local demon_world_dollar = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/DemonWorldDollar')
		demon_world_dollar:add_dollar(self.controller.money_info.after_truth, false, { pos = ordeal.Position })

		--주인공이 돈 받으면 츠킁~ 하는 계산대 소리.
		user_party.Leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader,
				{name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true, sfx = '01_stage_intro_jump_01'})
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

		--오딜 down 방향으로 전환. 컨트롤 풀리며 이벤트 종료
		quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 1)
	end

	self.controller:publish_ordeal_talk_done()

	male.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	female.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

return local_class

end

end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

	self.entrance_marker = field:GetMarker('bank_hall_entrance')
	self.hall_marker = field:GetMarker('bank_hall_center')
	self.intro_marker = field:GetMarker('robbery_intro_align')

	self.robs = {}
	for i = 1, 6 do

		self.robs[i] = rob
		character_util.set_active_state(rob, 'disabled')
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		get_character('police_'.. 0 .. '_' .. i ).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

		hostage.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_active_state(hostage, 'disabled')
	end

	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('upper_stair_entrance_door', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('upper_stair_exit_door', true))

end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_demonworld_event_7', state = 'field', mix = 0.6})
	else

		wait_for_sec(0.6)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_police_01', state = 'field', mix = 0.6})
	end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldBankRobberyPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = DemonWorldBankRobbery @
		Comment =  은행 강도 서브 스테이지 열리기 전까지 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 은행강도 서브 스테이지 열어주는 npc
	self.get_bank_robbery_member = function() return get_character('bank_robbery_member') end

	-- 패스워드 테이블
	self.password_table = { 1, 9, 4, 5 }

	-- 2스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'demonworld_part1_1_2'

	-- 은행강도 npc 위치 마커
	self.event_start_marker = 'sub_bank_robbery_pos'

	-- 뱅크 이벤트 시작 존
	self.event_start_zone = 'sub_bank_robbery_zone'

	-- 암호 입력용 키
	self.num_key = 'demonworld_bank_robbery_pre_num_'

	-- 대사 스트링 키
	self.script_key = 'demonworld_bank_robbery_pre_'

	-- 선택지 스트링 키
	self.choose_key = 'demonworld_bank_robbery_pre_choose_'

	-- 상호 작용을 한번 했는지?
	self.is_interact = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 리스너 추가
	local bank_robbery_member = self.get_bank_robbery_member()
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(bank_robbery_member, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	bank_robbery_member.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	character_util.set_with_marker(bank_robbery_member, field:GetMarker(self.event_start_marker))
	character_util.set_direction(bank_robbery_member, 'right')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(bank_robbery_member, 0, 0)
	bank_robbery_member.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.1, 0.5, 1.7))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	-- 리스너 해제
	local bank_robbery_member = self.get_bank_robbery_member()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(bank_robbery_member, self.cs_controller)

	self.password_table = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		return false
	end

	local bank_robbery_member = self.get_bank_robbery_member()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bank_robbery_member) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.answer_password, self, bank_robbery_member)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:answer_password(bank_robbery_member)
	-- 은행강도 멤버 앞으로 align_party
	party_util.align_to_target(bank_robbery_member, bank_robbery_member.Direction, 1, 'linear')

	-- 뭐하다 이제 온 거야?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 이러다 작전에 늦겠어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 뭐, 아무리 바빠도 확인은 해야겠지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 3, skip = true })


	-- 읖어봐!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 6, skip = true })

	-- 패스워드 4개 입력
	local is_correct = true
	for i = 1, #self.password_table do
		local result = nil
		if i == 1 or i == 4 then
			result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
				{ self.num_key .. 1, 'normal' },
				{ self.num_key .. 2, 'normal' },
				{ self.num_key .. 3, 'normal' },
				{ self.num_key .. 4, 'normal' },
				{ self.num_key .. 5, 'normal' },
				{ self.num_key .. 6, 'normal' } })
		else
			result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
				{ self.num_key .. 4, 'normal' },
				{ self.num_key .. 5, 'normal' },
				{ self.num_key .. 6, 'normal' },
				{ self.num_key .. 7, 'normal' },
				{ self.num_key .. 8, 'normal' },
				{ self.num_key .. 9, 'normal' } }) + 3
		end
		if result ~= self.password_table[i] then
			is_correct = is_correct and false
		end
	end

	-- 오답일 경우
	if not is_correct then
		self:wrong_answer(bank_robbery_member)
		return
	end


	-- 정답이야
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 7, skip = true })

	-- 듣던 것과 판박이라 너인 줄 알았어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 8, skip = true })

	-- 다들 기다리고 있으니, 빨리 가보는게 좋을 거야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 9, skip = true })


	-- 서브 스테이지 오픈
	--stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
	--	substage_name = '',
	--	substage_open_string_key = ''
	--})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bank_robbery_member)
	bank_robbery_member.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	character_util.set_position(bank_robbery_member, vector(999, 0, 999))
	-- 프리 섹션 클리어
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(user_party.Leader)

	floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party.Leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

function local_class:wrong_answer(bank_robbery_member)
	-- 오답이야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 10, skip = true })

	-- 설마… 너?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 11, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'scared'})
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 농담이야. 이렇게 생긴 사람이 또 있을리 없지
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 12, skip = true })

	-- 그래도 원칙은 원칙이니…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 13, skip = true })

	-- 정답을 맞출 때까진 지나갈 수 없어.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bank_robbery_member)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 14, skip = true })

	-- 잘 기억 안 나면 시원한 음료수라도 마시면서 다시 생각해보라고.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bank_robbery_member, { key = self.script_key .. 5, skip = true })
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.intro_zone and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader)
				and self.is_first then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.robbery_scene_intro, self))
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.robs[2]) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.robbery_scene_intro, self))
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:robbery_scene_intro()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()


	if self.is_first then
		self.is_first = false
		camera_util.move(self.robs[2].Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 2)
		party_util.align_party(self.robs[2].Position + vector(1.5, 0, -1), 'right', 2, 'linear')

		character_util.set_direction(self.robs[1], 'right')
		character_util.normal_double_jump(self.robs[1], true)
		--가면1: 늦었어. 주인공은 늦게 온다 이거냐?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.set_anim(self.robs[1], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.robs[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true})
		character_util.remove_anim(self.robs[1])
		--가면3: 네가 그 헤실헤실한 얼굴이 아니었다면 쏴버렸을 거라고.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.set_anim(self.robs[3], {name = 'bomb_idle'})
		character_util.set_direction(self.robs[3], 'right')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.robs[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 2, skip = true})
		character_util.remove_anim(self.robs[3])
		--가면2: 모두 조용.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.robs[2], {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})
		--가면2: 이곳은 튜링에 적대하는 마피아 조직들이 자금을 세탁하는 은행이다.
		character_util.set_direction(self.robs[1], 'up')
		character_util.set_direction(self.robs[3], 'up')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.robs[2], {key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true})
		--가면3: 그럼… 위험한 거 아냐?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.robs[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true})

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldBankRobberySection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @

		Comment = 은행강도 변장 이후 첫 전투 @

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec


	self.intro_offset = {
		vector(1, 0, -1.5),
		vector(0, 0, 0.5),
		vector(-0.5, 0, -2),
		vector(0.5, 0, -2.5),
		vector(999, 0, 999),

	}

	self.intro_dir = {
		'up',
		'down',
		'up',
		'up',
		'right',
		'right',
	}

	self.hostage_offset = {
		vector(-3, 0, 2),
		vector(-4, 0, -1),
		vector(-2, 0, 3),
		vector(2, 0, 3),
		vector(-3, 0, -2),
		vector(-2, 0, -2),
		vector(1, 0, -3),
		vector(1, 0, 3),
	}


	self.intro_zone = 'bank_intro_zone'

	self.default_wave = {}
	self.first_wave = {}
	self.second_wave = {}
	self.third_wave = {}

	self.battle_wave_name = 'bank_hall_battle_'

	self.playstate_enum = {
		init = 1,
		prebattle = 2,
		battle_1 = 3,
		battle_2 = 4,
		battle_3 = 5,
		battle_clear = 6,
		fail = 7,
	}

	self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.init

	self.call_blocked = false

	self.retry = false

	self.call_duration = 5

	self.talk_name = 'demonworld_bank_robbery_s2_'
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.sub_stage_name then return true end

	self.entrance_marker = field:GetMarker('bank_hall_entrance')
	self.hall_marker = field:GetMarker('bank_hall_center')
	self.vault_marker = field:GetMarker('vault_entrance')

	self.intro_marker = field:GetMarker('robbery_intro_align')
	self.player = self.controller.get_player()
	self.robs = {}
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local rob = self.controller.get_robbery(i)
		self.robs[i] = rob
		character_util.set_position(rob, self.intro_marker.position + self.intro_offset[i])
		character_util.set_direction(rob, self.intro_dir[i])
	end

	self.default_pos = {}
	self.default_first = get_character('police_0_0')

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local police = get_character('police_'.. 0 .. '_' .. i )
		table.insert(self.default_wave, police)
		table.insert(self.default_pos, police.Position)
	end
	for i = 1, 5 do
		table.insert(self.first_wave, get_character('police_'.. 1 .. '_' .. i ))
	end
	for i = 1, 5 do
		table.insert(self.second_wave, get_character('police_'.. 2 .. '_' .. i ))
	end
	for i = 1, 5 do
		table.insert(self.third_wave, get_character('police_'.. 3 .. '_' .. i ))
	end

	self.counter = {
		get_field_object('bank_counter_1'),
		get_field_object('bank_counter_2'),
	}

	self.bank_workers = {
		get_character('bank_worker_1'),
		get_character('bank_worker_2'),
	}

	self.hostages = {}
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local hostage = self.controller.get_hostage(i)
		self.hostages[i] = hostage
		character_util.look_at(hostage, self.default_first)
	end

	-- ShootHelper 로드
	local pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
	local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
	local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('rifle_bullet_long_dist'):Clone()

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.robs[1])
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, proj_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('lower_stair_exit_door', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('bank_main_entrance_door', true))

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 1 then
		character_util.add_listener(self.robs[2], self.controller)
		--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_stage_enter, self))
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bank_intro_scene, self, false))
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_stage_enter()
	character_util.add_listener(self.robs[2], self.controller)

	party_util.align_party(self.robs[2].Position + vector(6, 0, -2), 'right', 0, 'linear')
	character_util.move_to(self.player, self.player.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1, nil, true, true)
	--TODO 대체 오프닝 연출
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field'})
	character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'smile'})

	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.player)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent.Instance)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadStageTitle()
end

function local_class:robbery_reset(pos)
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local target = self.robs[i]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(target)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
		if pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(target, self.intro_marker.position + self.intro_offset[i])
			character_util.set_direction(target, self.intro_dir[i])
		end

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.sender = target
		heal_info.target = target
		heal_info.heal = target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
	end

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.sender = self.player
	heal_info.target = self.player
	heal_info.heal = self.player.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.sub_stage_name then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.robs[2]) and
				self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.init then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bank_intro_scene, self, true))
		end

		for i = 1, #self.counter do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.counter[i]) then
				self.call_blocked = true
			end
		end

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_wave_name .. i then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.call_battle_group, self, i + 1))
			end
		end

	end
	return false
end

function local_class:block_call(index)
	if self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.fail then return end
	local npc = self.bank_workers[index]
	self.counter[index].Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, {name = 'eat'}, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.show_attack_timer(npc, self.call_duration)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'bank_call', self.counter[index], true)

	--전투 중 대사
	--가면2: 놈들을 막아!
	--가면3: 직원들이 외부에 전화를 걸지 못하게 해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.robs[2], {key = self.talk_name .. 'battle_1', bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.robs[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 'battle_2'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.robs[3],
			{ key = self.talk_name .. 'battle_2', bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(-300, 250) })


	local timer = self.call_duration
	while timer > 0 and not self.call_blocked do
		timer = timer - unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove('bank_call')

	if self.call_blocked then
		self.call_blocked = false
		-- 저지에 성공함
		character_util.hide_attack_timer(npc)
		self.counter[index].Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance


		character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.player, {name = 'attack', count = 1})
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})
		character_util.normal_jump_async(npc, true)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'scared'})
	else

		self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.fail
		self.player.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Immortal = true

		--buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.player, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.player, 'defense_up_permill_persistent')

		character_util.hide_attack_timer(npc)

		local battle = stage.BattleManager:CreateBattleInstance()

		for _, v in ipairs(self.default_wave) do
			character_util.convert_to_npc(v)

		for _, v in ipairs(self.first_wave) do
			character_util.convert_to_npc(v)
		end
		for _, v in ipairs(self.second_wave) do
			character_util.convert_to_npc(v)
		end
		for _, v in ipairs(self.third_wave) do
			character_util.convert_to_npc(v)
		end

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		for i = 1, 4 do
			character_util.set_side_direction(self.robs[i])
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.robs[i], {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'scared'})
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		local siren = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_siren_oneshot_01', loop = true})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		character_util.set_side_direction(self.player)

function local_class:call_battle_group(index)
	local routines = {}
	if index == 1 then
		if self.playstate ~= self.playstate_enum.prebattle then
			return
		end
		self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.battle_1
		-- 웨이브 동안 bgm이 전투로 고정되도록 필드 bgm을 비워서 자동으로 돌아가지 않도록 함.
		music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })
		stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = false
		for _, target in ipairs(self.default_wave) do
			character_util.convert_to_monster(target, self.battle_wave_name .. index, 'bank_main_hall' )
			command_util.execute_monster_notice(target, self.player, "battle")
		end
		table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(self.enter_from_vault, self, self.first_wave[1], vector(0, 0, 0), index))
		for i = 2, 5 do
			table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(self.enter_from_entrance, self, self.first_wave[i], vector(0, 0, 3 - i), index))
		end

		wait_all(routines)
	elseif index == 2 then
		if self.playstate ~= self.playstate_enum.battle_1 then
			return
		end
		self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.battle_2
		table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(self.enter_from_vault, self, self.second_wave[1], vector(0, 0, 0), index))
		for i = 2, 5 do
			table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(self.enter_from_entrance, self, self.second_wave[i], vector(0, 0, 3 - i), index))
		end

		-- 외부와 연락하려는 직원
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.block_call, self, 1))

		wait_all(routines)
	elseif index == 3 then
		if self.playstate ~= self.playstate_enum.battle_2 then
			return
		end
		self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.battle_3
		table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(self.enter_from_vault, self, self.third_wave[1], vector(0, 0, 0), index))
		for i = 2, 5 do
			table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(self.enter_from_entrance, self, self.third_wave[i], vector(0, 0, 3 - i), index))
		end
		-- 외부와 연락하려는 직원
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.block_call, self, 2))

		wait_all(routines)
	elseif self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.battle_3 then
		stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = true
		self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.battle_clear

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2.0})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_battle_fanfare_01')
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		--TODO: 전투 완료시 처리
		for i = 1, 6 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. i))
		end
		for i = 1, 4 do
			character_util.convert_to_npc(self.robs[i])
		end
		wait_for_sec(1)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		--전투 종료
		--fade out - 정렬
		--buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.player, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.player, 'attack_up_permill_persistent')
		--buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.player, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.player, 'defense_up_permill_persistent')

		self:robbery_reset()
		camera_util.move(self.hall_marker.position, 0)

		local offsets = {
			vector(1, 0, -0.5),
			vector(0.5, 0, 1),
			vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			vector(-1.5, 0, 0.5),
			vector(2.5, 0, 0.5)
		}
		local dirs = {
			'up',
			'down',
			'up',
			'right',
			'left'
		}
		for i = 1, 4 do
			character_util.set_position(self.robs[i], self.hall_marker.position + offsets[i])
			character_util.set_direction(self.robs[i], dirs[i])
		end
		character_util.set_position(self.player, self.hall_marker.position + offsets[5])
		character_util.set_direction(self.player, dirs[5])

		for i = 1, 2 do
			worker = get_character('bank_worker_' .. i)
			table.insert(self.hostages, worker)
		end


		for i = 1, #self.hostages do
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.hostages[i], {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'scared'})
			character_util.set_position(self.hostages[i], self.hall_marker.position + self.hostage_offset[i])

	local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
	local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('rifle_bullet_long_dist'):Clone()

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.robs[1])
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, proj_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('bank_main_entrance_door', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('lower_stair_exit_door', true))

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 2 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_intro_scene, self))
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_intro_scene, self, true))
	end


	return true
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.sub_stage_name then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		if e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile then
			for i = 1, #self.hostages do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.hostages[i].npc) then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_killed, self, self.hostages[i]))
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.activity then
			for i = 1, #self.hostages do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hostages[i].npc) then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_warned, self, self.hostages[i], self.timer))
					return true
				end
			end
		elseif self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.init and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.robs[2]) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:hostage_check_routine(continued)
	-- 마지막 순번 인질은 연출에서 이미 죽었다.
	for i = 1, #self.hostages - 1 do
		-- 이미 추가되어있는 경우 contains 체크해서 return하기 때문에 문제가 없다
		character_util.set_active_state(self.hostages[i].npc, 'enabled')
		stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(self.hostages[i].npc)
		self.hostages[i].npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.hostages[i].npc.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(CS.Oak.DeathType.None)
		self.hostages[i].init_pos = self.hall_marker.position + self.hostage_offset[i]
		self.hostages[i].init_dir = self.hostages[i].npc.Direction
		character_util.set_position(self.hostages[i].npc, self.hostages[i].init_pos)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.hostages[i].npc)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.hostages[i].npc, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'scared'})
		self.hostages[i].warn_time = 0
		self.hostages[i].state = self.hostage_state.idle
	end
	self.hostages[#self.hostages].state = self.hostage_state.dead

	self.robs[2].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.robs[1].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_direction(self.robs[2], 'down')

	if continued then
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	timer_util.start_timer({duration = self.play_time, handler = self})

	-- 내비바 버튼 임시로 여기서 On
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = true

	self.alive = #self.hostages - 1
	self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.activity
	self.timer = 0

	local thres = 2
	local critical = nil

	--local attack_range_renderer = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(self.player, self.sight_distance, self.sight_angle)
	--attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Show(0)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	--인질 감시 루프
	while self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.activity do
		--attack_range_renderer:Update(self.player)

		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local limit = self.actor_limit[math.floor(self.timer / (self.play_time/3)) + 1]

		if self.alive < 5 then
			self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.kill_fail
			break
		end

		if self.timer >= self.play_time then
			self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.clear
			break
		end

		if thres < self.timer then
			thres = thres + 4
			local actor_count = 0
			local actors = {}
			for _, hostage in ipairs(self.hostages) do
				if hostage.state == self.hostage_state.run then
					actor_count = actor_count + 1
					if hostage.npc.Position.x > self.entrance_marker.position.x - 2 then
						self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.fail
						critical = hostage.npc
						character_util.remove_relate_event(hostage.npc, self.controller)
						break
					end
				end
				if hostage.state == self.hostage_state.call then
					actor_count = actor_count + 1
					if hostage.warn_time < self.timer then
						self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.fail
						critical = hostage.npc
						character_util.remove_relate_event(hostage.npc, self.controller)
						break
					end
				end

				if hostage.warn_time < self.timer then
					if hostage.state == self.hostage_state.idle then
						table.insert(actors, hostage)
						--if not self:direction_checker(hostage.npc) then
						--end
					elseif hostage.state == self.hostage_state.wait then
						hostage.state = self.hostage_state.idle
					end
				end
			end

			-- 인질 행동 조건 체크 및 만족시 행동
			while actor_count < limit and #actors > 0 do
				local index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #actors)
				local hostage = actors[index]
				local act = random_util.get_random_int(0, 1)

				if act == 0 then
					-- running
					local pos = self.entrance_marker.position
					if hostage.index < 3 then
					elseif hostage.index < 5 then
						pos = pos + vector(0, 0, 1)
					else
						pos = pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
					end
					hostage.npc.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy
					hostage.state = self.hostage_state.run
					character_util.add_listener(hostage.npc, self.controller)
					character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(hostage.npc, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'scared'})
					character_util.move_waypoint(hostage.npc, {
						vector(hostage.init_pos.x, 0, pos.z),
						pos }, self.run_speed, true, 'stop', 'floor', nil, true)
				else
					-- calling
					hostage.npc.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy
					hostage.state = self.hostage_state.call
					hostage.warn_time = self.timer + self.call_duration
					character_util.add_listener(hostage.npc, self.controller)
					character_util.set_side_direction(hostage.npc)
					character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(hostage.npc, {name = 'eat'}, {name = 'scared'})
					character_util.show_attack_timer(hostage.npc, self.call_duration)
					hostage.sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true})
				end

				actor_count = actor_count + 1
				table.remove(actors, index)
			end
		end

		self.timer = self.timer + dt
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--attack_range_renderer:Dispose()

	for i = 1, #self.hostages do
		self.hostages[i].npc.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral
		self.hostages[i].npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.hostages[i].npc.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	end

	timer_util.end_timer(self)
	if self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.fail then
		--TODO: 실패시 리셋 처리
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(critical, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'attack'})

		camera_util.move_async(critical.Position, 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		for i = 1, #self.hostages - 1 do
			local target = self.hostages[i]
			if target.state == self.hostage_state.call then
				character_util.hide_attack_timer(target.npc)
				if target.sfx ~= nil then
					target.sfx:Stop()
					target.sfx = nil
				end
			elseif target.state == self.hostage_state.run then
				character_util.stop(target.npc)
			end
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(target.npc, 1, 0)
			target.npc.SpineController:RemoveColor('bank_dead', 0)
			character_util.set_position(target.npc, target.init_pos)
			character_util.set_direction(target.npc, target.init_dir)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(target.npc, self.controller)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target.npc)

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(target.npc, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'scared'})
		end
		party_util.align_party(self.robs[2].Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 'right', 0, 'linear')
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hostage_check_routine, self, true))
	elseif self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.kill_fail then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		camera_util.move_async(self.robs[2].Position, 1)
		character_util.look_at(self.robs[2], self.player)
		character_util.set_anim(self.robs[2], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_boss_sapa_shout_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.robs[2], {key = self.talk_name .. 0, skip = true})

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		for i = 1, #self.hostages -1 do
			local target = self.hostages[i]
			if target.state == self.hostage_state.call then
				character_util.hide_attack_timer(target.npc)
				if target.sfx ~= nil then
					target.sfx:Stop()
					target.sfx = nil
				end
			elseif target.state == self.hostage_state.run then
				character_util.stop(target.npc)
			end
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(target.npc, 1, 0)
			target.npc.SpineController:RemoveColor('bank_dead', 0)
			character_util.set_position(target.npc, target.init_pos)
			character_util.set_direction(target.npc, target.init_dir)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(target.npc, self.controller)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target.npc)

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(target.npc, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'scared'})
		end
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.robs[2])
		party_util.align_party(self.robs[2].Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 'right', 0, 'linear')
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hostage_check_routine, self, true))
	else
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		--TODO: 클리어시 처리
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_activity_clear_01')
		for _, hostage in ipairs(self.hostages) do
			if hostage.alive then
				character_util.remove_relate_event(hostage.npc, self.controller)
				character_util.hide_attack_timer(hostage.npc)
				character_util.stop(hostage.npc)
				if hostage.sfx ~= nil then
					hostage.sfx:Stop()
					hostage.sfx = nil
				end
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		party_util.align_to_target(self.robs[2], 'right', 0)

		self.robs[1].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

		for _, hostage in ipairs(self.hostages) do
			if hostage.alive then
				character_util.set_position(hostage.npc, hostage.init_pos)
				character_util.set_direction(hostage.npc, hostage.init_dir)
				character_util.remove_relate_event(hostage.npc, self.controller)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hostage.npc)
			else
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hostage.npc)
				character_util.set_active_state(hostage.npc, 'disabled')
			end
		end

		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	end
end

function local_class:get_killed(target)
	local npc = target.npc
	if target.state == self.hostage_state.call then
		character_util.hide_attack_timer(npc)
		if target.sfx ~= nil then
			target.sfx:Stop()
			target.sfx = nil
		end
	elseif target.state == self.hostage_state.run then
		character_util.stop(npc)
	end
	target.alive = false
	target.state = self.hostage_state.dead

	self.alive = self.alive - 1

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_harvester_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(npc.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npc)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(npc)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(npc, self.controller)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

	npc.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral
	npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	npc.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NoneAttackableDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.set_side_direction(npc)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, {name = 'dead', loop = false}, {name = 'damaged'})
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
end

function local_class:get_warned(target, stamp)
	local npc = target.npc
	if target.state == self.hostage_state.call then
		character_util.hide_attack_timer(npc)
		if target.sfx ~= nil then
			target.sfx:Stop()
			target.sfx = nil
		end
	else
		character_util.stop(npc)
	end

	target.warn_time = stamp + 7
	target.state = self.hostage_state.stun

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_costume_equip_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(npc.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0))
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.player, {name = 'attack', count = 1, scale = 1.5})
	npc.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral
	character_util.remove_relate_event(npc, self.controller)

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npc)

	character_util.set_side_direction(npc)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})

	character_util.remove_anim(npc)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(npc, { vector(target.init_pos.x, 0, npc.Position.z), target.init_pos },

	character_util.set_direction(npc, target.init_dir)

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.sub_stage_name then return false end

	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'upper_floor_grid') then
		if self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.init then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'bank_robbery_s4', self.main_security, true)
		elseif self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.security_start then
			quest_marker_util.remove('bank_robbery_s4')
			for i, rod in ipairs(self.security_rod) do
				if rod.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'bank_security_'..i, self.security_com[i], true)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.sub_stage_name then return false end

	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'upper_floor_grid') then
		if self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.security_start then
			for i, rod in ipairs(self.security_rod) do
				if rod.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
					quest_marker_util.remove('bank_security_'..i)
				end
			end
		end
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'bank_robbery_s4', self.lower_stair, true)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.sub_stage_name then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		for i, com in ipairs(self.security_com) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, com) then
				self.security_state[i] = false
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.release_security, self, i)
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'security_zone' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.player)
				and self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.init and e.FullEnter then
			self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.security_start
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.security_start_scene, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name and self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.security_clear then
			self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.battle_clear
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.after_battle, self)
		end
	end
	return false
end

		table.insert(self.hostages, worker)

		table.insert(self.polices, waves)

	self.item_2.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.robs[2])

			ps, proj_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

	get_field_object('vault_main_door').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('bank_main_entrance_door', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('lower_stair_entrance_door', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('lower_stair_exit_door', true))
	for i = 1, 6 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.hall_battle_gate_name .. i))
	end

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'bank_robbery_s5', self.upper_stair, true)

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 4 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_stage_enter, self))

	return true

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.sub_stage_name then return false end

	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'upper_floor_grid') then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'bank_robbery_s5', self.upper_stair, true)
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'bank_basement_grid') then
		if self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.safe then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 1})
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'bank_robbery_s5', self.robs[2], true)
		else
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 0.6})
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.sub_stage_name then return false end

	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'upper_floor_grid') then
		if self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.init then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'bank_robbery_s5', self.robs[1], true)
		else
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'bank_robbery_s5', self.vault_hole, true)
		end
	elseif type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'bank_basement_grid') then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 1})
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'bank_robbery_s5', self.robs[2], true)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.sub_stage_name then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FallInHoleEndEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_fallin_hole_end_event, self, e))
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.player) and e.FullEnter then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.basement_battle_front and self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.basement then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fleeing_leader, self))
			end
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.robs[3]) and e.FullEnter
				and e.Zone.Name == self.hole_zone_name and self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.not_safe then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.robbery_in_the_hole, self, 3))
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.robs[4]) and e.FullEnter
				and e.Zone.Name == self.hole_zone_name and self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.not_safe then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.robbery_in_the_hole, self, 4))
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.robs[1]) and self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.init then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.police_entrance, self)
		end
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.corpses[i]) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(field_ui_util.show_narration_async, {key = self.talk_name .. 0})
			end
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.basement_exit) and self.playstate == self.playstate_enum.basement_battle then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.last_scene, self))
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.qte_complete = true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == self.hall_battle_wave_name .. 4 then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'bank_robbery_s5', self.vault_hole, true)
			for i = 1, 6 do

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	local moved_object = e.FieldObject
	local offsets = {
		vector(-0.1, 0.3, 0),
		vector(0.2, 0.3, 0),
		vector(0.1, 0.5, 0),
		vector(-0.3, 0.35, 0),
		vector(-0.2, 0.5, 0),
		vector(0.35, 0.3, 0),
		vector(0.27, 0.5, 0),
	}

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(moved_object, self.item_1) then
		if #self.items_1 > 0 then
			local is_holding = self.robs[4].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
					lua_helper.type_compare(self.robs[4].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)

			if (is_holding) then
				for i, v in ipairs(self.items_1) do
					v.Position = moved_object.Position + offsets[i]
				end
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(moved_object, self.item_2) then
		if #self.items_2 > 0 then
			local is_holding = self.robs[2].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
					lua_helper.type_compare(self.robs[2].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)

			if (is_holding) then
				for i, v in ipairs(self.items_2) do
					v.Position = moved_object.Position + offsets[i]
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

			local target = nil

				target = self.robs[3]

				target = self.robs[4]
			end
			if target == nil then return end

			self.mine_passed = true
			self.playstate = self.playstate_enum.safe

			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 1})
			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

			local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall()
			free_fall:SetParameters(0.7, 8, 0)

			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

			while free_fall:GetProgress() < 1 do
				free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
				character_util.set_position(target, self.basement_marker.position + vector(0, 8 + free_fall:GetDistance(), 0))
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(target)

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mine_field_explode, self))

function local_class:back_to_car(target, taxi, offset)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(target, {
		vector(target.Position.x, 0, pos.z),
		pos
	}, 3, false, 'stop', 'floor')
end

function local_class:throw_all(item_table, dist)
	local t = {}
	for i, v in ipairs(item_table) do
		table.insert(t, v)
		item_table[i] = nil
	end
	local routines = {}
	for _, v in ipairs(t) do
		table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(function()
			local timer = 0.5
			local init_pos = v.Position
			while timer >  0 do
				v.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(init_pos, init_pos + dist, 1 - (timer / 0.5))
				timer = timer - unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end))
		table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async, v, 0, 0.5))
	end
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_turn_page_02')
	wait_all(routines)
	for _, v in ipairs(t) do
		v:ConsumeComplete()
	end
end

	secretary.Interactable =  CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

end

end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.event_pre_zone) and
				not self.controller.interacting and self.controller.can_operate_quest and not self.is_pre_event_playing then

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.play_pre_dialogue_event, self))

			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.event_start_zone) and
				not self.controller.interacting and self.controller.can_operate_quest then
			self.controller.interacting = true
			self:remove_pre_event_sb()
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.boss_secretary_scene, self)

			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:play_pre_dialogue_event()
	self.is_pre_event_playing = true

	local boss = self.controller.get_boss()
	local secretary = self.controller.get_secretary()

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(secretary, { key = 'demon_world_boss_secretary_42' })

	if self.controller.interacting == true then
		return
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss, { key = 'demon_world_boss_secretary_43' })

	self.is_pre_event_playing = false
end

function local_class:remove_pre_event_sb()
	local boss = self.controller.get_boss()
	local secretary = self.controller.get_secretary()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(boss)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(secretary)
