local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldBullyKidPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = DemonWorldBullyKid @
		Comment = 이벤트 완료 이후 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 꼬마 아이 세팅
	local boy = self.controller.get_boy()
	local boy_pos = self.controller.get_bully_kid_trash_point().position
	character_util.set_position(boy, boy_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(boy, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(boy, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'cry' })
	self.controller.is_boy_alpha = true

	-- 여자 아이들 세팅
	local dir = { 'right', 'down', 'left' }
	local add_pos_array = {
		vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		vector(0, 0, 0.5),
		vector(0.5, 0, 0),
	}

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local girl = self.controller.get_girl(i)
		local pos = boy_pos + add_pos_array[i]

		girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_direction(girl, dir[i])
		character_util.set_position(girl, pos)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(girl, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.add_listener(girl, self.controller)
	end

	-- post면 이미 쓰레기통 이벤트를 보았기에 true로
	self.controller.is_show_garbage_event = true

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local girl = self.controller.get_girl(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(girl, self.controller)
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local girl = self.controller.get_girl(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, girl) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(girl, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_' .. (57 + i) })
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

return local_class

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- Zone and Battle Group
	self.kid_bully_zone = 'bully_kid_battle_zone'
	self.sister_zone = 'bully_kid_sister_zone'
	self.battle_group = 'bully_kid_battle'

	-- 깡패들이 말하고 있는지
	self.player_talk_bad_guys = false

	-- 여자아이들이 말하고 있는지
	self.player_talk_girls = false

	-- 쓰레기통 흔들거리고 있는지?
	self.trash_can_shaking = true

	-- 스타피스 이름
	self.star_piece_name = 'bully_kid_star_piece'

	-- FX_dead 이팩트 가져오기
	self.get_dead_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead') end

	-- Markers
	self.get_bully_kid_girls_point = function(index) return field:GetMarker('bully_kid_girls_point_' .. index) end
	self.get_bully_kid_leader_point = function() return field:GetMarker('bully_kid_leader_point') end

	-- 퀘스트 진행 상태
	self.section_state = { none = 1, battle_bad_guy = 2, battle_end = 3, interact_kid = 4, ending = 5 }
	self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.none
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 여자아이들 초기 위치로 세팅
	local girls_pos = self.get_bully_kid_girls_point(1).position
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local girl = self.controller.get_girl(i)
		character_util.set_position(girl, girls_pos + vector(0.5 * i, 0, 0))
		character_util.add_listener(girl, self.controller)
	end

	-- 깡패들 초기 위치로 세팅
	local dir_array = { 'down', 'right', 'up' }
	local pos_array = {
		vector(43, 0, 5.5),
		vector(42, 0, 4.5),
		vector(43, 0, 3.5),
	}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local bad_guy = self.controller.get_bad_guy(i)
		local target_pos = pos_array[i]
		character_util.set_position(bad_guy, target_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(bad_guy, dir_array[i])
		character_util.add_listener(bad_guy, self.controller)
	end

	-- 쓰레기통 초기 위치로 세팅
	local trash_can = self.controller.get_trash_can()
	local trash_can_pos = vector(41, 0, 6.5)
	trash_can.Position = trash_can_pos

	-- 꼬마도 같은 위치로 세팅
	local boy = self.controller.get_boy()
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(boy, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(boy, trash_can_pos)
	character_util.add_listener(boy, self.controller)

	-- 쓰레기통 흔들리게 세팅
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shake_trash_can, self))
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_dead_effect()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local bad_guy = self.controller.get_bad_guy(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(bad_guy, self.controller)
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local girl = self.controller.get_girl(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(girl, self.controller)
	end

	local boy = self.controller.get_boy()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(boy, self.controller)

	self.trash_can_shaking = false

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		return false
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.kid_bully_zone) then
		if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.none and not self.player_talk_bad_guys then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bad_guys_talking, self))
		elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.ending then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self)
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.sister_zone) and
			not self.player_talk_girls then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.girls_talking, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		return false
	end

	-- 여자 아이들 상호작용 체크
	if self.cur_section_state ~= self.section_state.ending then
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local girl = self.controller.get_girl(i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, girl) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_to_sister, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	local boy = self.controller.get_boy()
	if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		-- 아직 아무것도 진행하지 않았을 때
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, boy) then
			-- 흑, 누나…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(boy, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_1' })
		else
			for i = 1, 3 do
				local bad_guy = self.controller.get_bad_guy(i)
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bad_guy) then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_bad_guy, self)
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.interact_kid then
		-- 전투가 끝난 후 꼬마와 상호작용 했을 때
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, boy) then
			-- 이제 누나들 눈만 피하면…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(boy, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_23' })
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group and self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.battle_bad_guy then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_bad_guys, self))
	end
end

-- 깡패 존에 처음 입장했을 때
function local_class:bad_guys_talking()
	self.player_talk_bad_guys = false
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local bad_guy = self.controller.get_bad_guy(i)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bad_guy, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_' .. (i + 4) })
		if self.player_talk_bad_guys or not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
			break
		end
	end
end

-- 처음에 여자 아이들 존으로 도착했을 때
function local_class:girls_talking()
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local girl = self.controller.get_girl(i)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_' .. (i + 1) })
		if self.player_talk_girls or not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
			break
		end
	end
end

-- 깡패들을 다 무찔렀을 때
function local_class:defeat_bad_guys()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.battle_end

	local boy = self.controller.get_boy()
	local trash_can = self.controller.get_trash_can()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent.Create(self.controller.my_quest_key, false))
	party_util.align_party(boy.Position, 'right', 0, 'arc')
	character_util.add_listener(self.controller.get_boy(), self.controller)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.trash_can_shaking = false
	self.controller.is_boy_alpha = true
	self.controller.is_show_garbage_event = true
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bomb_holdup_fail_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	trash_can:Shake(0.08, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bomb_holdup_fail_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- FX_dead 이펙트를 출력하며 쓰레기통 사라지고 남자아이 down, tired, 1회 jump로 등장.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.get_dead_effect():Instantiate(trash_can.Position)
	trash_can.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(boy, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_emotion(boy, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.mario_jump_async(boy, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(boy, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	-- 남자 꼬마 (right, attack, idle) : 와… 진짜 쎄다…!
	character_util.remove_anim(boy)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_19', skip = true })

	-- 남자 꼬마 (right, idle, idle) : 아, 누나들이 이럴 땐 꼭 감사하다고 인사하랬어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_20', skip = true })

	-- 남자 꼬마 (right, smile, cast2) : 정말 고맙습니다 기사님!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim(boy, { name = 'cast2', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_21', skip = true })

	-- 기사 left, attack, release(2회) 실행. 이후 꼬마 대사 진행.
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01', keep_anim = false })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy)

	-- 남자 꼬마 (right, attack, idle, jump 1회) : 실은 잔소리가 심한 누나들이랑 싸워서 집을 나왔거든요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(boy, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_22', skip = true })

	-- 남자 꼬마 (right, tired, cross_arm) : 그냥 무작정 전에 친구들이랑 놀던 곳에 왔는데…
	character_util.set_anim(boy, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_22_1', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(boy)

	-- 남자 꼬마 (right, tired, cross_arm) : 저렇게 무서운 형들이 있을 줄은 몰랐어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_22_2', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy)

	-- 남자 꼬마 (right, smile, cast2) : 기사 님이 아니었다면 정말 큰일 났을 거예요!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(boy, { name = 'cast2', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_22_3', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy)
	character_util.set_emotion(boy, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.add_listener(self.controller.get_boy(), self.controller)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 이제 누나들 눈만 피하면…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(boy, { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_23' })
	self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.interact_kid
end

-- 여자아이들과 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:talk_to_sister()
	self.player_talk_girls = true

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local girls = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local girl = self.controller.get_girl(i)
		table.insert(girls, girl)
	end

	party_util.align_party(girls[2].Position, 'down', 0.6, 'arc')

	--여자 꼬마 2 (down, tired) : 이런 위험한 곳에서…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(girls[2], { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girls[2], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_24', skip = true })

	--여자 꼬마 1 (down, tired) : 혼자 있으면 위험한데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(girls[1], { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girls[1], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_25', skip = true })

	--여자 꼬마 3 (down, tired) : 도대체 어디있는 거람…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(girls[3], { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girls[3], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_26', skip = true })

	--기사 머리 위로 (emoticon_bubble_question) 말풍선 출력.
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	--여자 꼬마 2 (down, idle) : 아, 사실 같이 놀고 있던 남동생이 있는데…
	character_util.remove_emotion(girls[2])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girls[2], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_27', skip = true })

	--여자 꼬마 1 (down, idle) : 잠깐 한눈 판 사이에 사라져 버렸어요…
	character_util.remove_emotion(girls[1])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girls[1], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_28', skip = true })

	--여자 꼬마 3 (down, idle) : 이런 무서운 곳에 혼자서 있다고 생각하면…
	character_util.remove_emotion(girls[3])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girls[3], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_29', skip = true })

	--꼬마 아이들 표정 일제히 tired로 변경. 이후 1초 간격을 두고 하단 선택지 출력
	character_util.set_group_emotion(girls, { name = 'tired' })

	local choose_list
	if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.interact_kid then
		choose_list = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--찾아보겠다.
			{ 'demon_world_bully_kid_29_1', 'normal' },
			--주차장에서 본 것 같은데…
			{ 'demon_world_bully_kid_29_2', 'intellect' }
		})
	else
		choose_list = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			-- 찾아보겠다.
			{ 'demon_world_bully_kid_29_1', 'normal' }
		})
	end

	if choose_list == 1 then
		-- 꼭 부탁드려요 기사님…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girls[2], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_29_3', skip = true })

		-- 우리에겐 동생이…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girls[1], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_29_4', skip = true })

		--꼭 필요하거든요…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girls[3], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_29_5', skip = true })

		for i = 1, #girls do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(girls[i])
		end
	else
		--여자 꼬마 2 (down, smile) : 주차장이요?
		character_util.set_emotion(girls[2], { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girls[2], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_30', skip = true })

		--여자 꼬마 1 (down, smile) : 무서워서 거기까지 도망간거구나…
		character_util.set_emotion(girls[1], { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girls[1], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_31', skip = true })

		--여자 꼬마 3 (down, smile) : 우리가 지켜줘야 해!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(girls[3], { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girls[3], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_32', skip = true })

		character_util.set_group_emotion(girls, { name = 'awesome' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
		local target_pos = girls[3].Position + vector(14, 0, 0)
		character_util.move_waypoint(girls[1], target_pos, 8, true, 'stop', 'floor')
		character_util.move_waypoint(girls[2], target_pos, 8, true, 'stop', 'floor')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(girls[3], target_pos, 8, true, 'stop', 'floor')

		-- 여자아이들 주차장으로 이동
		local index_array = { 1, 4, 3 }
		local dir_array = { 'right', 'down', 'left' }
		for i = 1, #girls do
			girls[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(girls[i])
			character_util.set_emotion(girls[i], { name = 'doyagao' })
			character_util.set_direction(girls[i], dir_array[i])
			character_util.set_position(girls[i], self.controller.get_bully_kid_trash_center_point(index_array[i]).position)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(girls[i], self.controller)
		end

		--꼬마 위치 설정
		local boy = self.controller.get_boy()
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy)
		character_util.set_emotion(boy, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_direction(boy, 'up')
		character_util.set_position(boy, self.controller.get_bully_kid_trash_point().position)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(boy, self.controller)

		-- 섹션 상태 엔딩으로 변경
		self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.ending
	end
end

-- 깡패들과 대화
function local_class:interact_bad_guy()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent.Create(self.controller.my_quest_key, false))

	self.player_talk_bad_guys = true

	-- 불량배 세팅
	local bad_guys = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local bad_guy = self.controller.get_bad_guy(i)
		table.insert(bad_guys, bad_guy)
	end

	-- 리더는 앞으로 나머지 파티원 뒤로
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local target_pos = bad_guys[2].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_to(leader, target_pos, 0.5, nil, true, true)
	local party_n = user_party.Count - 1
	local gap = 0.75
	local z_pos = (party_n - 1) * gap * 0.5
	for i = 1, party_n do
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], target_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, z_pos),
				0.5, nil, true, true)
		z_pos = z_pos - gap
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	for i = 0, party_n do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'right')
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 그 꼬맹이 분명 이쪽으로 왔는데…!
	character_util.set_emotion(bad_guys[1], { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bad_guys[1], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_7_1', skip = true })

	-- 오랜만에 보리차 값좀 버나 했더니…
	character_util.set_emotion(bad_guys[1], { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bad_guys[3], { key = 'demon_world_bully_kid_7_2', skip = true })

	-- 에이, 가자 가! 다른 놈이나 찾지 뭐.

			yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,

						sphere.transform:SetParent(effect_parent)
						sphere:SetActive(false)
					end)

			for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do

				character_util.set_active_state(user_party[i], 'disabled')
			end

			wait_for_sec(2)

				self.stage_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_event_dw_11', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })
			end

			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

			sphere.transform:SetParent(leader.Transform)
			sphere.transform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.5, 0)
			sphere.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-35, 0, 0)
			sphere:SetActive(true)

			local fall_time = 2.5
			local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
			local start_pos = leader.Position
			local end_pos = vector(start_pos.x, 0.2, start_pos.z)
			local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, start_pos.y, 0)

			local dir_change_time = 0
			local dir_time = 0.1
			local dir_str = {'left', 'up', 'right', 'down'}
			local dir_counter = 1

			local portal_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_portal_05'})
			while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time do
				free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
				local cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance() + 0.2

				character_util.set_position(leader, start_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0), true)

				if unity_class.time.time - cur_time >= dir_change_time then
					dir_change_time = dir_change_time + dir_time
					dir_counter = dir_counter + 1 > 4 and 1 or dir_counter + 1
					character_util.set_direction(leader, dir_str[dir_counter])
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			portal_sfx:FadeOut(1.5)

			character_util.set_position(leader, end_pos, false)
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

				character_util.set_position(user_party[i], leader.Position + vector(i * -0.2, 0, 0))

			end

			party_util.align_to_target(leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 'left', 1)

			coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
					field:GetMarker('default_start').direction, game_string:GetString(stage.Name)))

			demon_world_dollar:remove_dollar_async(self.require_dollar, false, false)

			yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

			if self.resholder ~= nil then

			end

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(workers[1],
				{ key = 'demonworld_crystal_room_27', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rt', offset = workers_offset[1] })
		--거 마음이 바뀌면 다시 오도록 해!
		character_util.remove_anim(workers[1])

		fail()
	end
end

function local_class:make_heavenhold_character(character)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(character.Transform, 'SpecialEvents')
	character.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	character.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
	character_util.set_scale_factor(character, 'heavenhold', 0.5)
end

function local_class:move_heavenhold_camera(camera_transform, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_pos = camera_transform.position

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		camera_transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

return local_class

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_npc = function(name) return get_character(name) end

	-- 교환에 필요한 npc 테이블
	self.exchange_table = {
		{
			stage_name = 'demonworld_part1_1_2',
			npc = {
				{ name = 'exchange_npc_2', order = 2, cb = self.exchange_2, disable = self.disable_npc },
				{ name = 'exchange_npc_3', order = 3, cb = self.exchange_3, disable = self.disable_npc }
			}
		},
		{
			stage_name = 'demonworld_part1_1_3',
			npc = {
				{ name = 'mad_scientist', order = 6, cb = self.exchange_ending, disable = self.disable_npc },
				{ name = 'exchange_npc_1', order = 1, cb = self.exchange_1, disable = self.disable_npc },
				{ name = 'exchange_npc_4_1', order = 4, cb = self.exchange_4, disable = self.disable_npc_4 }
			}
		},
		{
			stage_name = 'substage_12_1',
			npc = {
				{ name = 'exchange_npc_5_1', order = 5, cb = self.exchange_5, disable = self.disable_npc_5 }
			}
		}
	}

	self.current_exchange_table = nil

	self.drop_item = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.controller.exchange_custom_state) == -1 then
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.controller.exchange_custom_state, 1)
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	for i = 1, #self.exchange_table do
		local custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.controller.exchange_custom_state)
		if stage.Name == self.exchange_table[i].stage_name then
			self.current_exchange_table = self.exchange_table[i]
			self:add_listener_next_order(custom_state)

			-- order 완료된 npc disable
			for i = 1, #self.current_exchange_table.npc do
				if self.current_exchange_table.npc[i].order < custom_state then
					self.current_exchange_table.npc[i].disable(self, self.get_npc(self.current_exchange_table.npc[i].name))
				end
			end
			break
		end
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.exchange_table = nil
	self.current_exchange_table = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end


function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_exchange_table == nil then return false end

	for i = 1, #self.current_exchange_table.npc do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_npc(self.current_exchange_table.npc[i].name)) and
				quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.controller.exchange_custom_state) == self.current_exchange_table.npc[i].order then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.current_exchange_table.npc[i].cb, self, self.get_npc(self.current_exchange_table.npc[i].name), self.current_exchange_table.npc[i].order)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 다음 교환 이벤트 NPC addlistener 활성화
function local_class:add_listener_next_order(order)
	for i = 1, #self.current_exchange_table.npc do
		if self.current_exchange_table.npc[i].order == order then
			self.get_npc(self.current_exchange_table.npc[i].name).Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldInfectedPeoplePostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = DemonWorldInfectedPeople @
		Comment = 이벤트 완료 이후 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.star_piece_name = 'infected_people_star_piece'

	self.ellen_point_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('infected_people_prison_ellen_point') end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.quest_progress.Grade == 0 then
		-- 고발 / 추방 엔딩
		local chief = self.controller.get_chief()
		character_util.remove_emotion(chief)
		character_util.set_anim(chief, { name = 'idle' })
		character_util.add_listener(chief, self.controller)

		if self.controller.starting_grade >= 0 then
			-- 클리어 한 이후라면 격리자 촌에 촌장 세팅
			character_util.set_active_state(chief, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_direction(chief, 'right')
			character_util.set_position(chief, self.controller.get_chief_stay_marker().position)
		end

		self.controller:set_default_prison_npc()
	elseif self.quest_progress.Grade == 1 then
		-- 고발 / 감옥 엔딩
		local chief = self.controller.get_chief()
		character_util.remove_emotion(chief)
		character_util.set_anim(chief, { name = 'idle' })
		character_util.add_listener(chief, self.controller)

		local ellen = self.controller.get_ellen()
		character_util.set_active_state(ellen, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(ellen, 'right')
		character_util.set_position(ellen, self.ellen_point_marker().position)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(ellen, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'tired' })
		ellen.SpineController:AddColor(ellen.Name, unity_color({ 0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 1 }), 1, 0)

		if self.controller.starting_grade >= 0 then
			-- 클리어 한 이후라면 격리자 촌에 촌장 세팅
			character_util.set_active_state(chief, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_direction(chief, 'right')
			character_util.set_position(chief, self.controller.get_chief_stay_marker().position)
		else
			-- 막 클리어 한것 이라면 주민 두명은 애드리스너 추가
			for i = 1, 2 do
				local villager = self.controller.get_villager(i)
				character_util.add_listener(villager, self.controller)
			end
		end
		self.controller:set_default_prison_npc()
	elseif self.quest_progress.Grade == 2 then
		-- 해방 엔딩
		local village_center_pos = self.controller.get_center_marker().position
		local ellen = self.controller.get_ellen()
		ellen:HideWeapon(true)
		character_util.set_active_state(ellen, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(ellen, village_center_pos + vector(5, 0, 2.5))
		character_util.set_direction(ellen, 'left')

		local is_first_clear = self.controller.starting_grade < 0
		self.controller:infected_free_ending_npc_setting(is_first_clear)
	end

	star_piece_util.show_hidden_star_piece(self.star_piece_name)
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local villager = self.controller.get_villager(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(villager, self.controller)
	end

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local stay_npc = self.controller.get_stay_infected_npc(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(stay_npc, self.controller)
	end

	for i = 1, 6 do
		local escape_npc = self.controller.get_escape_infected_npc(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(escape_npc, self.controller)
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local chief = self.controller.get_chief()
	local ellen = self.controller.get_ellen()

	-- 촌장 인터렉트 확인

	self.controller.is_setting_chief = false
	local chief = self.controller.get_chief()

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

		return false
	end

	if self.cur_pre_section_state == self.pre_section_state.none then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.prison_zone_name) then
			-- 유치장 이벤트를 안봤으면서 유치장에 들어왔을 때
			self.cur_pre_section_state = self.pre_section_state.show_prison_event
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_first_prison_event, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif self.cur_pre_section_state == self.pre_section_state.show_prison_event then
		if self.is_show_prison_event then

					self.cur_pre_section_state = self.pre_section_state.next_section

					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

end

function local_class:show_first_prison_event()
	local event_pos = vector(-13, 0, 178)

	local crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })

	-- 카메라가 유치장 쪽으로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(event_pos, 1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_cry_01')

	-- 감염자들의 상태를 1.5초간 보여준다.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 꺼내줘! 난 아무 죄도 없다고! 왜 유치장에 있어야 하는 건데!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	local escape_npc_1 = self.controller.get_escape_infected_npc(1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(escape_npc_1, { key = self.first_string_key .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 이 안에서 썩어 문드러져 죽으라는 거냐!
	local escape_npc_5 = self.controller.get_escape_infected_npc(5)
	character_util.set_direction(escape_npc_5, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(escape_npc_5, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(escape_npc_5, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(escape_npc_5, vector(0, 0, -0.5), 0.2, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(escape_npc_5.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.4))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_02')
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(escape_npc_5, { key = self.first_string_key .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 어떻게 같은 사람을 이렇게 대할 수가 있냐고…
	local stay_npc_1 = self.controller.get_stay_infected_npc(1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(stay_npc_1, { key = self.first_string_key .. 3, skip = true })

	-- 죽기 싫어…
	local stay_npc_2 = self.controller.get_stay_infected_npc(2)
	character_util.shake(stay_npc_2, 0.05, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(stay_npc_2, { key = self.first_string_key .. 4, skip = true })

	-- Directing) 문 앞 간수가 눈을 찡그리며 귀를 막은 상태
	camera_util.move_async(event_pos - vector(0, 0, 5), 1)

	local prison_guard = self.controller.get_prison_guard()

	-- 간수 : 듣지마 듣지마 듣지마…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(prison_guard, 0.05, 1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prison_guard, { key = self.first_string_key .. 5, skip = true })

	-- 간수 : 저들은 감염자들이야… 이게 최선이라고…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prison_guard, { key = self.first_string_key .. 6, skip = true })

	-- …나는 잘못없어… 잘못없어… 잘못없어…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(prison_guard, 0.05, 1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prison_guard, { key = self.first_string_key .. 7, skip = true })

	-- 카메라가 돌아옴
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.25)
	crowd_sfx:FadeOut(2)

	-- 컨트롤 돌아 오고 난 뒤 유치장 밖에 엘렌 세팅
	self.controller:set_ellen_first_point(false)
	self.is_show_prison_event = true
end

-- 유치장 밖으로 나온후 살짝 내려가면 발생하는 엘렌 조우 이벤트 끝나고 난 뒤 Section1로 이동
function local_class:first_meet_ellen()
	local ellen = self.controller.get_ellen()

	camera_util.move_async(ellen.Position, 0.5)

	-- 이봐요! 거기 당신…!
	character_util.normal_jump(ellen, '01_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 8, skip = true })
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(ellen, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_emotion(ellen, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(ellen, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 9, skip = true })
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ellen)

	-- 퀘스트 활성화
	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldInfectedPeopleSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonWorldInfectedPeople @
		Comment = 엔딩 전까지 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- effect
	self.get_reset_object_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object') end
	self.get_field_fire_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_field_fire') end

	-- marker
	self.get_prostrate_marker = function(index) return field:GetMarker('infected_people_prison_prostrate_' .. index) end

	-- 열쇠 문

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이름

	-- 배틀 그룹 이름

	-- 캠프파이어 존 이름
	self.campfire_zone_name = 'infected_people_campfire_zone'
	self.prison_zone_name = 'infected_people_prison_zone_1'
	self.enter_prison_zone_name = 'infected_people_enter_prison_zone'

	-- first string key
	self.first_string_key = 'demonworld_infected_people_section_one_'
	self.first_choose_string_key = 'demonworld_infected_people_choose_'

	-- 섹션1의 state
	self.section_state = { none = 1, start_quest = 2, light_campfire = 3
	, sleep_chief = 4, battle_chief = 5, accuse_ellen = 6, battle_ellen = 7, steal_key = 8, }
	self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- 촌장이 잠들기 까지의 state
	self.chief_sleep_state = { step1 = 1, step2 = 2, step3 = 3, end_step = 4 }
	self.cur_chief_sleep_state = self.chief_sleep_state.step1

	-- 촌장 잠드는 시간 카운트용
	self.chief_sleep_time = 0

	-- 캠프파이어 루틴을 타고 있는가?
	self.is_enable_campfire_routine = false

	-- 키 연출 중인가?
	self.is_directing_key_interact = false

	-- 촌장 잠자는 연출 중인가?
	self.is_directing_chief_sleep = false

	-- 엘렌의 대화를 한번 보았는가?
	self.is_talk_ellen = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent), 'on_burn_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	-- 엘렌 세팅 (활성화 및 마커 세팅)
	local ellen = self.controller.get_ellen()
	self.controller:set_ellen_first_point(true)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, ellen)

	-- 촌장 기본 세팅

	-- 간수 세팅

	local key_door = self.get_prison_key_door()
	key_door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- npc 세팅

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_reset_object_effect()
	self.get_field_fire_effect()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	-- 구치소 경찰 disable
	self.controller:disable_prison_guard()

	-- 촌장 add_listener 해제
	self.controller.is_setting_chief = false
	local chief = self.controller.get_chief()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(chief, self.controller)

	-- 엘렌 add_listener 해제
	local ellen = self.controller.get_ellen()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(ellen, self.controller)

	-- 키는 숨김
	local prison_key = self.controller.get_prison_key()
	prison_key.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local ellen = self.controller.get_ellen()
	local chief = self.controller.get_chief()
	local prison_key = self.controller.get_prison_key()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, ellen) then
		if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_ellen, self)
		elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.start_quest then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 12 })
		elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.accuse_ellen then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_ellen_chief_root, self)
		end
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, chief) then
		if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			-- 촌장 : 안녕하신가?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(chief, { key = 'demonworld_infected_people_interact_15' })
		elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.start_quest
				or self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.light_campfire then
			-- 고발루트로 갈지 정하는 함수
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_chief_after_quest_start, self)
		elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.accuse_ellen then
			-- 촌장 : 부탁일세. 이대로 두면 그녀가 무슨 짓을 할지 몰라.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 55 })
		elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.sleep_chief and not self.is_directing_chief_sleep then
			-- sleep 이모티콘 출력
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_chief_sleep, self, chief))
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, prison_key) and not self.is_directing_key_interact
			and self.cur_section_state <= self.section_state.light_campfire then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_key_routine, self, chief))
	end
end

-- 자는 촌장에 interact 했을 때
function local_class:show_chief_sleep(chief)
	self.is_directing_chief_sleep = true

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sleep_02')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(chief, nil, 'sleep')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	self.is_directing_chief_sleep = false
end

-- 열쇠에 intecte할 때
function local_class:interact_key_routine(chief)
	self.is_directing_key_interact = true
	self.chief_sleep_time = 0

	-- 잠들었을 때는 notice 이모티콘을 실행한다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(chief)
	character_util.set_anim(chief, { name = 'idle' })
	if self.cur_chief_sleep_state ~= self.chief_sleep_state.step1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(chief, nil, 'notice')
	end

	-- 미안하지만 이 열쇠는 관계자에게만 넘겨줄 수 있다네.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 14 })

	self.is_directing_key_interact = false
	self.chief_sleep_time = 0
	self.cur_chief_sleep_state = self.chief_sleep_state.step1
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		return false
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.campfire_zone_name)
			and self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.light_campfire then
		-- 퀘스트를 시작했으면서 캠프파이어에 불을 붙여줬을 때
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.campfire_counting_routine, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.prison_zone_name)
			and self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.sleep_chief and self:is_hold_key() then
		-- sleep_chief State에서 열쇠를 들고 감옥까지 왔을 때 타는 이벤트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_prison_have_key, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.enter_prison_zone_name)
			and self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.sleep_chief and self:is_hold_key() then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_prison_with_key, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.campfire_zone_name)
			and self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.light_campfire then
		self.is_enable_campfire_routine = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_burn_event(e)
	local campfire = self.controller.get_campfire()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, campfire)
			and self.cur_section_state < self.section_state.light_campfire then
		-- 촌장 조는 이벤트 시작
		local chief = self.controller.get_chief()

		-- 촌장 : 안그래도 쌀쌀 했는데 고맙네. 젊은이.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 15 })
		self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.light_campfire
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.campfire_counting_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:enter_prison_with_key()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local pos_to_teleport = field:GetMarker('entry_building_1').position

	character_util.move_to(user_party_leader,
			user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.8), 0.5,
			nil, true, true)

	coroutine.yield()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], pos_to_teleport + vector(0, 0, -i))
	end

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'up')

	coroutine.yield()

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:is_hold_key()
	local current_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
		if hold_target.Name == 'infected_people_prison_key' then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName ~= self.battle_group_name then
		return false
	end

	if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.battle_chief then
		-- 감염자 구출 루트를 타고 촌장 과의 전투가 끝난 후
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.battle_end_chief, self)
	elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.battle_ellen then
		-- 엘렌 고발 루트를 타고 엘렌 과의 전투가 끝난 후
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.battle_end_ellen, self)
	end

	return true
end

-- 엘렌과 대화하여 퀘스트를 수락할지 여부 확인
function local_class:interact_ellen()
	local ellen = self.controller.get_ellen()

	-- 엘렌 앞으로 정렬
	party_util.align_party(ellen.Position, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	if not self.is_talk_ellen then
		-- 당신, 안에서 감염자들을 보았죠?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 1, skip = true })

		-- 그들은 단지 아픈 것 뿐이에요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(ellen, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 2, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ellen)

		-- 저렇게 좁은 공간에서 비인간적인 대우를 받을 이유가 있을까요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 3, skip = true })

		-- …이 마을은 미쳤어요.
		character_util.set_emotion(ellen, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 4, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(ellen)

		-- 제가 매번 감염자들의 해방을 요구하였지만 전혀 들어주질 않았어요.
		character_util.set_anim(ellen, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 5, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ellen)

		-- …
		character_util.set_emotion(ellen, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 6, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(ellen)

		-- 이제는 말이 아닌 행동을 할 때에요.
		character_util.set_emotion(ellen, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(ellen, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01', keep_anim = false })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 7, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ellen)

		-- 하지만… 저 혼자서는 해결할 수 없어요.
		character_util.set_emotion(ellen, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 8, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(ellen)
		self.is_talk_ellen = true
	end

	-- 그들을 해방 시킬 수 있도록 저를 도와줄 수 있나요?
	character_util.set_emotion(ellen, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 9, skip = true })

	local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)
	if not is_accepted then
		-- 알겠어요… 혹시나 마음이 바뀌면 말을 걸어주세요.
		character_util.set_emotion(ellen, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 10, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ellen)
		return
	end

	-- 고마워요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 11, skip = true })

	-- 우선 격리자촌에서 촌장의 열쇠를 가져와주세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 12, skip = true })

	-- 저 좁은 공간에서 그들을 해방만 시켜준다면 이후의 일은 내게 맞겨주세요!
	character_util.set_anim(ellen, { name = 'cast2' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 13, skip = true })

	-- 화로 세팅
	local brazier = self.controller.get_brazier()
	brazier.Position = self.controller.get_brazier_marker(1).position

	-- 화로에 불 옮겨 붙을 수 있게 세팅
	local campfire = self.controller.get_campfire()
	campfire.CombustibleBehaviour.IsAffectedBurn = true

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ellen)
	self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.start_quest
end

--region 엘렌 감염자 해방 루트
-- 촌장이 캠프 파이어 에서 조는 루틴
function local_class:campfire_counting_routine()
	if self.is_enable_campfire_routine then
		return
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local chief = self.controller.get_chief()
	local prison_key = self.controller.get_prison_key()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self.cur_chief_sleep_state = self.chief_sleep_state.step1
	self.chief_sleep_time = 0
	self.is_enable_campfire_routine = true

	local target_pos_x = chief.Position.x - 0.5
	while self.is_enable_campfire_routine do
		-- 부스 울리는 도중에 경고뜨면 안눌리게
		if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		else
			-- 촌장이 화면밖으로 벗어났을 경우 대기
			if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(chief.Position) then
				if leader.Position.x > target_pos_x and math.abs(leader.Position.z - chief.Position.z) < 4
						and self.cur_chief_sleep_state == self.chief_sleep_state.step1 then
					-- step1일 때 촌장의 시야 안에 있으면 카운팅한 시간 초기화
					self.chief_sleep_time = 0
				else
					self.chief_sleep_time = self.chief_sleep_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					if self.chief_sleep_time >= 5 and self.cur_chief_sleep_state == self.chief_sleep_state.step1 then
						-- 촌장 : …따뜻하니 조금 졸리군.
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
						character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(chief, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
						speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 17 })
						self.cur_chief_sleep_state = self.chief_sleep_state.step2
					elseif self.chief_sleep_time >= 10 and self.cur_chief_sleep_state == self.chief_sleep_state.step2 then
						-- 촌장 : 리리스님 저희를 굽어살펴주세요…
						speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 18 })
						self.cur_chief_sleep_state = self.chief_sleep_state.step3
					elseif self.chief_sleep_time >= 15 and self.cur_chief_sleep_state == self.chief_sleep_state.step3 then
						self.is_enable_campfire_routine = false
						self.cur_chief_sleep_state = self.chief_sleep_state.end_step
						prison_key.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sleep_02')
						character_util.show_emoticon(chief, nil, 'sleep')
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.cur_chief_sleep_state ~= self.chief_sleep_state.end_step then
		character_util.remove_emotion(chief)
		character_util.set_anim(chief, { name = 'idle' })
	else
		-- end_step으로 빠져 나온거면 잠든거니 열쇠를 들 수 있게 한다.
		self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.sleep_chief
		prison_key.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
		prison_key.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '01_bounce_iron_02'
		prison_key.Holdable.ResizeHitbox = false

		-- 간수 disable
		self.controller:disable_prison_guard()

		-- 엘렌 화면밖으로 이동시킴
		local ellen = self.controller.get_ellen()
		character_util.set_position(ellen, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end
end

-- 열쇠를 들고 감옥 입구 앞에서 진행되는 이벤트
function local_class:enter_prison_have_key()
	local chief = self.controller.get_chief()
	local villagers = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local villager = self.controller.get_villager(i)
		villager:HideWeapon(true)
		table.insert(villagers, villager)
	end

	-- 이봐 자네! 이게 무슨 짓인가…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 19, bubble_direction = 'ct'
	, world_pos = vector(-15.75, 0, 165), bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	local center_pos = self.controller.get_prison_center().position
	party_util.align_party(center_pos + unity_class.vector3.back, 'up', 0.5, 'arc')

	-- 촌장 세팅
	local start_pos = center_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 6
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chief)
	character_util.set_position(chief, start_pos)
	local chief_pos = center_pos + unity_class.vector3.back
	character_util.move_waypoint(chief, chief_pos, 5, true, "stop"
	, "floor", "up", "01_dash_01")

	-- 주민 세팅
	local start_pos_list = {
		start_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, -1),
		start_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 1.5,
		start_pos + vector(1.5, 0, -1),
	}
	local target_pos_list = {
		chief_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, -1),
		chief_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 1.5,
		chief_pos + vector(1.5, 0, -1),
	}
	for i = 1, #villagers do
		character_util.set_position(villagers[i], start_pos_list[i])
		character_util.set_active_state(villagers[i], 'enabled')

		if i == #villagers then
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(villagers[i], target_pos_list[i], 5, true, "stop"
			, "floor", "up", "01_dash_01")
		else
			character_util.move_waypoint(villagers[i], target_pos_list[i], 5, true, "stop"
			, "floor", "up", "01_dash_01")
		end
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 대체 무슨 짓을 하려는건가?!
	character_util.normal_jump(chief, '01_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 20, skip = true })

	-- 혹시?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 21, skip = true })

	-- 엘렌이 부탁하던가…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 22, skip = true })

	-- 자네 마음은 알겠지만, 감염자들이 풀려나게 되면 병의 전염을 돌이킬 수 없게 돼버린다네.
	character_util.set_emotion(chief, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(chief, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01', keep_anim = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 23, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chief)

	-- 지금이라도 늦지 않았네, 이런 짓은 그만두게…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 24, skip = true })

	-- 선택지) 열쇠를 반환한다 / 이들에게도 자유로울 권리가 있다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.first_choose_string_key .. 3, 'mercy' }
	, { self.first_choose_string_key .. 4, 'brutal' } })

	local prison_key = self.controller.get_prison_key()
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 잘 생각했네.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 25, skip = true })

		-- 페이드 아웃
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 원래 자리로 돌리고 페이드 인
		local chief_origin_pos = self.controller.get_chief_stay_marker().position

		-- 주민들은 다시 disable
		for i = 1, #villagers do
			character_util.set_active_state(villagers[i], 'disabled')
		end

		character_util.set_direction(chief, 'down')
		character_util.set_position(chief, chief_origin_pos)

		-- 열쇠를 내려놓는다.
		prison_key.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = nil
		character_util.release_hold_object(user_party.Leader, prison_key)
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		prison_key.Position = chief_origin_pos + unity_class.vector3.right
		prison_key.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		prison_key.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

		party_util.align_party(chief, 'down', 0, 'linear')
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		-- 페이드 인
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 마을의 평화를 위해서라도 이런맘 먹지 말게.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 26, skip = true })
		character_util.set_direction(chief, 'right')

		self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.light_campfire
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.campfire_counting_routine, self))
		return
	end

	-- ....
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 27, skip = true })

	-- 말이 안 통하는군…
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2.0 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 28, skip = true })

	-- 미안하지만 열쇠는 힘으로라도 빼앗아야겠네.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 29, skip = true })

	-- 저 젊은이를 잡게!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_china_master_shout_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(chief, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(chief, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01', keep_anim = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 30, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chief)

	character_util.release_hold_object(user_party.Leader, prison_key)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_guild_warp_01')
	self.get_reset_object_effect():Instantiate(prison_key.Position)
	prison_key.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	prison_key.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 배틀 그룹에 캐릭터들을 넣어주고 notice를 날린다.
	self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.battle_chief
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	chief:HideWeapon(false)
	character_util.convert_to_monster(chief, self.battle_group_name, nil)
	chief.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = self.battle_group_name
	character_util.set_death_type(chief, "prostrate")
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(chief, leader, 'battle')
	for i = 1, #villagers do
		villagers[i]:HideWeapon(false)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(villagers[i], self.battle_group_name, nil)
		villagers[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = self.battle_group_name
		character_util.set_death_type(villagers[i], "prostrate")
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(villagers[i], leader, 'battle')
	end
end

-- 촌장 및 주민들 과의 전투가 끝난 후 이벤트
function local_class:battle_end_chief()
	local ellen = self.controller.get_ellen()
	local prison_key = self.controller.get_prison_key()

	local escape_npc_list = {}
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local escape_npc = self.controller.get_escape_infected_npc(i)
		table.insert(escape_npc_list, escape_npc)
	end

	local stay_npc_list = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local stay_npc = self.controller.get_stay_infected_npc(i)
		table.insert(stay_npc_list, stay_npc)
	end

	local chief = self.controller.get_chief()
	local villagers = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local villager = self.controller.get_villager(i)
		table.insert(villagers, villager)
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 문의 크래쉬비헤이비어를 키도어 크래쉬비어로 돌린다.
	local key_door = self.get_prison_key_door()
	key_door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.KeyDoorCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 파티원들 위치 조정
	local center_pos = self.controller.get_prison_center().position
	party_util.align_party(center_pos + unity_class.vector3.right, 'left', 0, 'arc')

	-- 촌장 및 주변 npc들 쓰러진 채로 세팅
	character_util.convert_to_npc(chief)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chief)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(chief, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_direction(chief, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(chief, self.get_chief_prostrate_marker().position)

	local dir_list = { 'right', 'left', 'right' }
	for i = 1, #villagers do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(villagers[i])
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(villagers[i])
		character_util.set_direction(villagers[i], dir_list[i])
		character_util.set_position(villagers[i], self.get_prostrate_marker(i).position)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(villagers[i], { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	end

	-- 열쇠 다시 보이게 세팅
	prison_key.Position = user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right
	prison_key.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 대체 왜 이런 짓을…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chief, { key = self.first_string_key .. 31, skip = true })

	-- Directing) 엘렌이 아래서 플레이어 아래로 달려들어옴
	character_util.set_position(ellen, center_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 6)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(ellen, user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back
	, 6, true, "stop", "floor", "up", "01_dash_01")
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 주변을 두리번 두리번 하고
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(ellen, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(ellen, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local ellen_way_points = {
		ellen.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 2,
		user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 2,
	}
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(ellen, ellen_way_points
	, 4, false, "stop", "floor", "left")

	-- 해냈군요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(ellen, { name = 'cast2' }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 32, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ellen)

	-- 당신이라면 옳은 일을 할것이라 생각했어요.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(ellen, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01', keep_anim = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 33, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(ellen)

	-- Directing) 열쇠를 집어서 도어에 던져서 문을 연다.
	command_util.execute_holdup(ellen, prison_key, ellen.Position)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 문까지 이동
	local waypoint_list = {
		ellen.Position + unity_class.vector3.right,
		ellen.Position + vector(1, 0, 2),
	}

	camera_util.move(user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2.5, 0.5)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(ellen, waypoint_list, 4, false, "stop"
	, "floor", "up")

	-- 열쇠를 던진다.
	command_util.execute_throw(ellen, prison_key, direction_util.to_vector3(ellen.Direction), vector(0, 0, 6), 8, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(ellen, ellen.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 2, 4, false, "stop"
	, "floor", "right")
	wait_for_sec(5)

	-- 카메라를 감염자 쪽으로 이동 시킨다.
	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 9, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	-- 감염자들 문이 열리는 것을 보고 놀란다.
	for i = 1, #stay_npc_list do
		stay_npc_list[i]:HideWeapon(true)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(stay_npc_list[i])
		character_util.normal_jump(stay_npc_list[i], '01_jump_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(stay_npc_list[i], { name = 'surprise' })
	end
	for i = 1, #escape_npc_list do
		escape_npc_list[i]:HideWeapon(true)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(escape_npc_list[i])
		character_util.normal_jump(escape_npc_list[i], '01_jump_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(escape_npc_list[i], { name = 'surprise' })
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 탈출하는 npc들은 탈출, 나머지 npc들은 seat, tired
	for i = 1, #stay_npc_list do
		character_util.remove_emotion(stay_npc_list[i])
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(stay_npc_list[i], { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'tired' })
	end

	local escape_npc_way_point_list = {
		vector(-10.5, 0, 176),
		vector(-10.5, 0, 171)
	}

	local string_key_list = {
		self.first_string_key .. 99,
		nil,
		self.first_string_key .. 100,
		self.first_string_key .. 101,
		nil,
		self.first_string_key .. 102,
	}

	local sound_key = {
		'01_crowd_shout_06',
		nil,
		'03_dialogue_positive_01',
		nil,
		nil,
		nil,
	}

	local wait_for_sec_list = { 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25 }

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	for i = 1, #escape_npc_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(escape_npc_list[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(escape_npc_list[i], { name = 'attack' })

		-- 대사가 있으면 대사 출력
		if string_key_list[i] ~= nil then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(escape_npc_list[i], { key = string_key_list[i] })
		end

		-- 사운드 키가 있으면 재생
		if sound_key[i] ~= nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sound_key[i])
		end

		if i == #escape_npc_list then
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(escape_npc_list[i], escape_npc_way_point_list, 6, true, "stop"
			, "floor", "down", "01_dash_01")
		else
			character_util.move_waypoint(escape_npc_list[i], escape_npc_way_point_list, 6, true, "stop"
			, "floor", "down", "01_dash_01")
			wait_for_sec(wait_for_sec_list[i])
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #escape_npc_list do
		character_util.set_active_state(escape_npc_list[i], 'disabled')
	end

	-- 카메라가 리더와 엘렌 사이로 간다.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 리더쪽으로 엘렌이 내려온다.
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(ellen, user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 4, false, "stop"
	, "floor", "left")

	-- 저들이 기뻐하는 모습을 보았나요?
	character_util.set_emotion(ellen, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 34, skip = true })

	-- 모두 당신 덕분이에요!
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(ellen, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01', keep_anim = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 35, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(ellen)

	-- 스타피스 드랍
	character_util.set_anim(ellen, { name = 'get' })
	local star_piece = self.controller.get_star_piece()
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, ellen.Position, ellen.Position + unity_class.vector3.back)
	wait_for_sec(3)
	character_util.remove_anim(ellen)

	-- 시간이 되면 부디 다시 마을에 들려주세요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 36, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(ellen)

	-- 모두가 평등한, 달라진 마을을 보여드릴테니까요.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(ellen, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ellen, { key = self.first_string_key .. 37, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ellen)

	-- 엘렌이 아래로 내려가며 퇴장
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(ellen, ellen.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 5, 6, true, "stop"
	, "floor", "down", "01_dash_01")
	character_util.set_active_state(ellen, 'disabled')

	-- 섹션 넘김
	-- 퀘스트 클리어
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

-- 엘렌 과의 전투가 끝난 후 이벤트
function local_class:battle_end_ellen()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local chief = self.controller.get_chief()
	local ellen = self.controller.get_ellen()

	local villagers = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local villager = self.controller.get_villager(i)
		table.insert(villagers, villager)
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- (엘렌 가운데에 쓰러져있고 주인공/촌장/젊은이 2 명이 둘러싸고 있음)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(ellen)

	local center_pos = self.controller.get_prison_center().position

	party_util.align_party(center_pos, 'left', 0, 'arc')

	character_util.set_position(ellen, center_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(ellen, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(ellen, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'tired' })

	-- 촌장 세팅
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(chief)
	character_util.set_direction(chief, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(chief, center_pos + unity_class.vector3.right)

	-- 두명의 마을 주민 세팅
	local dir_list = { 'up', 'down' }
	local pos_list = { center_pos + unity_class.vector3.back, center_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward }
	for i = 1, #villagers do
		character_util.set_active_state(villagers[i], 'enabled')

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldInfectedPeopleSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonWorldInfectedPeople @
		Comment = 감염자를 풀어줄 때 연출용 @
		Index = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- first string key
	self.first_string_key = 'demonworld_infected_people_section_two_'

	-- 존 이름
	self.village_zone_name = 'demonworld_infected_people_ending'

	-- 센터 포지션
	self.get_center_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('infected_people_village_center') end

	-- 스타피스 이름
	self.star_piece_name = 'infected_people_star_piece'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 엘렌 세팅 (활성화 및 마커 세팅)
	local village_center_pos = self.get_center_marker().position
	local ellen = self.controller.get_ellen()
	ellen:HideWeapon(true)
	character_util.set_active_state(ellen, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(ellen, village_center_pos + vector(3, 0, 2.5))
	character_util.set_direction(ellen, 'left')

	-- 감옥 안 npc 세팅
	self.controller:infected_free_ending_npc_setting()
	star_piece_util.show_hidden_star_piece(self.star_piece_name)
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local stay_npc = self.controller.get_stay_infected_npc(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(stay_npc, self.controller)
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local stay_npc = self.controller.get_stay_infected_npc(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, stay_npc) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(stay_npc, { key = 'demonworld_infected_people_interact_' .. (i + 3) })
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		return false
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.village_zone_name) then
		-- 감염자 해방 루트 엔딩 보여주기
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress_enum = {
		-- 초기 상태
		none = 1,
		-- 대화 이벤트 시작
		talk_begin = 2,
		-- 대화 이벤트 끝
		talk_end = 3
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.none
	-- 자동차 찾았는지
	self.car_found = false
	-- 이벤트 시작 시키는 존 이름
	self.event_start_zone = 'louise_melanie_zone'
	-- 메인 퀘스트 아이디
	self.main_quest_id = 216
	-- 섹션 체크해서 게임 시작할 수 있는지 확인
	self.can_start_event = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self.can_start_event = true

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.can_start_event then
		self:setting()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller.get_louis_car().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.controller.interacting = false

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.can_start_event then return false end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.event_start_zone) and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and self.controller.can_operate_quest  then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.louis_melanie_begin, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.can_start_event then return false end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.get_louis_car()) and not self.controller.interacting and
			self.controller.can_operate_quest then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_louis_car, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:setting()
	-- npc 시작 정보 세팅
	local louis = self.controller.get_louis()
	local melanie = self.controller.get_melanie()
	local start_marker_pos = self.controller.get_start_marker().position

	self.controller.get_louis_car().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	character_util.set_position(louis, start_marker_pos)
	character_util.set_position(melanie, start_marker_pos + vector(1, 0, 0))

	character_util.set_direction(louis, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(melanie, 'left')

	character_util.remove_emotion(louis)
	character_util.set_emotion(melanie, {name= 'doyagao'})

	character_util.remove_anim(louis)
	character_util.remove_anim(melanie)


	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.talk_begin and not self.controller.exclusive_called then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.talk_begin
	else
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.none
	end
	self.controller.is_auto_moving = false
end

function local_class:louis_melanie_begin()
	local louis = self.controller.get_louis()
	local melanie = self.controller.get_melanie()
	self.controller.is_auto_moving = true
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.talk_begin

	self.controller:jump_n_times(melanie, 0.3, 2)

	-- 우리 차 어디 두고 왔는지 기억해?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_1'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = false, parent = louis})
	character_util.set_direction(louis, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(louis, {name = 'tired'})

	-- 아니. 그 쪽은 편의점이고.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_2'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	-- 세상에. 너 같은 저능아는 내 생에 처음 봐.
	character_util.set_emotion(louis, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_3'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	-- 너 그 머리로 어떻게 은행을 털었어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_evil_01', loop = false, parent = melanie})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_3_1'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	-- ….
	character_util.set_emotion(louis, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(louis, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_3_2'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	-- 조용히 해.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = false, parent = louis})
	character_util.set_direction(louis, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(louis, {name = 'mad'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(louis, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_3_3'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	-- 네 차가 붉은색인 건 기억하니?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_4'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_angry_01', loop = false, parent = louis})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(louis, nil, 'angry')
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	self.controller.is_auto_moving = false
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.talk_end

	-- 조용히 해.
	louis.Interactable.Talk = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_3_3'

	-- 네 차가 붉은색인 건 기억하니?
	melanie.Interactable.Talk = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_4'

	self:move_to_next_section()
end

function local_class:interact_louis_car()
	-- 컨트롤 뺐는 이벤트 중에는 다른 이벤트 실행 불가능으로 변경
	self.controller.interacting = true
	self.car_found = true

	-- 3분도 달리지 못할 것 같은 고물차다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_5'})

	self.controller.interacting = false
	self:move_to_next_section()
end

function local_class:move_to_next_section()
	if self.car_found and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.talk_end and not self.controller.interacting then
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	end
end

function local_class:check_exclusive()
	local rst = self.controller:reset_routine(true)
	if rst then
		self:setting()
		return true
	end
end


return local_class

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent), 'on_exclusive_quest_end_event')

	-- ShootHelper 로드
	local pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
	local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
	local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('rifle_bullet_long_dist'):Clone()

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.controller.get_louis())
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, proj_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

	return true

function local_class:start()

		local waypoint = field:GetMarker('louis_melanie_waypoint_' .. i)

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(
			CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent.Create(CS.Oak.ConvertSwitchFieldObjectBehaviour.ConvertSwitchState.BLUE))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestEndEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(louis, self)
	louis.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

				not self.controller.interacting and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none then

end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.gun_fire_zone) and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.gun then
		self.in_gun_fire_zone = true
		if self.controller.can_operate_quest and not self.gun_fire_scene_play_once then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gun_fire_scene, self, false))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.gun_fire_zone) and
		self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.gun then
		self.in_gun_fire_zone = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.controller.stage_name then
		if e.Key ~= self.controller.my_quest_key then
			if self.in_gun_fire_zone and self.controller.can_operate_quest and
					not self.gun_fire_scene_play_once and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.gun then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gun_fire_scene, self, true))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:louis_melanie_end()

	local melanie = self.controller.get_melanie()

	local walk_speed = 3
	local run_speed = 5

	self.controller.is_auto_moving = true

	-- 멍청한 루이스. 도대체 아는게 뭐니?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_7'})

	-- 루이스 이동 시작

			walk_speed, true, 'stop', 'floor')

	character_util.move_waypoint(louis, waypoint[1].position,
			walk_speed, false, 'stop', 'floor')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

										   start_waypoint_2 + vector(1, 0, 0)},
			run_speed, true, 'stop', 'floor')
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

			run_speed, true, 'stop', 'floor')
