	-- 예전에 은행 털었을 때, 도망 못 쳐서 감옥에 갔잖아.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_10'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	-- 그때도 네 차를 못 찾아서 잡힌 거지? 하하!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_evil_02', loop = false, parent = melanie})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_10_1'})

	character_util.set_emotion(louis, {name =  'mad'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_angry_01', loop = false, parent = louis})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(louis, nil, 'angry')

		self:gun_fire_zone_reset()
		return false

	-- 웨이포인트 6 ~ 12 까지 이동
	local waypoint_2 = self:make_waypoint_table(7, 12, vector(1, 0, 0))
	character_util.move_waypoint(louis, waypoint_2[1], walk_speed, false, 'stop', 'floor')
	character_util.move_waypoint(melanie, waypoint_2[2], walk_speed, false, 'stop', 'floor')

	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_12'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	-- 루이스으으~
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_ghost_laugh_evil_01', loop = false, parent = melanie})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_13'})

	wait_for_sec(2)
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.gun
	self.controller.is_auto_moving = false

	if not self.gun_fire_scene_play_once then
		self.in_gun_fire_zone = true
		self:gun_fire_scene()
	end

function local_class:gun_fire_zone_reset()
	local louis = self.controller.get_louis()
	local melanie = self.controller.get_melanie()
	local waypoint = self.waypoint

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(louis)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(melanie)
	character_util.stop(louis)
	character_util.stop(melanie)
	character_util.stop_shake(louis)
	character_util.stop_shake(melanie)

	if 	self.shaking_sfx ~= nil then
		self.shaking_sfx:Stop()
	end

	if self.controller.is_auto_moving then
		self.controller.is_auto_moving = false
	end

	-- 멜로니 죽은 후에 exclusive 불리면
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.see_final then
		character_util.stop_shake(melanie)
		melanie.SpineController:RemoveColor('darken_melanie', 0)
		self.controller.melanie_dead = false
		character_util.remove_relate_event(melanie, self)

		field_ui_manager:SetUI(melanie, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	self.gun_fire_scene_play_once = false
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.gun
	character_util.remove_relate_event(louis, self)
	louis.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	melanie.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.set_position(louis, waypoint[12].position)
	character_util.set_direction(louis, 'left')

	character_util.set_position(melanie, waypoint[12].position + vector(1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(melanie, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(melanie, {name = 'doyagao'})
end

function local_class:gun_fire_scene(wait_on_start)
	local louis = self.controller.get_louis()
	local melanie = self.controller.get_melanie()
	local waypoint = self.waypoint
	local walk_speed = 3
	local run_speed = 5.5

	self:gun_fire_zone_reset()
	self.gun_fire_scene_play_once = true
	self.controller.is_auto_moving= true

	if wait_on_start then
		if self:wait(1.1) then return false end
	end

	-- 둘다 보일 때 까지 연출 시작 대기
	while true do
		if self.controller:player_watching_event() then
			break
		end
		if self:check_exclusive() then return false end
		if self:check_distance() then return false end

		-- 대기 하다 존 밖으로 나가면 함수 탈출
		if not self.in_gun_fire_zone then
			self:gun_fire_zone_reset()
			return false
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end
	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	if self:look_around_distance_check(louis, {'up','down', 'left'}, 0.75) then return false end
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = false, parent = louis})
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(louis, {name = 'question', loop = false}, {name = 'tired'})
	if self:wait(1.5) then return false end

	-- 이쪽 골목 맞아? 응~?
	character_util.remove_anim(louis)
	character_util.set_emotion(louis, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_13_3'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end
	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	-- 정말로?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_13_4'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end
	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	-- 아님 저쪽 골목?
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = false, parent = melanie})
	character_util.set_direction(melanie, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim(melanie)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_13_5'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end
	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	-- 루이스? 루이이이이스?
	character_util.set_direction(melanie, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(melanie, {name = 'walk', loop = true})
	character_util.move_to(melanie, louis.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil, walk_speed, true, false)
	if self:wait_until_reach_waypoint_distance_check(melanie, louis.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)) then return false end

	character_util.set_anim(melanie, {name = 'spear_attack2', loop = true})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_runaway_02', loop = false, parent = melanie})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_bad_fairy_01', loop = false, parent = melanie})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_13_6'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end
	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	-- ..이 쪽 맞아.
	character_util.remove_anim(melanie)
	character_util.look_at(louis, melanie)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(louis, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_14'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end
	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	-- 확실해? 응~?

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_16'})

	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	character_util.set_emotion(louis, {name = 'mad'})

	if self:check_distance() then return false end

		'demon_world_louis_melanie_15',
		-- 감옥에 한 번 더 가야겠네~ 루이스.
		'demon_world_louis_melanie_16_1',
		-- 바보같은 루이스. 제대로 기억하는게 없네.
		'demon_world_louis_melanie_26'
	}

	local sound_key = {
		'03_dialogue_negative_02',
		'03_runaway_02',
		'01_bad_fairy_01'
	}

	local move_distances = {
		vector(-0.75, 0, 0),
		vector(0, 0, 0.75),
		vector(0.75, 0, 0)
	}

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(string_key) do
		local pos = louis.Position + move_distances[i]

		if self:check_distance() then return false end

		character_util.look_at(melanie, louis)
		character_util.set_anim(melanie, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = sound_key[i], loop = false, parent = melanie})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = string_key[i]})
		if self:check_exclusive() then return false end
		if self:check_distance() then return false end

		if i == 1 then
			character_util.set_direction(louis, 'down')
			character_util.shake(louis, 0.03, 999)
			self.shaking_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = true, parent = louis})
		end
	end

	-- 조용!
	if self.shaking_sfx ~= nil then
		self.shaking_sfx:Stop()
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', loop = false, parent = louis})
	character_util.stop_shake(louis)
	character_util.set_anim(louis, {name = 'cast2', loop = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(melanie)
	character_util.set_emotion(melanie, {name = 'surprise'})

	if self.controller:player_watching_event() then
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(louis, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_17', bubble_type = 'shout',
														scale = 1.4, world_pos = louis.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end
	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	character_util.set_locked_dir(melanie, 'left')
	character_util.move_to_async(melanie, melanie.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			nil, 2, false, true)
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end
	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	melanie.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_direction(melanie, 'left')

	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	-- 아니 난…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(melanie, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_18'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end
	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	-- 진심이야. 단 한마디도 더 하지마.
	character_util.set_direction(louis, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(louis, {name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(louis, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_21_1'})

	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	character_util.move_to(louis, louis.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, 1.5, false, false)
	if self:wait_until_reach_waypoint_distance_check(louis, louis.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)) then return false end

	character_util.set_anim(louis, {name = 'rifle_idle'})
	if self:wait(0.5) then return false end

	self:Shoot(louis, melanie, 0.2, vector(0.15,0,-0.1))
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_hit_monster_01', loop = false, parent = melanie})

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.see_final
	character_util.shake(melanie, 0.03, 1)
	melanie.SpineController:AddColor('darken_melanie', unity_color({ 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1 }), 1, 1)
	self.controller.melanie_dead = true
	character_util.add_listener(melanie, self)
	if self:wait(1) then return false end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(louis)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(melanie, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	character_util.move_waypoint(louis, waypoint[13].position, walk_speed, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
	if self:wait_until_reach_waypoint_distance_check(louis, waypoint[13].position) then return false end
	if self:wait(0.75) then return false end

	-- 거봐 여기 맞다니까.
	character_util.set_direction(louis, 'right')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(louis, {key = 'demon_world_louis_melanie_21'})
	if self:check_exclusive() then return false end
	if self:check_distance() then return false end

	character_util.move_waypoint(louis, self.controller:get_finish_marker().position,
			walk_speed, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
	if self:wait_until_reach_waypoint_distance_check(louis, self.controller:get_finish_marker().position) then return false end

	self.controller.is_auto_moving = false

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:Shoot(shooter, target, hit_delay, hit_offset)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(shooter, {name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false}, {name = 'attack'})
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetObject(target, vector(0.2, 0, 0.3), -1, true, 0)
	wait_for_sec(hit_delay)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	table.insert(self.effects, unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect):Instantiate(target.Position + hit_offset))
end

function local_class:look_around(fo, dir, delay)
	wait_for_sec(delay)
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(dir) do
		character_util.set_direction(fo, dir[i])
		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end
end

function local_class:wait_until_reach_waypoint(fo, pos, reset)
	while true do
		local dis = fo.Position:SqrDistance(pos)
		if dis < 0.01 then
			break
		end

		local do_reset = lua_helper.get_or_default(reset, true)
		if do_reset then
			local rst = self.controller:reset_routine()
			if rst then
				return true
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:look_around_distance_check(fo, dir, delay)
	if self:wait(delay) then return true end
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(dir) do
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = false, parent = fo})
		character_util.set_direction(fo, dir[i])
		if self:wait(delay) then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:check_exclusive()
	local rst = self.controller:reset_routine(true)
	if rst then
		self:gun_fire_zone_reset()
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:check_distance()
	if not self.in_gun_fire_zone then
		self:gun_fire_zone_reset()
		self.controller.is_auto_moving = false
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:wait(time)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < time do

		if self:check_exclusive() then
			return true
		end
		if self:check_distance() then
			return true
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:wait_until_reach_waypoint_distance_check(fo, pos)
	while true do
		local dis = fo.Position:SqrDistance(pos)
		if dis < 0.01 then
			break
		end

		if self:check_exclusive() then
			return true
		end
		if self:check_distance() then
			return true
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	return false
end


function local_class:make_waypoint_table(start_idx, end_idx, melanie_last_pos_offset)
	local waypoint = self.waypoint
	local louis_waypoint = {}
	local melanie_waypoint = {}
	local offset = lua_helper.get_or_default(melanie_last_pos_offset, vector(0, 0, 0))

	for i = start_idx, end_idx do
		table.insert(louis_waypoint, waypoint[i].position)
		table.insert(melanie_waypoint, waypoint[i].position)
	end

	local size = table_util.get_size(melanie_waypoint)
	melanie_waypoint[size] = melanie_waypoint[size] + offset

	return { louis_waypoint, melanie_waypoint }
end

return local_class

demon_world_global_event = get_or_create_global_variable('utils/DemonWorldGlobalEvent')

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldMadeQueenSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonWorldMadeQueen @
		Comment = 접객 실패 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 1 분기에서 선택한 넘버
	self.first_selection = -1
	-- 2 분기에서 선택한 넘버
	self.second_selection = -1
	-- 맞는 엔딩을 봤는지
	self.saw_right_ending = false
	-- 최초 실행시 나오는 이벤트 봤는지
	self.saw_first_scene = false

	-- 서큐버스 a 교육 씬 초기 위치 마커
	self.succubus_educate_start_marker = nil
	-- 플레이어 교육 씬 초기 위치 마커
	self.player_educate_start_marker = nil
	-- 까다로운 손님 교육 씬 초기 위치 마커 (의자 한칸 아래에 배치)
	self.picky_customer_educate_start_marker = nil

	-- 작게 말하는 사이즈
	self.small_size = 0.8
	-- 카매라 줌 상태에 따른 말풍선 사이즈 조정용
	self.cam_size = {
		small = 0.9,
		smaller = 0.8
	}
	-- 카메라 줌 스피드
	self.camera_zoom_dur = 0.25

	-- 양주 스프라이트 아이디
	self.liquor_bottle_id = 20369
	self.feeding_bottle_id = 20372
	self.feeding_bottle_90_id = 20373
	self.glass_cup_id = 20330
	self.glass_cup_90_id = 20331
	self.glass_cup_empty_90_id = 20332

	self.fx_fire_effect = 'FX_field_fire'

	self.play_fire = false

	self.player_blocked_kid_yet = true

	self.reward = 6000

	self.can_stop = false

	self.success = false

	self.boss_secretary_quest_id = 236
	self.bully_kid_quest_id = 237

	self.star_piece_name = 'made_queen_star_piece'

	self.mike_earring_id = 20341

	self.drinking_feeding_bottle = false
	self.drinking_feeding_bottle_routine_ended = false

	self.right_answered_times = 0

	self.liquor_bottle = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.succubus_a_marker = field:GetMarker('made_queen_succubus_a_marker')
	self.succubus_educate_start_marker = field:GetMarker('made_queen_succubus_educate_start_marker')
	self.player_educate_start_marker = field:GetMarker('made_queen_player_educate_start_marker')
	self.picky_customer_educate_start_marker = field:GetMarker('made_queen_picky_customer_educate_start_marker')

	local succubus_a = self.controller.get_succubus_a()
	local picky_customer = self.controller.get_picky_customer()

	character_util.add_listener(succubus_a, self)

	-- 까다로운 손님은 전 섹션에서 사라졌다는 설정이니 멀리 배치
	character_util.set_position(picky_customer, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_direction(succubus_a, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_position(succubus_a, self.succubus_a_marker.position)
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_fire_effect)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	local succubus_a = self.controller.get_succubus_a()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(succubus_a, self)

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.controller.can_operate_quest or self.controller.interacting then
		return false
	end
	local succubus_a = self.controller.get_succubus_a()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, succubus_a) then
		self.controller.interacting = true
		if not self.saw_first_scene then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.educate_succubus_scene, self)
		end
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:educate_succubus_scene()
	local succubus_a = self.controller.get_succubus_a()
	local picky_customer = self.controller.get_picky_customer()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	-- 도와주실 준비가 되셨나요?
	party_util.align_party(succubus_a.Position, 'left', 1)
	character_util.set_direction(succubus_a, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_0', skip = true })

	local ans = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 예
		{ 'demon_world_made_queen_2_1', 'mercy' },
		-- 아직 준비가 부족하다.
		{ 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2', 'normal' }
	})

	if ans == 1 then
		local succubus_marker = self.succubus_educate_start_marker
		local player_marker = self.player_educate_start_marker
		local picky_customer_marker = self.picky_customer_educate_start_marker
		local small_size = self.small_size

		-- 감사합니다 점장님!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_new_16', skip = true })

		-- 아무리 거친 분들도 이전 점장님 앞에선 모두 얌전해 지셨어요.
		character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_new_17', skip = true })

		-- 전설의 점장님이라면 분명 그에 못지 않을 거라 믿어요!
		character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'attack' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_new_18', skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(succubus_a, { name = 'release', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		wait_for_sec(0.2667)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
		--상단 대사 종료 후 서큐버스 attack 동작으로 secretagent_mike_earring_accessory를 기사에게 던지고, 기사 스프라이트 흡수
		local mike_earring = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = succubus_a.Position, target = leader.Position + vector(-0.15, 0, 0), itemid = self.mike_earring_id,
														  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })

		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(succubus_a)
		mike_earring.ConsumeTarget = leader
		mike_earring:Fly()

		-- 자, 이걸로 제게 지시를 내려주세요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_new_19', skip = true })

		-- 그럼… 잘 부탁드려요!
		character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_new_20', skip = true })

		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		character_util.set_position(succubus_a, succubus_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 0.3))
		character_util.set_direction(succubus_a, 'left')
		character_util.remove_emotion(succubus_a)

		character_util.set_position(leader, player_marker.position + vector(0, 1, -0.15))
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'meditation', loop = true })
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

		character_util.set_position(picky_customer, picky_customer_marker.position + vector(0, 0, -6))

		camera_util.move(succubus_a.Position, 0)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_cakeshop_01')
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 까다로운 손님 입장
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(picky_customer, picky_customer_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
				2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.jump_move(picky_customer, picky_customer_marker.position + vector(0, 0.5, 1),
				2.5, 0.5, true, 'right')

		-- 그녀가 없는 걸 알면서도… 나도 모르게 여길 와버리고 말았군
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(picky_customer, { name = 'seat', loop = true }, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(picky_customer, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_3', skip = true })

		-- 오늘 한 번만 믿어볼까?
		character_util.set_emotion(picky_customer, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(picky_customer, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_4', skip = true })

		-- 여기 주문!
		character_util.remove_emotion(picky_customer)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(picky_customer, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_5', skip = true })

		-- 그때 그 손님이에요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_direction(succubus_a, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_6', skip = true, scale = small_size })

		-- 빅 마더께선 항상 처음이 중요하다 하셨어요…
		character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_7', skip = true, scale = small_size })

		-- 첫 인사는 어떻게하면 좋을까요?
		character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_8', skip = true, scale = small_size })

		self:first_part_make_decision()
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'tired' })
	end

	self.controller.interacting = false

	if self.success == true then
		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
	end
end

--region 1 분기 이벤트
function local_class:first_part_make_decision()

	-- 손님. 주문 받겠습니다.
	-- 후후, 성질 급한 손님이네~
	local selection_table = { { 'demon_world_made_queen_2_9', 'mercy' }, { 'demon_world_made_queen_2_10', 'brutal' } }

	-- 엄격한 모성애
	if user_progress:ClearedQuest(self.bully_kid_quest_id) then
		table.insert(selection_table, { 'demon_world_made_queen_2_11', 'forced' })
	end

	local attitude_ans = choose_util.play_choose_event(selection_table)

	if attitude_ans == 1 then
		self:first_part_decision_1()
	elseif attitude_ans == 2 then
		self:first_part_decision_2()
	elseif attitude_ans == 3 then
		self:first_part_decision_3()
	end

	self:second_part_make_decision()
end

-- 1 분기 1 선택지
function local_class:first_part_decision_1()

	local succubus_a = self.controller.get_succubus_a()

	character_util.set_direction(succubus_a, 'left')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_12', skip = true, scale = small_size })

	-- 이전과 달라보이진 않지만…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_13', skip = true, scale = small_size })

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(picky_customer, { name = 'seat', loop = true }, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(picky_customer, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_15', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'question', loop = false }, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(succubus_a, nil, 'silence')

	-- 네 손님. 주문 받겠습니다.
	character_util.remove_anim(succubus_a)
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_16', skip = true })

	-- … 그게 단가?
	character_util.set_emotion(picky_customer, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(picky_customer, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_17', skip = true })

	-- 네, 네! 혹시 찾으시는 거라도…….
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_18', skip = true })

	-- 아니… 됐어.
	camera_util.move_async(picky_customer.Position, camera_zoom_dur)
	character_util.set_emotion(picky_customer, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(picky_customer, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_21', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_22', skip = true })

	camera_util.resize_to(3.25, camera_zoom_dur)

	local picky_customer = self.controller.get_picky_customer()
	local small_size = self.small_size
	local succubus_marker = self.succubus_educate_start_marker
	local picky_customer_marker = self.picky_customer_educate_start_marker

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.move(picky_customer.Position, 0)

	character_util.remove_anim(succubus_a)
	character_util.set_position(succubus_a, succubus_marker.position + vector(-4, 0, 0), false)
	character_util.set_direction(succubus_a, 'right')

	character_util.set_position(picky_customer, picky_customer_marker.position + vector(0, 0.5, 1))
	character_util.set_anim(picky_customer, { name = 'seat', loop = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(picky_customer)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_cakeshop_01')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if self.right_answered_times == 0 then
		-- 뭔가 불안하지만, 어떻게든 넘겼네요.
		character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_1', skip = true, scale = small_size })
	else
		-- 대성공이었어요!
		character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'smile' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_1_1', skip = true, scale = small_size })
	end

	-- 선배는 늘 마무리가 가장 중요하다 했어요…!
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_2', skip = true, scale = small_size })

	-- 승부가 될 만한 한 마디…
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_3', skip = true, scale = small_size })

	-- 한 번 생각해주세요!
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_4', skip = true, scale = small_size })

	-- 분기 2 시작: 고객을 대하는 입장
	-- 오늘의 추천 메뉴입니다.
	-- 혹시… 뉴튜브 보세요?
	-- 맘마 먹을 시간이에요.
	local selection_table = { { 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_5', 'mercy' }, { 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_6', 'brutal' } }

	if user_progress:ClearedQuest(self.boss_secretary_quest_id) then
		table.insert(selection_table, { 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_7', 'forced' })
	end

	local attitude_ans = choose_util.play_choose_event(selection_table)

	if attitude_ans == 1 then
		self:second_part_decision_1()
	elseif attitude_ans == 2 then
		self:second_part_decision_2()
	elseif attitude_ans == 3 then
		self:second_part_decision_3()
	end
end

function local_class:second_part_decision_3()
	self.second_selection = 3
	local succubus_a = self.controller.get_succubus_a()
	local picky_customer = self.controller.get_picky_customer()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local small_size = self.small_size

	-- 따스한 어머니의 위로요…?
	character_util.normal_jump(succubus_a, '01_player_jump_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_38', skip = true, scale = small_size })

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'seat', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'release', loop = true, upper = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'meditation', loop = true })

	-- 설마 선배가 남기고 간 분유가… 마무리 승부수!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_39', skip = true, scale = small_size })

	-- 잠시… 좀 데울게요. 어머니께서 분유는 꼭 36.4℃가 되어야 한다 했거든요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_40', skip = true, scale = small_size })

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(succubus_a, { name = 'boong_attack', keep_anim = true, count = 1 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slide_01')
	local feeding_bottle = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = succubus_a.Position + vector(0.75, 0.4, 0),
														itemid = self.feeding_bottle_id, notforinven = true,
														lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true, skip_text = true })
	feeding_bottle.SpriteTransform.localScale = 0.01 * unity_class.vector3.one

	local appear_time = 1
	local cur_time = 0.01
	while true do
		cur_time = cur_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = cur_time / appear_time
		if progress >= 1 then
			break
		end
		local size = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
		feeding_bottle.SpriteTransform.localScale = size
		feeding_bottle.ShadowTransform.localScale = size
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')
	local fire_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_fire_effect):Instantiate(succubus_a.Position + vector(0.75, 0.5, -0.1))
	fire_effect.transform.localScale = 0.7 * unity_class.vector3.one
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local shrink_time = 0.5
	cur_time = 0

	while true do
		cur_time = cur_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = cur_time / shrink_time
		local size = 1 - progress
		if progress >= 1 then
			break
		end
		size = size > 0.7 and 0.7 or size
		fire_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * size
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	fire_effect:Dispose()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	feeding_bottle:ConsumeComplete()
	feeding_bottle = nil
	character_util.remove_anim(succubus_a)

	-- 우리 아가… 맘마 먹을 시간이에요…!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'sing', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_41', skip = true, scale = small_size })

	-- 뭐…? 방금 뭐라고…
	character_util.set_direction(picky_customer, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(picky_customer, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(picky_customer, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_42', skip = true })

	-- 우리 아가, 맘마 먹자.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_43', skip = true })

	-- 맘-마-!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_44', skip = true })

	-- ……
	character_util.set_emotion(picky_customer, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(picky_customer, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_45', skip = true })

	-- 역시 이런 게 통할리가…
	character_util.set_anim(succubus_a, { name = 'sing', loop = false, scale = 9999 })
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_46', skip = true, scale = small_size })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(picky_customer)
	local start_position = picky_customer.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall()
	local v = 3
	local a = 15
	local d = picky_customer.Position.y
	local dest_pos = start_position + vector(-1, -start_position.y, 0)
	local duration = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.CalculateDurationIncludingBounces(v, a, d, -start_position.y, 0)
	free_fall:SetParameters(v, a, d, 0)
	local time_passed = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	while time_passed < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		free_fall:Proceed(dt)

		local y = free_fall:GetDistance()
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(vector_util.get_x0z(start_position, y), vector_util.get_x0z(dest_pos, y), progress)
		character_util.set_position(picky_customer, pos, true)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(picky_customer, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false, scale = 9999 }, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_position(picky_customer, dest_pos, false)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 응애애애애!
	character_util.normal_jump(picky_customer)
	character_util.set_emotion(picky_customer, { name = 'cry' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true }, { name = 'surprise' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_baby_cry_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(picky_customer,
			{ key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_47', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.2 })

	-- 맘마 줘! 맘마!
	character_util.normal_double_jump(picky_customer, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(picky_customer, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_48', skip = true })

	-- 어, 어?
	character_util.remove_anim(succubus_a)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_49', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	feeding_bottle = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = succubus_a.Position + vector(0.15, 0, 0),
												  target = picky_customer.Position,
												  itemid = self.feeding_bottle_id, notforinven = true,
												  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true, skip_text = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	character_util.remove_anim(succubus_a)
	feeding_bottle.ConsumeTarget = picky_customer
	feeding_bottle:Fly()

	-- 	-- 그래, 여기 맘마!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_50', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(picky_customer, { name = 'seat', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })
	self.drinking_feeding_bottle = true
	self.drinking_feeding_bottle_routine_ended = false
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.drink_feeding_bottle, self, picky_customer))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(picky_customer, nil, 'heart')

	-- 아이, 착하다. 우리 아가 오늘 힘들었지?
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(succubus_a, { name = 'sing', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_51', skip = true })

	-- 맘마 먹고, 오늘 힘들었던건 전부 잊는 거야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_52', skip = true })

	-- 알겠지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_a, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_53', skip = true })

	self.drinking_feeding_bottle = false

	while true do
		if self.drinking_feeding_bottle_routine_ended then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 응!
	character_util.normal_jump(picky_customer, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(picky_customer, { key = 'demon_world_made_queen_2_2_54', skip = true })

	self.right_answered_times = self.right_answered_times + 1

	self:play_ending_based_on_decision()
end

--region 3분기 엔딩 관련
function local_class:play_ending_based_on_decision()
	CS.UnityEngine.Debug.Log(self.first_selection + self.second_selection)
	if self.first_selection + self.second_selection == 6 then
		self:play_right_ending()
	else
		self:play_wrong_ending()
	end
end

function local_class:play_right_ending()
	local succubus_a = self.controller.get_succubus_a()
	local picky_customer = self.controller.get_picky_customer()
	local ending_customer_1 = self.controller.get_ending_customer_1()
	local ending_customer_2 = self.controller.get_ending_customer_2()
	local ending_customer_3 = self.controller.get_ending_customer_3()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if self.liquor_bottle ~= nil then
		self.liquor_bottle:ConsumeComplete()
		self.liquor_bottle = nil
	end

function local_class:drink_feeding_bottle(fo)
	fo.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'feeding_bottle_90')
	self.drinking_feeding_bottle_routine_ended = false

	while true do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drinking_01')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(fo, { name = 'dualgun_attack_right', upper = true, loop = false, count = 1, scale = 0.3 })
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'dualgun_attack_right', upper = true, scale = 0.0001, loop = false })

		local stop = false
		for i = 1, 10 do
			wait_for_sec(0.1)
			if not self.drinking_feeding_bottle then
				stop = true
				break
			end
		end

		if stop then
			break
		end

	character_util.remove_anim(fo, true)
	fo.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
end

function local_class:throw_item_on_table(thrower, id, end_pos)
	local sprite_size = 0.8 * unity_class.vector3.one

	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = 'attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = thrower.Position + vector(0.15, 0, 0),
											  itemid = id, notforinven = true,
											  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true, skip_text = true })
	item.SpriteTransform.localScale = sprite_size
	self:move_rotate_item(item, 0.5, end_pos, 0.6, 3)
	character_util.remove_anim(thrower)

	return item
end

function local_class:move_rotate_item(item, duration, end_pos, height, rotate_count)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = item.Position
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		item.Position = cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)
		local cur_rot_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 360 * rotate_count, progress)
		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rot_z)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_player_weapon()
	if self.player_weapon_right == nil then
		self.player_weapon_right = user_party.Leader.Weapon1
	end

	if self.player_weapon_left == nil then
		self.player_weapon_left = user_party.Leader.Weapon2
	end

	user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, nil)
	user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, nil)
	user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
end

function local_class:restore_player_weapon()
	user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, self.player_weapon_right)
	user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, self.player_weapon_left)
end

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldMainPartASection10')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonWorldMainPartA @
		Comment = 4스테이지로 이동 @
		Index = 9 @
		NextSections = 10 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = "demonworld_part1_1_3"

	-- 대사
	self.main_script = 'demonworld_part1_s10_'

	-- 오딜
	self.ordeal = nil

	-- 경찰 리스트
	self.police_list = nil

	-- Exit 관련
	self.exit_next_stage = nil

	-- 기타 상수
	self.police_num = 4

	-- NPC 이름
	self.trouble_shooter_name = 'trouble_shooter'
	self.police_name = 'section_10_police_'

	-- 필드오브젝트 이름
	self.exit_office_name = 'exit_office'
	self.exit_name = 'exit_passage_12_2'

	-- 마커 이름

	-- 존 이름
	self.office_event_zone_name = 'trouble_shooter_house'

	-- 퀘스트 마커, 트래커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = "demonworld_main_part_a"
	self.quest_tracker_name_1 = "demonworld_part1_s10_tracker_1"

	-- 오브젝트 풀 프리셋 이름
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
	)
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.ordeal = get_character(self.trouble_shooter_name)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.ordeal, 'disabled')

	self.police_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.police_num do
		local cur_character = get_character(self.police_name..i)
		cur_character.Interactable.Talk = nil

		character_util.add_listener(cur_character, self.controller)
		self.police_list:Add(cur_character)
	end

	self.exit_next_stage = get_field_object(self.exit_name)
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	quest_icon_util.remove(self.ordeal)

	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.police_list[2])

	-- 이 섹션부터 시작한 경우, 입장 처리는 여기서 해준다.
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 9 then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
				self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.exit_next_stage)
	else
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object(self.exit_office_name))
	end

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.ordeal = nil
	self.police_list = nil

	self.exit_next_stage = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end

	if e.Zone.Name == self.office_event_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object(self.exit_office_name))
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	if not e.FullLeave then return end

	if e.Zone.Name == self.office_event_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
				self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.exit_next_stage)
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 0, self.police_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.police_list[i]) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.police_event, self)

			break
		end
	end
end

--- ExclusiveQuestStartEvent
function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		for i = 0, self.police_list.Count - 1 do
			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.police_list[i], self.controller)
		end

		quest_icon_util.remove(self.police_list[1])
	end
end

--- ExclusiveQuestEndEvent
function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		for i = 0, self.police_list.Count - 1 do
			character_util.add_listener(self.police_list[i], self.controller)
		end

		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.police_list[1])
	end
end

-- 경찰 이벤트

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_barricade_event and
				string.find(e.Zone.Name, self.barricade_event_zone_name) then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_barricade_event

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.barricade_event, self)
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.inner_zone_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		end
	end
end

	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.inner_zone_name then

function local_class:on_event(e)

		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_loot_body_event and
				e.Zone.Name == self.loot_body_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_loot_body_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.loot_body_event, self))
		elseif self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_isolation_event and
				e.Zone.Name == self.campfire_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_isolation_event

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_isolation_event, self)
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.complete_investigate and
				e.Zone.Name == self.bug_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_bug_event

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.bug_event, self)
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_bug_event and
				e.Zone.Name == self.turing_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_turing_event

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.appear_turing_event, self)
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.inner_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_isolation_event then
				for i = 1, #self.quarantine_civiilan_table do
					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..i)
				end
			else
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.inner_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.idle then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-0.5, 0, 67.5))
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_loot_body_event then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(40.5, 0, 67.5))
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_isolation_event then
				for i = 1, #self.quarantine_civiilan_table do
					if not self.quarantine_civiilan_table[i].flag then
						ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name..i, self.quest_id,
								self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.quarantine_civiilan_table[i].character)
					end
				end
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.complete_investigate then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(66, 0, 67.5))
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_bug_event then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(36.5, 0, 89))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.quarantine_civiilan_table do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.quarantine_civiilan_table[i].character) then
			if not self.quarantine_civiilan_table[i].flag then
				self.quarantine_civiilan_table[i].flag = true

				character_util.remove_relate_event(self.quarantine_civiilan_table[i].character, self.controller)
				quest_icon_util.remove(self.quarantine_civiilan_table[i].character)

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.investigate_quarantine_civilian, self, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key == self.sub_quest_key then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_isolation_event then
			for i = 1, #self.quarantine_civiilan_table do
				if not self.quarantine_civiilan_table[i].flag then
					quest_icon_util.remove(self.quarantine_civiilan_table[i].character)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key == self.sub_quest_key then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_isolation_event then
			for i = 1, #self.quarantine_civiilan_table do
				if not self.quarantine_civiilan_table[i].flag then
					quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.quarantine_civiilan_table[i].character)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	self.odile = nil

	self.sealstone = nil
	self.mouse_bomb = nil

	if self.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect = nil
	end

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
		self.resholder = nil
	end

	if self.large_bug_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.large_bug_effect.gameObject)
		self.large_bug_effect = nil
	end

	if self.bug_sfx_1 ~= nil then
		self.bug_sfx_1:FadeOut(0)
		self.bug_sfx_1 = nil
	end

	if self.bug_sfx_2 ~= nil then
		self.bug_sfx_2:FadeOut(0)
		self.bug_sfx_2 = nil
	end

	if self.sealstone_sfx ~= nil then
		self.sealstone_sfx:FadeOut(0)
		self.sealstone_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent) then
		self:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.turing_fight and
				e.Zone.Name == self.turing_fight_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.turing_fight

			local fight_turing = get_character(self.battle_turing_name)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(fight_turing,
					{ key = self.main_script..1, bubble_type = 'shout' })
		elseif self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_mouse_bomb_event and
				e.Zone.Name == self.mouse_bomb_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_mouse_bomb_event

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mouse_bomb_event, self)
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.inner_zone_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.inner_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.idle then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
						self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.mouse_bomb)
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.destroy_seal_stone then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
						self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.sealstone)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.sealstone) then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.interact_with_seal_stone then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.interact_with_seal_stone

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_seal_stone_event, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.mouse_bomb) and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_mouse_bomb_event then
		if not self.is_mouse_bomb_move then
			self.is_mouse_bomb_move = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.sealstone_damage_obj) and
			self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_mouse_bomb_event then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.destroy_seal_stone

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.destroy_seal_stone_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:phone_jump(phone, add_pos, duration)
	local timer = 0

	local start_pos = phone.Position
	local end_pos = start_pos + add_pos

	local cur_duration = duration / 2

	while timer < cur_duration do
		local progress = timer / cur_duration
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		phone.Position = cur_pos

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	phone.Position = end_pos

	timer = 0

	end_pos = start_pos
	start_pos = phone.Position

	while timer < cur_duration do
		local progress = timer / cur_duration
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		phone.Position = cur_pos

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	phone.Position = end_pos
end

end

--[[QuestAttribute

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.wave_1_battle_name = "battle_1"

	self.wave_1_battle_group_name_2 = "wave_1_2"

	-- 웨이브 1 전투 배틀 그룹 이름 3
	self.wave_1_battle_group_name_3 = "wave_1_3"

	-- 웨이브 카운트
	self.wave_count = 0

	self.tilemap_x_rot = 30
	self.need_tilemap_recover = false

	self.swipe_type = ''

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_gatling_gun_gang = function() return get_character('gatlinggun_gang') end

	-- 개틀링 갱 죽었나 살았나 판별용
	self.is_gatlinggun_gang_dead = false

	-- 스나이퍼 연출용 이펙트
	self.get_fx_target_circle_loop = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_targetcircle_typeb_loop') end
	self.get_fx_target_circle_end = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_targetcircle_typeb_end') end
	self.get_fx_critical_hit_blood = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Critical_Hit_Blood') end
	self.get_custom_sprite = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite') end

	self.pooled_bullet = nil

	-- 이벤트 상태값
	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		battle_1_start = 1,
		battle_1_end = 2,
		gatling_gun_event = 3,
		after_gatling_gun = 4,
		battle_4_event = 5,
		battle_4_end = 6,
		fall_down_event = 7,
		next_section = 8
	}

	-- 현재 이벤트 상태
	self.current_state = self.event_state.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_GunShot_Groundhit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_GunShot_Firing')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_windowbreak')

	self.get_fx_target_circle_loop()
	self.get_fx_target_circle_end()
	self.get_fx_critical_hit_blood()
	self.get_custom_sprite()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	-- 총알 프리로드
	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local custom_atlas
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	self.pooled_bullet = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
	local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
	bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'sniper_shot_middle.png'
	bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_revive_event')

	local trouble_shooter = get_character('trouble_shooter')
	character_util.set_position(trouble_shooter, vector(0, 0, -4))
	character_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'up')
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(trouble_shooter, user_party)
	trouble_shooter.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Immortal = true

	local mk2 = get_character('mk2')
	character_util.set_position(mk2, vector(0.5, 0, 19.5))
	character_util.set_direction(mk2, 'down')
	mk2.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'basic_handgun')
	character_util.set_anim(mk2, { name = 'sniper_shoot', loop = false})

	local mad_scientist = get_character('mad_scientist')
	character_util.set_position(mad_scientist, vector(0.5, 0, 18.65))
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(mad_scientist, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(mad_scientist, { name = 'push' })

	for i = 1, 4 do
		character_util.set_active_state(get_character('battle_1_0_'..i), 'disabled')
	end

	-- 웨이브 1 전투 적 설정
	for i = 1, self.wave_1_battle_monster_num[1] do
		local c = get_character(string.format("%s%s%d", self.wave_1_battle_name, '_1_', i))
		table.insert(self.wave_1_battle_list, c)
	end
	for i = 1, self.wave_1_battle_monster_num[2] do
		local c = get_character(string.format("%s%s%d", self.wave_1_battle_name, '_2_', i))
		table.insert(self.wave_1_battle_list, c)
	end
	for i = 1, self.wave_1_battle_monster_num[3] do
		local c = get_character(string.format("%s%s%d", self.wave_1_battle_name, '_3_', i))
		table.insert(self.wave_1_battle_list, c)
	end
	for i = 1, #self.wave_1_battle_list do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.wave_1_battle_list[i], 0, 0)
		character_util.set_active_state(self.wave_1_battle_list[i], 'disabled')
	end

	for i = 3, 4 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(string.format("%s%d", self.wave_1_battle_gate_name, i )))
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove('marker')
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'marker', vector(154, 0, -52))

	for i = 1, 16 do
		character_util.set_anim(get_character('battle_4_'..i), { name = 'dagger_idle' })
		character_util.set_emotion(get_character('battle_4_'..i), { name = 'doyagao' })
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(get_character('battle_4_'..i), 0, 0)
		character_util.set_active_state(get_character('battle_4_'..i), 'disabled')
	end

	local potion_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{itemid = 20259, notforinven = true, pos = vector(31.5, 0, 34.5),
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', target = vector(31.5, 0, 34.5), skip_text = true})

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 0})

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({
		name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_demonworld_event_8', state = 'field'
	})

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'field'
	})
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))

	-- 스나이퍼 에임 Dispose
	self:dispose_sniper_attack_range()

	if self.pooled_bullet ~= nil then
		self.pooled_bullet:Dispose()
		self.pooled_bullet = nil
	end
end

--region on_event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		return self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_revive_event(e)
	if self.wave_count < 4 and e.FieldObject == user_party.Leader  then
		local battle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleFor(user_party.Leader)
		if battle == nil then
			start_coroutine(self.wave_1_battle_notice, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local next_section_interact = get_field_object('next_section_interact')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, next_section_interact) then
		-- 해당 이벤트를 여러번 발생시키지 못하게 NonInteractable로 변경함
		next_section_interact.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.next_section, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	self:quest_marker_setting(zone_name)

	if self.current_state == self.event_state.none and zone_name == 'event_1_zone' then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.battle_1_start
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening_event, self))
	end

	if self.current_state == self.event_state.battle_1_end then
		if zone_name == 'gatlinggun_event_1' or zone_name == 'gatlinggun_event_2' then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.gatling_gun_event
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gatling_gun_event_1, self))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.event_state.gatling_gun_event then
		return false
	else
		if not self.is_gatlinggun_gang_dead and zone_name == 'gatlinggun_event_2' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gatling_gun_event_2, self))
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.event_state.after_gatling_gun and zone_name == 'battle_4_mid' then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.battle_4_event
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_4_event, self))
	end

	if self.current_state == self.event_state.battle_4_end and zone_name == 'fall_down' then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.fall_down_event
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_down_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.wave_1_battle_group_name_0 then
		self.wave_count = self.wave_count + 1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_wave_1_battle_1, self))
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.wave_1_battle_group_name_1 then
		self.wave_count = self.wave_count + 1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_wave_1_battle_2, self))
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.wave_1_battle_group_name_2 then
		self.wave_count = self.wave_count + 1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_wave_1_battle_3, self))
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.wave_1_battle_group_name_3 then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.battle_1_end
		self.wave_count = self.wave_count + 1

		quest_marker_util.remove('marker')
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'marker', vector(7, 0, 54))
		for i = 1, self.wave_1_battle_gate_num do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(string.format("%s%d", self.wave_1_battle_gate_name, i )))
		end
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'battle_4' then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.battle_4_end
		local exit1 = get_field_object('hallway_exit_1')
		exit1.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		local exit2 = get_field_object('hallway_exit_2')
		exit2.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'marker', vector(54.5, 0, 90.5))
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'battle_6' then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('battle_6_battlegate_'..i))
		end
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'battle_7' then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.section_end_event, self))
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'down'
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	local gang = self.get_gatling_gun_gang()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, gang) then
		self.is_gatlinggun_gang_dead = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:quest_marker_setting(zone_name)
	if zone_name == 'hallway' or zone_name == 'battle_4' or zone_name == 'battle_4_mid' then
		if self.need_tilemap_recover == false then
			self.need_tilemap_recover = true
			--self:set_tilemap()
		end
		quest_marker_util.remove('marker')
		if self.current_state ~= self.event_state.battle_4_event then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'marker', vector(54.5, 0, 90.5))
		end
	else
		if self.need_tilemap_recover == true then
			self.need_tilemap_recover = false
			--self:recover_tilemap()
		end
		if zone_name == '1F' then
			if self.current_state == self.event_state.none then
				quest_marker_util.remove('marker')
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'marker', vector(0.5, 0, 15.5))
			else
				quest_marker_util.remove('marker')
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'marker', vector(7, 0, 54))
			end
		elseif zone_name == '2F' then
			if self.current_state == self.event_state.battle_1_end then
				quest_marker_util.remove('marker')
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'marker', vector(41.5, 0, 68.5))
			else
				quest_marker_util.remove('marker')
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'marker', vector(69.5, 0, 49.5))
			end
		elseif zone_name == 'side' then
			quest_marker_util.remove('marker')
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'marker', vector(107.5, 0, 36))
		elseif zone_name == 'rooftop' then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_intro_demonworld_01')
			quest_marker_util.remove('marker')
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'marker', vector(94, 0, 87.5))
		elseif zone_name == '3F' then
			if self.current_state == self.event_state.next_section then
				quest_marker_util.remove('marker')
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'marker', get_field_object('next_section_interact'))

function local_class:wave_1_battle_convert_monster()

	local monster_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.wave_1_battle_monster_num[self.wave_count] do
		local c
		if self.wave_count > 1 then
			local temp = 0
			for j = 1, self.wave_count - 1 do
				temp = temp + self.wave_1_battle_monster_num[j]
			end
			c = self.wave_1_battle_list[i + temp]
		else
			c = self.wave_1_battle_list[i]
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(c, 'enabled')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(c, 1, 0)
		if c.Position.x > 0.5 then
			character_util.move_to(c, c.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), 0.5, nil, true, true)
		else
			character_util.move_to(c, c.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 0.5, nil, true, true)
		end

		table.insert(monster_list, c)
	end

	for i = 1, #monster_list do
		if self.wave_count == 1 then
			character_util.convert_to_monster(monster_list[i], self.wave_1_battle_group_name_1)
		elseif self.wave_count == 2 then
			character_util.convert_to_monster(monster_list[i], self.wave_1_battle_group_name_2)
		else
			character_util.convert_to_monster(monster_list[i], self.wave_1_battle_group_name_3)
		end

		command_util.publish_monster_notice(monster_list[i], user_party.Leader, "battle")
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:gatling_gun_effect_1(pos, duration)
	local effect_term = 0.025
	local time_passed = 0
	local effect_time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		effect_time_passed = effect_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if effect_term <= effect_time_passed then
			local aim = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos + vector(-6, 0, 0), pos, time_passed)

			local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
			local target_x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.7, 1.2)
			local target_z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.7, 1.2)
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_GunShot_Groundhit'):Instantiate(aim + vector(target_x, 0, target_z))

			effect_time_passed = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:set_tilemap()
	local tilemap = field.Tilemap

	for i = 0, tilemap.transform.childCount - 1 do
		local layer_tf = tilemap.transform:GetChild(i)
		local layer = layer_tf:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Tilemaps.Layer))
		local to_manage = (layer.LayerType == CS.Tilemaps.LayerType.Tile) and layer_tf.name ~= 'gimmick' and layer_tf.name ~= 'wall_invisible'

		if to_manage then
			layer_tf.position = layer_tf.position + vector(0, 43, 13.75)
			layer_tf.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(self.tilemap_x_rot, 0, 0)
		end
	end

	local factor = get_field_object('move_factor')
	--factor.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
end

		local to_manage = (layer.LayerType == CS.Tilemaps.LayerType.Tile) and layer_tf.name ~= 'gimmick' and layer_tf.name ~= 'wall_invisible'

function local_class:monster_appear(target, vtr, speed, battle_group)
	character_util.set_active_state(target, 'enabled')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(target, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'run' })

	character_util.jump(target, 1, 0.6)
	character_util.move_to_async(target, target.Position + vtr, nil, speed, true, false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
	character_util.convert_to_monster(target, battle_group)
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(target, user_party_leader, "battle")
end

function local_class:free_fall_func(object, start_pos, end_pos, duration)
	local time = 0
	local free_fall_fire = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(9.8, 19.6, 0, 0)
	while time < duration do
		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		free_fall_fire:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall_fire:GetDistance()
		local move_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time / duration)
		object.transform.position = move_pos + vector(0, 1, 0) * dist_y
		object.transform.localScale = (1 - ((time/duration) * 0.25)) * unity_class.vector3.one
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

--region hook_shot
function local_class:launch_hook_shot(character, transform, speed)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.launch_hook_shot_routine, self, character, transform, speed))
end

function local_class:launch_hook_shot_routine(character, transform, speed)
	self:stop_hook_shot(character)

	local req_id = self.hook_shot_req_id[character]
	speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(speed, 18)

	local pooled_hook_shot = self.get_hook_shot():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local hook_shot = pooled_hook_shot:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))
	local length = 0
	local is_launch = true

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hookshot_pull_02')

	while req_id == self.hook_shot_req_id[character] do
		if is_launch then
			length = length + (unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed)
		end

		local hook_shot_position = transform.position
		local character_position = character.Transform.position

		local diff = (hook_shot_position - character_position)
		local distance = diff.magnitude + 0.5
		local direction = diff.normalized

		if length >= distance or not is_launch then
			if is_launch then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')
			end

			is_launch = false
			length = distance
		end

		local bounds = character.Hitbox:ToWorldBounds(character.Transform.position)
		hook_shot:SetFromTo(bounds.center + direction * CS.Oak.HookShot.MinLength, bounds.center + direction * length)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	pooled_hook_shot:Dispose()
end

function local_class:stop_hook_shot(character)
	if not self.hook_shot_req_id[character] then
		self.hook_shot_req_id[character] = 0
	end

	self.hook_shot_req_id[character] = self.hook_shot_req_id[character] + 1
end
--endregion

--region util
function local_class:character_jump_async(fo, height, duration)
	height = lua_helper.get_or_default(height, 0.5)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0.3)

	local position = fo.Position

	self.is_jumping = true
	local time_passed = 0
	while self.is_jumping and time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y_offset = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

		fo.Position = position + vector(0, y_offset, 0)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	if self.is_jumping then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		fo.Position = position
	end

	self.is_jumping = false
end

function local_class:character_jump(fo, height, duration)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.character_jump_async, self, fo, height, duration))
end

function local_class:character_jump_and_go_async(fo, height, distance, duration)
	local position = fo.Position

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y_offset = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		local x_offset = progress * distance

		fo.Position = position + vector(x_offset, y_offset, 0)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
end

function local_class:character_jump_and_go(fo, height, distance, duration)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.character_jump_and_go_async, self, fo, height, distance, duration))
end

function local_class:character_jump_stop()
	self.is_jumping = false
end
--endregion

function local_class:move_car(car, start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	while true do
		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine(time_passed, start_pos.x, target_pos.x - start_pos.x, duration)
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine(time_passed, start_pos.z, target_pos.z - start_pos.z, duration)

		car.Position = vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	car.Position = target_pos
end
