local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldMainPartASection19')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = DemonWorldMainPartA @
		Comment = 오딜 그레모리 사무소에서 대화 @
		Index = 18 @
		NextSections = 19 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = "demonworld_part1_1_3"

	self.get_trouble_shooter = function() return get_character('trouble_shooter') end
	self.get_mad_scientist = function() return get_character('mad_scientist') end
	self.get_desk = function() return get_field_object('ordeal_desk') end

	-- NPC
	self.trouble_shooter = nil
	self.mad_scientist = nil
	self.hide_npc_list = {}
	self.hide_npc_origin_pos = {}
	self.hide_party_origin_pos = {}

	-- 필드오브젝트 이름
	self.exit_name = 'entry_office'
	self.exit_stage_name = 'exit_substage_12_1'

	-- 마커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'demonworld_main_part_a'

	-- 오브젝트 풀 프리셋 이름
	self.twinkle_fx_name = 'FX_Object_Twinkle'

	-- 이벤트 상태값
	self.s19_event_state = {
		none = 0,
		-- 대화 처음 걸었을 때 체크
		talk_trouble_shooter = 1
	}
	self.current_state = self.s19_event_state.none

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
		'FX_hit',
		self.twinkle_fx_name
	)

	yield_return_func(self.set_optimized_npc, self)
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	self:set_quest_marker(true, nil)
	character_util.add_listener(self.get_trouble_shooter(), self.controller)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'trouble_shooter_house' then
				self:set_quest_marker(false, true)
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'trouble_shooter_house' then
				self:set_quest_marker(false, false)
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 오딜과 상호작용
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_trouble_shooter()) or
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_desk()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_event, self))

		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:hide_office_npc()
	self.hide_npc_list = {
		get_character('wyvern_old_woman'),
		get_character('wyvern_red'),
		get_character('wyvern_red_2'),
		get_character('wyvern_yellow'),
		get_character('wyvern_green'),
		get_character('wyvern_purple'),
		get_character('wyvern_blue')
	}

	for i = 1, #self.hide_npc_list do
		table.insert(self.hide_npc_origin_pos, self.hide_npc_list[i].Position)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.hide_npc_list[i], 0, 0)
		character_util.set_position(self.hide_npc_list[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
	end


	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.hide_party_origin_pos, user_party[i].Position)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 0, 0)
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], vector(999, 0, 999))

	end
end

function local_class:show_office_npc()
	for i = 1, #self.hide_npc_list do
		character_util.set_position(self.hide_npc_list[i], self.hide_npc_origin_pos[i])
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.hide_npc_list[i], 1, 0.5)
	end

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], self.hide_party_origin_pos[i])
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 1, 0.5)
	end

end

function local_class:set_optimized_npc()
	self.optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		mad_scientist_event = 'demon1_mad_scientist'
	})

end

function local_class:remove_optimized_npc()
	-- 동적 로딩한 캐릭터들 전부 제거
	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)

function local_class:spine_scaleup(fo, strat_size, end_size, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	while true do
		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		local size = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(strat_size, end_size, progress)

		fo.SpineController.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * size

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

end

-- 카메라 이동
function local_class:heavenhold_camera_move()
	local heavenhold_camera = self.heavenhold_obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	heavenhold_camera.orthographicSize = 3.5

	heavenhold_camera.transform.localPosition = vector(-10, 10.5, -3)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < 8 do

		if not self.heavenhold_camera_stat then
			break
		end
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / 8

		if heavenhold_camera ~= nil then
			local pos_x = -10 + 14 * normalized
			heavenhold_camera.transform.localPosition = vector(pos_x, 10.5, -3)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

		local loop_time = 1
		local red_tint_on = red_check
		local target_color = unity_color{ 1, 1, 1, 1 }
		local start_color = unity_color{ 1, 0.5, 1, 1 }

		while true do

			if red_tint_on then
				target_color = unity_color{ 1, 0.5, 0.5, 1 }
				start_color = unity_color{ 1, 1, 1, 1 }
			else
				target_color = unity_color{ 1, 1, 1, 1 }
				start_color = unity_color{ 1, 0.5, 0.5, 1 }
			end

			local time_passed = 0

			while time_passed < loop_time do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / loop_time)
				local lerp_g = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_color.g, target_color.g, progress)
				local lerp_b = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_color.b, target_color.b, progress)
				local tint_progress = unity_color{ 1, lerp_g, lerp_b, 1}
				self:tint_color(self.bg_order_room, tint_progress)

				coroutine.yield()
			end
			self:tint_color(self.bg_order_room, target_color)
			if red_tint_on then
				red_tint_on = false
			else

function local_class:tint_color(root_object, target_color)
	local sprites = root_object.transform:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.CustomSprite));
	for i = 0, sprites.Length - 1 do
		local sprite = sprites[i]
		if self.sprite_origin_colors == nil then
			self.sprite_origin_colors = {}
		end
		local origin_color = sprite.TintColor
		if self.sprite_origin_colors[sprite] == nil then
			self.sprite_origin_colors[sprite] = origin_color
		else
			origin_color = self.sprite_origin_colors[sprite]
		end
		sprite.TintColor = unity_color{
			origin_color.r * target_color.r,
			origin_color.g * target_color.g,
			origin_color.b * target_color.b,
			origin_color.a * target_color.a}
		sprite:Rebuild(true)
	end
	local renderers = root_object.transform:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))
	local material_set = {}
	for i = 0, renderers.Length - 1 do
		local material = renderers[i].sharedMaterial
		if material_set[material] ~= true then
			if self.mat_origin_colors == nil then
				self.mat_origin_colors = {}
			end
			local origin_color
			if self.mat_origin_colors[material] ~= nil then
				origin_color = self.mat_origin_colors[material]
			end
			local color_prop_key
			if material:HasProperty('_Color') then
				color_prop_key = '_Color'
			elseif material:HasProperty('_TintColor') then
				color_prop_key = '_TintColor'
			end
			if color_prop_key ~= nil then
				if origin_color == nil then
					origin_color = material:GetColor(color_prop_key)
					self.mat_origin_colors[material] = origin_color
				end
				material:SetColor(color_prop_key,
						unity_color{
							origin_color.r * target_color.r,
							origin_color.g * target_color.g,
							origin_color.b * target_color.b,
							origin_color.a * target_color.a
						})
			end
			material_set[material] = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:restore_color()
	if self.sprite_origin_colors ~= nil then
		for sprite, color in pairs(self.sprite_origin_colors) do
			sprite.TintColor = color
			sprite:Rebuild(true)
		end
	end
	if self.mat_origin_colors ~= nil then
		for material, color in pairs(self.mat_origin_colors) do
			if material:HasProperty('_Color') then
				material:SetColor('_Color', color)
			elseif material:HasProperty('_TintColor') then
				material:SetColor('_TintColor', color)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:camera_shake(root, magnitude, duration)
	local camera = root.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))

	local start_pos = camera.transform.localPosition

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)
		local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)

		camera.transform.localPosition = start_pos + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera.transform.localPosition = start_pos
end

local local_class = newclass('DemonWorldMainPartASection20')

	self.quest_marker_name = 'demonworld_main_part_a'

		none = 0,
		-- 대화 처음 걸었을 때 체크

		-- 오딜 그레모리 파티 합류

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
	)

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.past_stage_name then
		-- 3스테이지일 경우
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	end

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드
	-- 리리스 타워일 경우
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.past_stage_name then
		-- 3스테이지일 경우
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress <= 18 then
			local exit = get_field_object('exit_office')
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, exit, true)

		else
			local exit = get_field_object('exit_substage_12_1')
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, exit, true)
		end

		return
	end

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드
	-- 리리스 타워일 경우

	character_util.set_position(self.get_mad_scientist(), vector(0, 0, 53))

	if stage.Name == self.past_stage_name then

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	end

    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.past_stage_name then
		-- 3스테이지일 경우
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
			self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
			self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		end
		return false
	end

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드
	-- 리리스 타워일 경우
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.past_stage_name then
		-- 3스테이지일 경우
		if e.FullEnter then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
				if e.Zone.Name == 'trouble_shooter_house' then
					local exit = get_field_object('exit_office')
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, exit, true)
					return true
				end

			end
		end
	end

	return false

end


function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		-- 리리스 타워일 경우
		if e.FullLeave then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
				if e.Zone.Name == 'lilith_tower_zone' then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.leave_warning_event, self))

					return true
				end
			end
		end

	elseif stage.Name == self.past_stage_name then
		-- 3스테이지일 경우
		if e.FullLeave then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
				if e.Zone.Name == 'trouble_shooter_house' then
					local exit = get_field_object('exit_substage_12_1')
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, exit, true)
					return true

				end

			end
		end
	end

	return false

end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 오딜과 상호작용
	if self.current_state == self.s20_event_state.none then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_trouble_shooter()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shooter_talk_event, self))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.s20_event_state.talk_trouble_shooter then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_trouble_shooter()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shooter_talk_event, self))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.s20_event_state.ong_in_party then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_guard(i)) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guard_talk_event, self))
			end
		end

	end

end

function local_class:leave_warning_event()
	if self.current_state == self.s20_event_state.ong_in_party then
		local trouble_shooter = self.get_trouble_shooter()

		local leader_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

		local odeal_talk = function (target_pos)
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
			stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

			character_util.look_at(trouble_shooter, user_party.Leader)
			character_util.set_emotion(trouble_shooter, {name = 'attack'})
			character_util.set_anim(trouble_shooter, {name = 'release'})

			-- 그 쪽이 아니라구!
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(trouble_shooter, { key = 'demonworld_part1_s20_14', skip = true})
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trouble_shooter)

			character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, target_pos, 1, nil, true, true)

			stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
			user_party:ResetControllers()
		end

		if leader_pos.z <= 50 then
			odeal_talk(vector(leader_pos.x, 0, 51))
			return

		elseif leader_pos.x <= -7 then
			odeal_talk(vector(-6, 0, leader_pos.z))
			return

		elseif leader_pos.x >= 6 then
			odeal_talk(vector(5, 0, leader_pos.z))
			return

		end

	end
end

	character_util.set_anim(trouble_shooter, {name = 'idle'})

	-- 가시죠. 이미 약속이 잡혀있습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_guard(3), { key = 'demonworld_part1_s20_10', skip = true})

	-- 너무 오래 그 분을 기다리게 하는 것은 현명하지 못하니까요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_guard(3), { key = 'demonworld_part1_s20_11', skip = true})

	-- 주인공 / 오딜 / 그레모리 서로를 바라보며 “?”
	character_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	character_util.set_anim(trouble_shooter, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
	character_util.set_anim(mad_scientist, {name = 'cross_arm'})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'bomb_idle'})

	character_util.set_emotion(trouble_shooter, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_emotion(mad_scientist, {name = 'tired'})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.show_emoticon(mad_scientist, nil, 'question')
	character_util.show_emoticon(trouble_shooter, nil, 'question')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'question')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trouble_shooter)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mad_scientist)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'up')

	-- 당신들을 기다리고 계십니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_guard(2), { key = 'demonworld_part1_s20_12', skip = true})

	duration = 1.5

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.get_guard(1))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.get_guard(2))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.get_guard(3))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.get_guard(4))

	character_util.move_to(self.get_guard(1), vector(-2.7, 0, 57) , duration, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to(self.get_guard(2), vector(-2.7, 0, 58) , duration, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to(self.get_guard(3), vector(1.7, 0, 58) , duration, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to(self.get_guard(4), vector(1.7, 0, 57) , duration, nil, true, true)

	character_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	character_util.set_direction(self.get_guard(1), 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(self.get_guard(2), 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(self.get_guard(3), 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.get_guard(4), 'left')

	character_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'up')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 리리스 각하께서.
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_guard(3), { key = 'demonworld_part1_s20_13', skip = true})

	character_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	character_util.set_direction(self.get_guard(3), 'left')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trouble_shooter)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mad_scientist)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	duration = 1
	character_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'up')
	character_util.move_to(mad_scientist, vector(0.5, 0, 57) , duration, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, vector(-1.5, 0, 57) , duration, nil, true, true)

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_emotion(trouble_shooter, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	character_util.nod_twice(trouble_shooter)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trouble_shooter)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_direction(trouble_shooter, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(mad_scientist, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'up')

	duration = 4
	stage_camera:Move(vector(-0.5, 0, 75), duration)
	character_util.move_to(mad_scientist, vector(0.5, 0.2, 58.8) , duration, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to(trouble_shooter, vector(-0.5, 0.2, 58.8) , duration, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, vector(-1.5, 0.2, 58.8) , duration, nil, true, true)

	wait_for_sec(3)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })

	-- 메인 퀘스트 클리어 연출 (앞으로n명)
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false, true, nil, nil, false)

	character_util.stop(trouble_shooter)
	character_util.stop(mad_scientist)
	character_util.stop(user_party.Leader)

	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby(true)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
	self.past_stage_name = nil

	self.quest_marker_name = nil

	self.s20_event_state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_guard(1), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_guard(2), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_guard(3), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_guard(4), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_trouble_shooter(), self.controller)
end

return local_class
